  • Je beschikt over eigen vervoer (auto, bromfiets, elektrische fiets, gewone fiets).

title: Business & Financial Controller
description:
Voor Groep De Troef, Den Aas en Aas+ zoeken wij een analytische en proactieve Business & Financial Controller.

In deze functie ben je de financiële rechterhand van directie en management. Je bewaakt de financiële gezondheid van onze organisaties, volgt budgetten op en vertaalt cijfers naar heldere inzichten die als basis dienen voor strategische en operationele beslissingen.

Jouw taken

  • Opvolgen en analyseren van budgetten, kosten en financiële resultaten.
  • Opstellen van managementrapporteringen, dashboards en KPI's.
  • Signaleren van financiële risico's en afwijkingen.
  • Uitwerken van financiële simulaties ter ondersteuning van HR en directie.
  • Opvolgen van subsidies en analyseren van hun financiële impact.
  • Bewaken van de rendabiliteit van projecten en activiteiten.
  • Uitwerken van rendabiliteits- en scenarioanalyses voor investeringen.
  • Opstellen van meerjarenprognoses en financiële toekomstanalyses.
  • Nauwe samenwerking met boekhouding, HR, directie en leidinggevenden.
  • Adviseren van management op basis van financiële inzichten

  • Je beschikt over een bachelordiploma in een financiële, economische of bedrijfskundige richting.
  • Je bent sterk in analytisch denken en werkt nauwkeurig en gestructureerd.
  • Je kan financiële gegevens vertalen naar begrijpbare inzichten voor collega's zonder financiële achtergrond.
  • Je neemt initiatief en durft kritische vragen te stellen.

title: WAKENDE NACHTBEGELEID(ST)ER mvx
description:
Vzw Rozemarijn organiseert dag en woonondersteuning op vraag van volwassen personen met een handicap. In onze afdeling te Haacht zoeken we een actieve nachtdienst. Naast de nachtpermanentie met ADL hulp, verwachten we van jou dat je een aantal huishoudelijke klussen opneemt (was - strijk - poetswerk), maar natuurlijk gaan de vragen van onze cliënten altijd voor. Bij de start werk je in twee blokjes per maand: één van vier nachten en één van drie nachten. Standaard werk je één blok van 7 nachten per maand. Je kan zelfstandig werken, vlot inspelen op onverwachte situaties en bent flexibel. Je start in Haacht, maar op termijn kan je ook tewerk gesteld worden in Keerbergen.

Vertrouwdheid met doelgroep - of bereid om zich snel in te werken. Een verpleegkundige opleiding is een meerwaarde. Je bent flexibel.

title: Medewerker Organisatie, Communicatie en Administratie vzw De Knoop
description:
Je verantwoordelijkheden zijn drieledig:

- Organisatie
- Je bent verantwoordelijk voor praktische en administratieve organisatie van onze sociale kruidenier
- Je staat in voor de operationele coaching van vrijwilligers in de sociale kruidenier. Je zorgt voor een duidelijke taakverdeling en volgt de planning op.
- Je bent het aanspreekpunt voor alles wat met de sociale kruidenier heeft te maken voor zowel de klanten als de vrijwilligers
- Je zorgt ook voor de stock en de bestellingen zowel in de kruidenier als de rest van de werkingen

- Administratie
- Algemene administratieve taken, zoals agenda- en mailbeheer, opmaak vergaderverslagen, nazicht boekingen en betalingen
- Eerste aanspreekpunt van de organisatie via telefoon, mail en andere sociale media
- Rapportering en opvolging van aanwezigheden in kader van sociale tewerkstelling
- Medeverantwoordelijk voor de financiële verantwoording
- Input en bijhouden van de boekhouding (kascontrole, bank- en kasverrichtingen, opvolging, controle en inkomende en uitgaande facturen,...)

- Communicatie
- Zorgt mee voor de (eind)redactie en copywriting van de nieuwsbrieven en alle andere communicatie
- Opvolgen sociale media
- Meewerken aan het updaten van de website en publiceren van digitale artikels.
- Onderhouden van contacten via Facebook, o.a. plaatsen van posts.
- Communicatieplannen

- Maandelijks neem je deel aan het teamoverleg en werk je mee aan initiatieven en evenementen van vzw De Knoop.



- Je bent in het bezit van een diploma hoger secundair onderwijs.
- Je bent sterk met cijfers en met taal
- Je hebt een goede kennis van Excel en Word
- Je bent sterk in nauwkeurig en ordelijk werken, met oog voor detail
- Je bent communicatief, discreet, stipt en gemotiveerd.
- Je leert snel, kan precies werken en verliest geen deadlines uit het oog
- Je wordt enthousiast van een goede planning en organisatie
- Je bent proactief en kan zowel zelfstandig als in team werken
- Je schrikt niet terug van avond- of weekendwerk tijdens piekperiodes
- Je hebt affiniteit en/of ervaring met de onderliggende problematiek van mensen in armoede en in kwetsbare situaties
- Ervaring met vrijwilligers is een pluspunt

title: Poetshulp - regio Puurs
description:
Als poetshulp in de thuiszorg in regio Puurs help je cliënten die door gezondheidsredenen het onderhoud van hun woning niet meer zelfstandig kunnen uitvoeren. Jij zorgt voor netheid, structuur en comfort in hun eigen huis, waardoor ze langer veilig en zelfstandig thuis kunnen blijven wonen. Je werkt zelfstandig, met respect voor iemands thuis en gewoontes, en je maakt met praktische hulp elke week opnieuw een merkbaar verschil. Jouw nieuwe taken:

  • je maakt woningen schoon (vloeren, meubels, keuken, sanitair) volgens de noden van de cliënt;
  • je stofzuigt, dweilt, ontstoft en houdt leefruimtes ordelijk en hygiënisch;
  • je ververst lakens en maakt bedden op, in overleg met de cliënt;
  • je toont aandacht voor details zoals verluchten van kamers en netjes opruimen;
  • je doet afwas en bergt de vaat op waar dit afgesproken is;
  • je poetst ramen, boent parket/meubels en pakt extra taken aan volgens behoefte;
  • je werkt respectvol in de thuissituatie en draagt bij aan comfort en zelfstandigheid van de cliënt.

Als poetshulp draag je bij aan comfort en zelfstandigheid van cliënten in hun eigen woning. Je voert huishoudelijke taken uit en werkt respectvol in de thuissituatie. Samen met collega’s zorg jij voor betrouwbare thuiszorgondersteuning. Daarnaast staan de kwaliteiten zelfstandig, sociaal en nauwkeurig binnen jouw functie centraal. Verder vragen wij:

  • geen specifieke studievereisten;
  • je beschikt over een eigen wagen;
  • je kan zelfstandig werken;
  • je hebt een goede kennis van de Nederlandse taal.

title: Schoonmaak - Housekeeping ( enkel voor enthousiastelingen )
description:
Word jij gelukkig van netjes opgemaakte bedden, frisse kamers en tevreden gasten? Dan hebben wij een job waar je elke dag het verschil maakt!

Voor ons sfeervolle hotel in Turnhout zoeken we een enthousiaste collega ter versterking van ons team. kamers.
Spreek je Nederlands of Engels? Perfect!


Wat ga je doen?

  • Hotelkamers perfect poetsen en klaarmaken voor nieuwe gasten
  • Bedden opmaken en linnengoed vervangen
  • Badkamers reinigen en aanvullen waar nodig
  • Zorgen voor een nette, frisse en gastvrije uitstraling
  • Samenwerken met collega's onze gasten een topverblijf te bezorgen

Belangrijk detail: Deze job is enkel beschikbaar voor ENTHOUSIASTE kandidaten die veel ZIN hebben om ons leuke TEAM te versterken.

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Do neatly made beds, fresh rooms and satisfied guests make you happy? Then we have a job where you can make a difference every day!

For our charming hotel in Turnhout, we’re looking for an enthusiastic colleague to join our team.

Do you speak Dutch or English? Perfect!

What will you be doing?

  • Cleaning hotel rooms to a high standard and preparing them for new guests
  • Making up beds and changing bed linen
  • Cleaning bathrooms and restocking where necessary
  • Ensuring a neat, fresh and welcoming atmosphere
  • Working with colleagues to ensure our guests have a fantastic stay

Please note: This job is ONLY available to ENTHUSIASTIC candidates who are really KEEN to join our great TEAM.

  • Je werkt nauwkeurig en hebt oog voor detail
  • Je bent 100% betrouwbaar
  • Je bent zelfstandig en steekt graag de handen uit de mouwen
  • Je spreekt Nederlands en/of Engels
  • Je bent vriendelijk en betrouwbaar
  • Ervaring in schoonmaak is mooi meegenomen

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

  • You work meticulously and have an eye for detail
  • You're 100% reliable
  • You are independent and enjoy getting stuck in
  • You speak Dutch and/or English
  • You are friendly and reliable
  • Experience in cleaning would be an advantage

title: Become a Truck Mechanic – Put Your Technical Skills to Work for the Future!
description:
As a truck mechanic, you’ll be responsible for performing accurate diagnostics and repairs on trucks, with a strong focus on DAF vehicles. You see electrical malfunctions as challenges, read wiring diagrams with ease, and work according to the latest technical guidelines. You communicate clearly with customers and manufacturers about your work and support our branch in Herent when needed.

Your day starts in a fully equipped workshop where you collaborate with a young, dynamic team. You begin by planning the necessary repairs, running diagnostics with advanced equipment, and ensuring every truck is safe and ready for the road. You coordinate colleagues and provide technical support, helping the whole team deliver top results.

Ready to take the next step in your career as a mechanic? Apply today and let our enthusiastic team guide you as you grow and thrive!

  • You have a technical diploma (A3/A2) in automotive mechanics or equivalent experience
  • A bachelor’s degree in automotive technology is a plus
  • At least 2 years of relevant experience in the automotive sector
  • You have basic knowledge of electronics and experience with wiring diagrams
  • You can work independently and take responsibility
  • Experience in leading a team is an advantage
  • Good command of English is required
  • A C(E) driver’s license is an asset but not required

title: Folding Glue Machine Operator F/X/M
description:
Step into the world of precision packaging with us as a Folding Glue Machine Operator. We're looking for individuals who are meticulous and passionate about delivering quality in every fold and glue application. This position is your chance to shine in a fast-paced production environment. Your day will revolve around setting up and operating folding glue machines, ensuring that all products meet our high standards of quality and efficiency. You'll be tasked with troubleshooting issues, maintaining equipment, and working closely with your team to achieve daily production targets. Your role is crucial in supporting our commitment to excellence. Ready to make an impact with your skills and expertise? Apply now and be part of a company where your efforts are recognized and rewarded. Join us and take your career in packaging to the next level.

  •  Attractive salary of €18,11 (I,II shift) up to 19,65 (night shift) + €5 food checks for each day worked
  • Bonuses: 13th salary, vacation money, mileage allowance, family allowance, health and accident insurance, paid holidays
  • Reimbursement for first arrival in Belgium: €250
  • Accommodation close to the workplace: single room
  • You'll start with a temporary employment contract and after one year there is the opportunity to receive a fixed contract

title: Huishoudhulp thuiszorg - regio Oudenaarde (deeltijds)
description:
Familiehulp ondersteunt mensen in hun dagelijks leven, met aandacht voor zorg, welzijn, huishouden en schoonmaak.

 

Als huishoudhulp / poetshulp in de thuiszorg ondersteun je mensen met een zorgbehoefte.

Je helpt hen voornamelijk met huishoudelijke taken zodat zij comfortabel thuis kunnen blijven wonen.

De klant is altijd thuis als jij er bent en je werkt samen met collega's huishoudhulpen en verzorgenden in een zorgteam.

Jouw taken zijn : 

  • Het schoonmaken en poetsen van de woning.
  • Af en toe de was en strijk .
  • Een luisterend oor en aandacht voor het welzijn van je klant.
  • Het signaleren van noden of veranderingen aan je collega's wanneer dat nodig is.
  • Geen ervaring of diploma nodig.
  • Je hebt een hart voor mensen en haalt voldoening uit huishoudelijke hulp, poetsen en schoonmaken bij klanten thuis.
  • Je houdt van sociaal contact, maar werkt ook graag zelfstandig.
  • Je werkt stipt en overlegt vlot met je klant en het zorgteam.
  • Je bent betrouwbaar en hebt respect voor de privacy van je klanten.

  • Je beschikt over eigen vervoer.

In sommige regio's is ander aangepast vervoer nodig om op tijd bij de klanten te geraken, zeker als je voltijds werkt.

title: Technisch-commercieel medewerker Groen
description:
Je hebt een grondige kennis van groenaanleg en -onderhoud en kan de noden van de klant moeiteloos vertalen naar een concreet voorstel?

Dan zoeken we jou.

Bij ODAS zorgt onze afdeling Groen voor onderhoud en aanleg van tuinen, parken en groenzones, bij bedrijven en particulieren.

Als Technisch-commercieel medewerker ben je de schakel tussen klant en werkvloer. Je bouwt de klantenportefeuille uit, je houdt ze tevreden, en je zorgt dat er genoeg opdrachten zijn om onze medewerkers het hele jaar door aan het werk te houden, ook in de winter.

Je rapporteert aan de Manager Diensten en werkt nauw samen met de Afdelingsverantwoordelijke Groen.

Je voelt je thuis in het groen en hebt een stevige algemene groenkennis.

Je hebt aantoonbare ervaring in groenonderhoud of -aanleg, in een professionele context.

·        Je onderhoudt de bestaande klantenportefeuille en gaat actief op zoek naar winterwerk voor de Groenploegen;

·        Je bouwt langetermijnrelaties uit met huidige en nieuwe klanten;

·        Je analyseert samen met de Teamverantwoordelijke Groen wat de klant nodig heeft;

·        Je stelt telkens een oplossing voor die zowel ecologisch als economisch klopt;

·        Je stemt de planning van de werken af met de Afdelingsverantwoordelijke en Teamverantwoordelijken;

·        Je volgt de voortgang op en regelt de oplevering, in samenspraak met diezelfde collega's;

·        Je polst frequent naar de tevredenheid van de klant;

·        Je geeft technische ondersteuning en advies aan de Teamverantwoordelijke en de werkvloer;

·        Je begeleidt en coördineert de opleidingen van de medewerkers;

·        Je beheert de technische infrastructuur van de groendienst en onderbouwt aankoopvoorstellen;

·        Veiligheid en 5S zitten in alles wat je doet en zegt;

·        Je werkt vlot met MS Office.

Herken je jezelf in dit verhaal? Dan ben je al goed op weg. 😉

title: Productieplanner / Aankoper
description:
Bij Mariasteen vzw combineren we ambitie en impact. Met een hoogtechnologisch machinepark en klanten van internationale allure zijn we een sterke speler in metaal & montage, hout, enclavewerking, horeca en externe diensten.Tegelijk zetten we dagelijks in op mensgericht werken: samen met 1.000 collega’s geef je mensen met een afstand tot de arbeidsmarkt alle kansen en maak je echt verschil.

Voor onze organisatie zoeken we een Productieplanner – Aankoper die instaat voor zowel het strategisch aankoopbeleid als de operationele opvolging binnen een technische productieomgeving.

In deze veelzijdige functie combineer je aankoop, planning, logistiek en klantenopvolging. Je werkt nauw samen met collega-productieplanners en de operationele leiding om een vlotte productie- en goederenflow te garanderen.

Jouw functieomschrijving

Aankoop & leveranciersbeheer

  • Strategisch en operationeel aankopen van grondstoffen
  • Selecteren, evalueren en opvolgen van leveranciers
  • Onderhandelen over prijzen en contractvoorwaarden in samenwerking met de operationele leiding
  • Opstellen van prijsaanvragen, beheren van info-records en plaatsen van bestellingen
  • Opvolgen van levertermijnen en behandelen van klachten
  • Actief meedenken over optimalisatie van aankoopprocessen
  • Inspelen op markt- en prijsfluctuaties

Planning, logistiek & klantopvolging

  • Beheer van productieorders en klantenorders binnen jouw portefeuille
  • Opmaak en opvolging van de productieplanning in samenwerking met de hoofdplanner
  • Klantencontact in functie van levertermijnen en orderopvolging
  • Opmaak van leveringsnota’s en verwerking van zendnota’s
  • Uitvoeren van magazijncontroles in functie van inventaris
  • Opvolging van verpakkingsmaterialen en logistieke flow
Jouw profiel
  • Bachelor of master (bij voorkeur industrieel ingenieur of gelijkwaardig door ervaring)
  • Enkele jaren ervaring binnen aankoop of supply chain management
  • Affiniteit met een technische productieomgeving; ervaring in de metaalindustrie is een plus
  • Sterk analytisch en probleemoplossend vermogen
  • Communicatief sterk en voldoende assertief
  • Vlotte kennis van Nederlands, Frans en Engels
  • Gestructureerd, nauwkeurig en stressbestendig

title: Enthousiaste poetshulpen regio LIEVEGEM - VAST CONTRACT & MAALTIJDCHEQUES
description:
Word je gelukkig in een propere en opgeruimde woning en help je graag anderen? Zoek je een flexibele job die je makkelijk kan combineren met je gezinsleven? Dan is een job als huishoudhulp ideaal voor jou!

Als huishoudhulp bij Daenens sta je in voor het huishouden van enkele gezinnen waar je op vaste basis langskomt. Je kent jouw klanten en weet dus waar je ze gelukkig mee kan maken. Zo ga je vlot aan het werk en zorg je voor een wow-effect als de klant thuiskomt.

Ben je enthousiast, vriendelijk, sociaal en hulpvaardig? Neem je graag initiatief? Kan je zelfstandig werken? Dan heb je bij Daenens al meteen een streepje voor! Een basiskennis van het Nederlands is een vereiste. Heb je nog geen ervaring? Een basiskennis schoonmaak is altijd interessant maar naargelang je hier werkt, krijg je ook de nodige opleidingen na verloop van tijd. Want bij ons word je goed omringd!

Daenens hecht veel belang aan gelijke kansen en diversiteit en moedigt iedereen aan om te solliciteren, ongeacht geslacht, afkomst, geloof, enz. Ook 45-plussers en personen met een functiebeperking zijn van harte welkom.

title: Fondsenwerver/Fundraiser (Antwerpen)
description:
Ben jij op zoek naar een flexibele en zinvolle job?

Sluit je aan bij ons dynamisch en gemotiveerd team van fondsenwervers bij Artsen zonder Grenzen (AZG)
Onze ambassadeurs reizen door heel België en helpen een divers publiek te betrekken bij de humanitaire inzet van Artsen Zonder Grenzen door maandelijkse steun te stimuleren.
Onze geëngageerde en communicatieve teams gaan in gesprek met mensen in winkels, ziekenhuizen, op evenementen en deur aan deur.
We zoeken voortdurend nieuwe talenten die ons team willen versterken en bijdragen aan de onafhankelijkheid en impact van Artsen Zonder Grenzen.

BELANGRIJKSTE VERANTWOORDELIJKHEDEN

  • Betrek zoveel mogelijk mensen bij het steunen van AZG met een maandelijkse donatie door gesprekken te starten met een divers publiek
  • Presenteer op een duidelijke en eenvoudige manier de acties en projecten van AZG, die het leven redden van duizenden mensen in meer dan 70 landen
  • Leg de waarden, principes en de besteding van donaties uit om het vertrouwen van donateurs te versterken
  • Zorg voor een nauwkeurige en volledige registratie van nieuwe inschrijvingen
  • Behaal de vooropgestelde doelstellingen op het vlak van volume en retentie

  • Interesse en/of ervaring in donorwerving, verkoop, …
  • Motivatie om je in te zetten voor een internationale medische organisatie, in lijn met de missie, waarden en principes van AZG
  • Flexibel om elke dag van locatie te veranderen in jouw eigen regio/provincie, zowel binnen als buiten (winkels, straat, evenementen, deur‑aan‑deur, …) en bereid om staand te werken op drukke plaatsen of buiten
  • Nauwkeurigheid, respect en een sterke ethiek, gecombineerd met een collegiale houding
  • Comfort bij intensief menselijk contact en spreken in het openbaar, met sterke verbale en non‑verbale communicatieve vaardigheden
  • Resultaatgericht dankzij doorzettingsvermogen, professionaliteit, positiviteit en dynamiek
  • Goede administratieve organisatie
  • Perfecte beheersing van het Nederlands (mondeling en schriftelijk);
  • In het bezit van een rijbewijs B en idealiter een auto; of bereid om je met het openbaar vervoer te verplaatsen

title: Customer Service Representative - Spanish & Portuguese Markets
description:
You play a key role in delivering excellent support and ensuring an efficient order-to-cash process.

Client Details

Our client is an international leader in the life sciences industry, based in Zaventem. They offer a long-term opportunity within their Customer Service team, providing a dynamic international environment, comprehensive training, and strong career development prospects.

Description

As a Customer Service, your key responsibilities are:

  • Processing and managing customer purchase orders in a timely manner, ensuring compliance with customer logistics and shipping requirements.
  • Serve as the first point of contact for customers, handling inquiries and resolving day-to-day issues.
  • Provide customers with accurate information regarding orders, products, and services while adhering to company processes and procedures.

We are looking for:

  • Previous experience in Customer Service, Order Management, or a related sales administrative role.
  • Strong communication and problem-solving skills with a customer-centric approach.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, international environment.
  • Fluent in English and Spanish, with a good command of Portuguese.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office applications. Experience with ERP systems is a plus.

title: Hulpverlener Bezoekruimte Dendermonde
description:
Als hulpverlener binnen de bezoekruimte sta je in voor het begeleiden van kinderen, jongeren en ouders waarbij het recht op persoonlijk contact werd verbroken. Je wilt je graag inzetten voor relatie- en contactherstel tussen ouders en minderjarige kinderen in (hoog)conflictueuze scheidingssituaties, die bij het CAW terechtkomen op doorverwijzing van een gerechtelijke instantie:

- Je organiseert begeleide bezoeken tussen ouder en kind in de lokalen van de bezoekruimte
- Je ervaring zet je graag in om begeleidingsgesprekken te doen met ouders en kinderen i.f.v. het uitzetten van een gedragen ouderschapsregeling
- Je vindt het belangrijk om het kindperspectief in te brengen in (hoog)conflictueuze scheidingen
- Je haalt energie uit het detecteren van de begeleidingsnoden bij de ouders en de kinderen i.f.v. een gepaste doorverwijzing binnen en buiten CAW Oost-Vlaanderen
- Hiernaast sta je ook in voor de administratie en rapportage verbonden aan de omgangsregeling en de verwijzende rechtbank.
- Je maakt deel uit van een enthousiast team en neemt actief deel aan interne en externe intervisies en supervisies.



- Je hebt een bachelordiploma (bachelor of HBO5) in een menswetenschappelijke richting (zoals toegepaste psychologie, sociaal werk of orthopedagogie), jouw kennis over (hoog)conflictueuze scheidingssituaties en effecten hiervan op ouder en kind is een troef!
- Je hebt minimum een eerste ervaring met begeleidingstrajecten.
- Je hebt een gezonde dosis assertiviteit en durft confronteren, structuur bieden en kordaat afgrenzen.
- Je weet van aanpakken en met jouw creatieve probleemoplossende vaardigheden speel je vlot in op nieuwe situaties.
- Je toont de nodige zelfstandigheid en verantwoordelijkheid in planning en administratie.
- Je bent sowieso 2x per maand op zaterdag beschikbaar en om de 14 dagen ook op woensdag.

title: Multilingual Customer Advisor – DE/EN/(NL or FR) in Liège
description:
Are you passionate about delivering outstanding customer service and fluent in multiple languages? As a Customer Advisor in our Liège-based team, you’ll be the first point of contact for customers, ensuring their needs are met with professionalism and efficiency. You’ll interact with international clients through various channels – calls, emails, and chat – providing accurate, friendly, and timely support.

On a typical day, you’ll handle inbound customer calls, respond to emails, and support clients via chat. You’ll address questions, resolve issues, and provide clear solutions, always following internal procedures and quality standards. Your day will be dynamic, working in rotating shifts and collaborating with colleagues from diverse backgrounds. Comprehensive training and support from your team ensure you have all the tools you need to succeed.

Ready to take the next step in your career? If you have strong language skills, a commitment to delivering excellent service, and thrive in a fast-paced, multicultural environment, we want to hear from you. Apply today and become a valued member of our international customer service team in Liège!

  • Successful completion of an English language assessment

  • Good computer literacy and ability to learn new systems
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, multicultural environment

  • Trilingual candidates are highly valued

title: Assistant Manager THE HOUSE OF FUN/SUPERJUMP GEEL
description:
Fase 1 — Own your zone

Jouw start als Lead SuperJump

Tijdens je eerste fase doorloop je een intensief opleidingstraject van ongeveer 6 maanden binnen SuperJump.

SuperJump wordt jouw eerste echte managementverantwoordelijkheid. Je wordt begeleid door ervaren verantwoordelijken en krijgt stap voor stap meer autonomie. Het doel is duidelijk: SuperJump operationeel volledig leren begrijpen, organiseren en leiden.

Wat willen we na deze eerste fase kunnen zeggen?

Je hebt SuperJump in je vingers.

Niet omdat je alles zelf doet, maar omdat je ervoor zorgt dat jouw team het goed doet. Dat verschil is voor ons belangrijk.

Fase 2 — Ready for more

Van SuperJump naar heel The House of Fun

Fase 3 — De rechterhand van onze Filiaalleider

Voor deze functie ligt onze lat bewust hoger dan voor een klassieke Lead-functie, vooral op het vlak van coaching. Jij tilt niet alleen je eigen team naar een hoger niveau: als het traject doorgroeit, help je uiteindelijk ook andere Leads sterker worden.

Diploma's zijn voor ons niet doorslaggevend. Leiderschapspotentieel, maturiteit en verantwoordelijkheidsgevoel wel.

We zoeken iemand die al heeft laten zien verantwoordelijkheid te kunnen opnemen. Ervaring met het aansturen, organiseren of begeleiden van mensen is daarom belangrijk. Dat kan bijvoorbeeld uit hospitality, leisure, retail, horeca, sport, events, entertainment of een andere dynamische omgeving komen.

title: Onthaalouder
description:
Haal jij ‘i-mens’ veel voldoening uit het begeleiden van kinderen? Dan ben jij misschien dé onthaalouder die baby’s en peuters opvangt bij jou thuis in Haaltert (of in deelgemeentes Heldergem, Kerksken, Denderhoutem).

Jouw hulp is goud waard, en daar krijg je veel voor terug:
  • Met je onthaalkinderen bij jou thuis is er altijd leven in de brouwerij;
  • Je speelt een belangrijke rol in de ontwikkeling van kinderen;
  • Je werkt in je eigen woning, waardoor je jouw werk-privébalans goed kan organiseren.

Meer weten over werken als onthaalouder bij i-mens? Check onze site!

Wat ga je doen?
Als onthaalouder vang je kinderen van 0 tot 3,5 jaar op bij jou thuis, op uren die je zelf mee bepaalt en met ondersteuning van i-mens. Je tovert je woning om tot een uitdagende, hygiënische en veilige omgeving voor kinderen.
Jouw takenpakket als onthaalouder is gevarieerd:
  • Je begeleidt de kinderen in hun eerste stapjes in het leven en stimuleert hun ontwikkeling;
  • Je speelt in op de talenten en de interesses van de kinderen;
  • Je houdt rekening met de emotionele behoeften van de kinderen;
  • Je biedt opvang en zorg en organiseert leerrijke, creatieve dagactiviteiten. Je behoudt het evenwicht tussen spel-, verzorgings-, rust- en eetmomenten;
  • Je werkt samen met het gezin als partner in de opvoeding. Je wisselt informatie uit met de ouders en maakt samen afspraken;
  • Je houdt nauwkeurig bij welke kindjes aanwezig waren en wanneer ze werden gebracht en opgehaald.
  • Je hebt een hart voor kinderen en helpt hen om hun eerste stappen in de wereld te zetten;
  • Je bent zorgzaam en geduldig;
  • Je kan goed organiseren;
  • Je gaat spontaan en correct in dialoog met kinderen, ouders en verantwoordelijke(n) van de dienst. Zo werken we het beste samen;
  • Als onthaalouder heb je een geldig kwalificatiebewijs nodig. We bekijken graag samen met jou of jouw diploma nu al in aanmerking komt. Als dat nog niet het geval is dan kan je dit alsnog behalen terwijl je al aan de slag gaat. Wij begeleiden je graag hierbij en voorzien hier ook een premie voor.

description:

title: Customer Support Associate with Norwegian & English – Sofia, Bulgaria
description:
For more than 37 years, Sutherland has been a global leader in Customer Experience Management (CXM). As a pioneer in automation and innovative customer solutions, we deliver exceptional service on behalf of our clients worldwide.

With operations in 60 countries and a presence in Bulgaria since 2008, our diverse team of more than 2,000 professionals supports customers in 17 different languages from Sofia, Varna, Burgas, and remote locations.

🎯 About the Role

We are looking for a Customer Support Associate with Danish and English to join our team supporting customers of a leading international telecommunications provider.

You will assist customers through inbound voice and non-voice channels, including phone, email, and chat, with day-to-day service-related questions such as top-ups, SIM activation, roaming usage, and general account inquiries. This is a pure customer service role with no sales, upselling, or device troubleshooting.

Key Responsibilities

    Handle inbound customer inquiries via phone, email, chat, and other supported channels
    Assist customers with top-ups, SIM activation, roaming usage, and general service-related questions
    Resolve customer concerns efficiently and aim for first-contact resolution whenever possible
    Accurately document customer interactions and follow established processes
    Provide professional, clear, and empathetic support in every interaction

🧠 What We’re Looking For

Must-have:

    Norwegian – minimum B2 level
    English – minimum B2 level
    Undergraduate, graduate, postgraduate education or equivalent
    Strong verbal and written communication skills
    Good computer skills and ability to work with multiple systems
    Availability to work 09:00–18:00, Monday to Friday

Nice-to-have:

    Previous experience in customer service, BPO, telecommunications, or a similar environment
    Experience working with CRM or ticketing systems
    Strong problem-solving skills and a customer-focused mindset

🎁 What You’ll Get

Compensation & Benefits:

    Competitive salary and performance-based bonuses
    Additional health insurance
    Food vouchers
    3 weeks of paid training in English, followed by accreditation
    Relocation support to Sofia for eligible candidates

Work Environment:

    Onsite from our Sofia office
    Working hours: 09:00–18:00, Monday to Friday
    Voice and non-voice customer support

Growth & Development

You will receive structured training and ongoing support while developing your customer service and communication skills in an international environment.

🚀 Ready to Apply?

Join us and become part of a team that delivers exceptional customer experiences every day. Apply now and start your journey with Sutherland.

title: Digital Transformation Services Lead (Hybrid)
description:
WorkNomads is on the hunt for a Head of Digital Transformation to join our team!



Who We Are:

We are building a community where global talent is geographically unleashed, and diversity is celebrated. We champion the freedom of living and working across borders, shaping a nation without a country.

·       Remote engineering services, global impact — expert engineering, design, and business talent in cross-disciplinary project teams.

·       Diversity celebrated — 40+ nationalities, 4 continents, one team.

·       Continuous growth — we invest in you: projects, coliving, community, pushing you beyond what you thought possible.



Your mission at WorkNomads:

The Digital Transformation Services Lead is responsible for reimagining and modernizing Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) service delivery by introducing digital, AI-enabled, and architecture-led operating models. Leveraging an enterprise architecture background, this role bridges business strategy, technology, and operations to transform how services are designed, delivered, measured, and continuously improved.

As the strategic technology leader for service transformation, the role also provides direction and governance to the IT organization, ensuring technology investments, platforms, and architecture enable the future state of service delivery.

Working in close partnership with Operations leadership to understand service performance, customer needs, and operational challenges through data-driven insights, the role actively uncovers commercial opportunities by identifying new digital capabilities, value-added services, and innovation initiatives that expand the client's service portfolio, strengthen strategic partnerships, and drive sustainable revenue growth and profitability.

Key Responsibilities

Service Transformation Strategy

Define and execute the digital transformation strategy for customer service accounts and managed services.

Design future-state operating models that leverage AI, automation, analytics, cloud technologies, and digital platforms.

Transform traditional BPO delivery into standardized, technology-enabled, and data-driven service models.

Establish scalable frameworks that can be replicated across multiple accounts and business units.



Enterprise Architecture & Technology Leadership

Apply Enterprise Architecture principles to align business capabilities, processes, applications, data, and technology with strategic objectives.

Define the target architecture for digital service delivery and guide the evolution of supporting technology platforms.

Ensure technology decisions support scalability, interoperability, security, governance, and operational excellence.

Lead and steer the IT organization in delivering technology capabilities that support business transformation.

Partner with IT leaders to prioritize investments, modernize platforms, and accelerate innovation.



Innovation & New Ways of Working

Introduce proven operational and digital practices from industries such as financial services, manufacturing, healthcare, logistics, and technology into the BPO environment.

Challenge existing service delivery models and drive continuous innovation.

Promote Agile, DevSecOps, product-oriented delivery, platform thinking, and automation-first principles across service operations.

Foster a culture of experimentation, continuous improvement, and technology adoption.



Operational Excellence

Redesign business processes to improve efficiency, quality, resilience, and customer experience.

Establish governance models, KPIs, dashboards, and performance metrics that provide end-to-end visibility into service performance.

Standardize processes and operating procedures to improve consistency across accounts.

Ensure transformation initiatives deliver measurable operational and financial outcomes.



Commercial Growth

Identify opportunities to expand service scope through digital capabilities, AI solutions, automation, consulting, and managed services.

Partner with Sales, Account Management, and Client Success teams to develop transformation roadmaps and business cases.

Position the organization as a strategic digital transformation partner for clients.

Support revenue growth through upselling, cross-selling, and innovative service offerings.



Financial & Value Realization

Improve account profitability through technology-enabled productivity gains and optimized delivery models.

Develop business cases that quantify expected benefits, ROI, and cost savings.

Track realization of transformation benefits and continuously optimize value delivery.



Leadership & Stakeholder Management

Lead cross-functional transformation programs involving Operations, IT, Digital, AI, Product, and Client teams.

Influence senior executives and client stakeholders on transformation priorities and investment decisions.

Mentor operational and technology leaders in digital transformation, enterprise architecture, and modern service delivery practices.

Build strong collaboration between business and IT to ensure successful execution.

Requirements

Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related discipline.

Enterprise Architecture experience with a strong understanding of business architecture, application architecture, data architecture, and technology architecture.

10+ years of experience in digital transformation, enterprise architecture, IT strategy, or service transformation.

Experience within BPO, customer operations, shared services, managed services, or large-scale service organizations.

Demonstrated success leading digital transformation initiatives involving AI, automation, cloud, analytics, and modern enterprise platforms.

Experience leading technology teams and influencing enterprise-wide transformation programs.

Knowledge of Enterprise Architecture frameworks (e.g., TOGAF) is an advantage.

Familiarity with Agile, DevSecOps, ITIL, Lean, Six Sigma, or Product Operating Models is preferred.

title: Svensktalande E-Commerce Advisor i Bulgarien
description:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they are doing!

We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business.

Concentrix Bulgaria is now looking for a number of dynamic and self-motivated Customer Advisors to join our exciting new project.

VF is the global company behind some of the world’s leading lifestyle brands including household names such as, Timberland, The North Face, Napapijri, Lee, Wrangler, Vans Eastpak and Kipling
Our aim is to consistently deliver world class customer service and we never lose sight of our goal - our customers are the focus of everything we do here! From email to phone in a multitude of languages, we’re on hand to offer care to all our customers to make sure they have a fun and enjoyable shopping experience with us.  

We’re an energetic, innovative and forward thinking team who are always looking for new ideas to delight and wow our customers.  The Customer Advisor is required to:

•    Be proficient (verbal & written) in Swedish
•    Be advanced in English
•    Be able to represent our client’s brands and deliver outstanding customer service with clarity, passion and enthusiasm
•    Be flexible to meet the changing needs and varying deadlines of our business
•    Be able to work to customer service measures, metrics and KPIs within a service targeted environment.
•    Hold a High-school or University degree
•    Possess excellent computer literacy
•    Have previous experience in a customer service environment, preferably telephone based.

Main responsibilities:

•    Communicating with customers by telephone, email and online to provide outstanding service
•    Building a rapport with customers to help them with enquiries including; order taking, product information, tracking deliveries, returns, sizing and quality queries
•    Discussing new products and managing multiple tasks to promptly resolve customer queries
•    Identifying ways to improve processes in order to improve sales, brand loyalty and the customer service and experience
•    Updating our systems with information and helping marketing, retail and other teams to further improve customer service and satisfaction.
Who are we:
Concentrix, a wholly owned subsidiary of SYNNEX Corporation (NYSE: SNX), is a leading business services company. We focus on customer engagement and improving business outcomes for over 450 global clients across many continents. Our 100,000+ staff deliver technology-infused, omni-channel customer experience management, marketing optimization, digital, consulting, analytics and back office solutions in 40+ languages from 125+ delivery centres. We serve automotive; banking and financial services; insurance; healthcare; technology; consumer electronics; media and communications; retail and e-commerce; travel and transportation; and energy and public-sector clients.

The Digital Transformation Services Lead is responsible for reimagining and modernizing Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) service delivery by introducing digital, AI-enabled, and architecture-led operating models. Leveraging an enterprise architecture background, this role bridges business strategy, technology, and operations to transform how services are designed, delivered, measured, and continuously improved.

As the strategic technology leader for service transformation, the role also provides direction and governance to the IT organization, ensuring technology investments, platforms, and architecture enable the future state of service delivery.

Working in close partnership with Operations leadership to understand service performance, customer needs, and operational challenges through data-driven insights, the role actively uncovers commercial opportunities by identifying new digital capabilities, value-added services, and innovation initiatives that expand the client's service portfolio, strengthen strategic partnerships, and drive sustainable revenue growth and profitability.

Key Responsibilities

Service Transformation Strategy

Define and execute the digital transformation strategy for customer service accounts and managed services.

Design future-state operating models that leverage AI, automation, analytics, cloud technologies, and digital platforms.

Transform traditional BPO delivery into standardized, technology-enabled, and data-driven service models.

Establish scalable frameworks that can be replicated across multiple accounts and business units.



Enterprise Architecture & Technology Leadership

Apply Enterprise Architecture principles to align business capabilities, processes, applications, data, and technology with strategic objectives.

Define the target architecture for digital service delivery and guide the evolution of supporting technology platforms.

Ensure technology decisions support scalability, interoperability, security, governance, and operational excellence.

Lead and steer the IT organization in delivering technology capabilities that support business transformation.

Partner with IT leaders to prioritize investments, modernize platforms, and accelerate innovation.



Innovation & New Ways of Working

Introduce proven operational and digital practices from industries such as financial services, manufacturing, healthcare, logistics, and technology into the BPO environment.

Challenge existing service delivery models and drive continuous innovation.

Promote Agile, DevSecOps, product-oriented delivery, platform thinking, and automation-first principles across service operations.

Foster a culture of experimentation, continuous improvement, and technology adoption.



Operational Excellence

Redesign business processes to improve efficiency, quality, resilience, and customer experience.

Establish governance models, KPIs, dashboards, and performance metrics that provide end-to-end visibility into service performance.

Standardize processes and operating procedures to improve consistency across accounts.

Ensure transformation initiatives deliver measurable operational and financial outcomes.



Commercial Growth

Identify opportunities to expand service scope through digital capabilities, AI solutions, automation, consulting, and managed services.

Partner with Sales, Account Management, and Client Success teams to develop transformation roadmaps and business cases.

Position the organization as a strategic digital transformation partner for clients.

Support revenue growth through upselling, cross-selling, and innovative service offerings.



Financial & Value Realization

Improve account profitability through technology-enabled productivity gains and optimized delivery models.

Develop business cases that quantify expected benefits, ROI, and cost savings.

Track realization of transformation benefits and continuously optimize value delivery.



Leadership & Stakeholder Management

Lead cross-functional transformation programs involving Operations, IT, Digital, AI, Product, and Client teams.

Influence senior executives and client stakeholders on transformation priorities and investment decisions.

Mentor operational and technology leaders in digital transformation, enterprise architecture, and modern service delivery practices.

Build strong collaboration between business and IT to ensure successful execution.

Requirements

Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related discipline.

Enterprise Architecture experience with a strong understanding of business architecture, application architecture, data architecture, and technology architecture.

10+ years of experience in digital transformation, enterprise architecture, IT strategy, or service transformation.

Experience within BPO, customer operations, shared services, managed services, or large-scale service organizations.

Demonstrated success leading digital transformation initiatives involving AI, automation, cloud, analytics, and modern enterprise platforms.

Experience leading technology teams and influencing enterprise-wide transformation programs.

Knowledge of Enterprise Architecture frameworks (e.g., TOGAF) is an advantage.

Familiarity with Agile, DevSecOps, ITIL, Lean, Six Sigma, or Product Operating Models is preferred.

title: Digital Transformation Services Lead (Hybrid)
description:
WorkNomads is on the hunt for a Head of Digital Transformation to join our team!



Who We Are:

We are building a community where global talent is geographically unleashed, and diversity is celebrated. We champion the freedom of living and working across borders, shaping a nation without a country.

·       Remote engineering services, global impact — expert engineering, design, and business talent in cross-disciplinary project teams.

·       Diversity celebrated — 40+ nationalities, 4 continents, one team.

·       Continuous growth — we invest in you: projects, coliving, community, pushing you beyond what you thought possible.



Your mission at WorkNomads:

The Digital Transformation Services Lead is responsible for reimagining and modernizing Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) service delivery by introducing digital, AI-enabled, and architecture-led operating models. Leveraging an enterprise architecture background, this role bridges business strategy, technology, and operations to transform how services are designed, delivered, measured, and continuously improved.

As the strategic technology leader for service transformation, the role also provides direction and governance to the IT organization, ensuring technology investments, platforms, and architecture enable the future state of service delivery.

Working in close partnership with Operations leadership to understand service performance, customer needs, and operational challenges through data-driven insights, the role actively uncovers commercial opportunities by identifying new digital capabilities, value-added services, and innovation initiatives that expand the client's service portfolio, strengthen strategic partnerships, and drive sustainable revenue growth and profitability.

Key Responsibilities

Service Transformation Strategy

Define and execute the digital transformation strategy for customer service accounts and managed services.

Design future-state operating models that leverage AI, automation, analytics, cloud technologies, and digital platforms.

Transform traditional BPO delivery into standardized, technology-enabled, and data-driven service models.

Establish scalable frameworks that can be replicated across multiple accounts and business units.



Enterprise Architecture & Technology Leadership

Apply Enterprise Architecture principles to align business capabilities, processes, applications, data, and technology with strategic objectives.

Define the target architecture for digital service delivery and guide the evolution of supporting technology platforms.

Ensure technology decisions support scalability, interoperability, security, governance, and operational excellence.

Lead and steer the IT organization in delivering technology capabilities that support business transformation.

Partner with IT leaders to prioritize investments, modernize platforms, and accelerate innovation.



Innovation & New Ways of Working

Introduce proven operational and digital practices from industries such as financial services, manufacturing, healthcare, logistics, and technology into the BPO environment.

Challenge existing service delivery models and drive continuous innovation.

Promote Agile, DevSecOps, product-oriented delivery, platform thinking, and automation-first principles across service operations.

Foster a culture of experimentation, continuous improvement, and technology adoption.



Operational Excellence

Redesign business processes to improve efficiency, quality, resilience, and customer experience.

Establish governance models, KPIs, dashboards, and performance metrics that provide end-to-end visibility into service performance.

Standardize processes and operating procedures to improve consistency across accounts.

Ensure transformation initiatives deliver measurable operational and financial outcomes.



Commercial Growth

Identify opportunities to expand service scope through digital capabilities, AI solutions, automation, consulting, and managed services.

Partner with Sales, Account Management, and Client Success teams to develop transformation roadmaps and business cases.

Position the organization as a strategic digital transformation partner for clients.

Support revenue growth through upselling, cross-selling, and innovative service offerings.



Financial & Value Realization

Improve account profitability through technology-enabled productivity gains and optimized delivery models.

Develop business cases that quantify expected benefits, ROI, and cost savings.

Track realization of transformation benefits and continuously optimize value delivery.



Leadership & Stakeholder Management

Lead cross-functional transformation programs involving Operations, IT, Digital, AI, Product, and Client teams.

Influence senior executives and client stakeholders on transformation priorities and investment decisions.

Mentor operational and technology leaders in digital transformation, enterprise architecture, and modern service delivery practices.

Build strong collaboration between business and IT to ensure successful execution.

Requirements

Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related discipline.

Enterprise Architecture experience with a strong understanding of business architecture, application architecture, data architecture, and technology architecture.

10+ years of experience in digital transformation, enterprise architecture, IT strategy, or service transformation.

Experience within BPO, customer operations, shared services, managed services, or large-scale service organizations.

Demonstrated success leading digital transformation initiatives involving AI, automation, cloud, analytics, and modern enterprise platforms.

Experience leading technology teams and influencing enterprise-wide transformation programs.

Knowledge of Enterprise Architecture frameworks (e.g., TOGAF) is an advantage.

Familiarity with Agile, DevSecOps, ITIL, Lean, Six Sigma, or Product Operating Models is preferred.

title: MEHANIČAR/ MEHATRONIČAR
description:
MEHANIČAR / MEHATRONIČAR (m/ž)

Kao obiteljsko poduzeće znamo da su ljudi ti, koji svojim znanjem i vještinama pridonose našem uspjehu. Isto im vraćamo sa stimulativnim primanjima i korporativnom kulturom u kojoj se žive obiteljske vrijednosti. Želimo biti više od skupine timova u jednom poduzeću. Međusobna suradnja znači za nas međusobnu povezanost. Svi smo složni u uvjerenju da zajedno postižemo velike stvari.

Kao poduzeće. Kao tim. Kao obitelj.

Očekuju te sljedeći zadaci:

  • Redovito održavanje strojeva u proizvodnom pogonu
  • Utvrđivanje i otklanjanje kvarova na strojevima

  • Završena škola: elektrotehničar, elektromehaničar, mehatroničar ili električar, stručnjak za pneumatiku i hidrauliku
  • Poželjno radno iskustvo minimalno 2 godine u području održavanja pneumatskih i hidrauličnih strojeva
  • Pouzdanost i samostalnost u obavljanju radnih zadataka
  • Izraženi timski duh
  • Fleksibilnost
  • Poželjno poznavanje engleskog ili njemačkog jezika u govoru i pismu

Što te očekuje:

  • Rad u internacionalnom okruženju
  • Stimulativna primanja
  • Mogućnost napredovanja
  • Ugovor na neodređeno vrijeme
  • Poticajna i prijateljska radna atmosfera
  • Uvođenje u posao pod vodstvom mentora

title: KONOBAR/ICA
description: Opis poslova: Naš tim proširujemo osobom koja ima želju za učenjem i kontinuiranim usavršavanjem na radnom mjestu: Ugostiteljski djelatnik/ica, lokacija rada Caffe Allegri-Velika Gorica. Što ćete raditi? - posluživati goste sukladno propisanim pravilima i standardima - održavati čistoću i urednost radnog prostora i opreme - osiguravati primjenu propisanih i zadanih standarda u ugostiteljstvu - predstavljati organizaciju u najboljem svjetlu te izgrađivati prijateljske odnose sa gostima i kolegama Što nudimo? - stimulativne uvjete - rad u uspješnoj i stabilnoj tvrtki - dinamičnu i ugodnu radnu atmosferu – izvrsne kolege i međuljudske odnose. Velika pozornost pridaje se kvaliteti usluge i stručnosti osoblja s naglaskom na srdačnost! Visoku razinu kvalitete održavamo kontinuiranim ulaganjem u naše djelatnike, prostor i ponudu, što nam se višestruko vraća kroz zadovoljne djelatnike i stalne goste. Ukoliko i Vi želite postati dio našeg tima od 150 zadovoljnih djelatnika, javite se na naš natječaj! Ako i nemate radnog iskustva te bi Vam ovo bilo prvo zaposlenje, rado ćemo Vas uzeti u obzir kao potencijalnog kandidata, te Vam pomoći u stjecanju iskustva i usvajanju novih znanja i vještina! Za dodatne informacije o našoj ponudi i uvjetima rada možete se javiti na broj 091 620 5744 ili posao@celka.hr .

  • Rad iz ureda: Posao se obavlja isključivo iz našeg ureda u Splitu (nije remote), što nam omogućuje bržu internu komunikaciju i bolju timsku sinergiju.

Uvjeti:

  • Izvrsno znanje francuskog jezika u govoru i pismu (minimalno razina C1) – s klijentima komuniciraš tečno i prirodno, na razini izvornog govornika, bez primjetnog naglaska
  • Iskustvo u korisničkoj podršci, account managementu ili telefonskoj prodaji (računamo i studentski rad)
  • Empatija i sposobnost slušanja: razumiješ potrebe klijenata i pretvaraš ih u konkretne korake
  • Organiziran/a si, voliš timski rad i motiviraju te jasni ciljevi

Što nudimo:

  • Strukturirani onboarding, kontinuirane edukacije i mentorstvo
  • Motivirajući bonusi povezani s rezultatima tima i portfelja
  • Ured s prijateljskom atmosferom i povremenim team building aktivnostima

Zašto se pridružiti:

  • Tržište smo lansirali nedavno – sudjeluješ u izgradnji od samog početka, imaš priliku ostaviti svoj trag i rasti zajedno s platformom
  • Napredovanje svakih 12 mjeseci
  • Vikendi i večeri su slobodni – rad-život balans nam je važan – radimo samo do 16 h radnim danom
  • Moderna oprema, besplatna kava i tim koji dijeli znanje i iskustvo

Osiguravamo ti između 20 i 30 dana odmora, ovisno o tvojoj dobi i stažu unutar naše firme. Posebno cijenimo tvoje slobodno vrijeme, stoga potičemo korištenje dužeg godišnjeg odmora tijekom ljetnih mjeseci kako bi u potpunosti napunio/la baterije.

title: POSLOVOĐA/POSLOVOTKINJA ODRŽAVANJA
description:
Opis poslova:

  • organizacija i praćenje provedbe godišnjeg plana održavanja i remonta
  • preventivno i interventno održavanje opreme te dijagnosticiranje i otklanjanje kvarova u proizvodnom pogonu
  • koordinacija i nadzor servisa i radova koje izvode vanjski izvođači
  • kontrola kvalitete rada operatera održavanja
  • sudjelovanje u remontima pogona i drugim poslovima održavanja u okviru stručnosti i iskustva
  • vođenje brige o zaduženoj radnoj opremi, alatima i materijalu
  • rad u skladu s dokumentacijom sustava upravljanja i propisanim procedurama
  • pridržavanje pravila zaštite na radu, zaštite od požara i zaštite okoliša
  • pravilno postupanje s otpadom i, prema potrebi, opasnim tvarima
  • obavljanje drugih poslova iz područja održavanja u skladu sa stručnim znanjima i iskustvom.

Potrebne kvalifikacije i kompetencije:

  • završena srednja stručna sprema tehničkog usmjerenja
  • najmanje 2 godine radnog iskustva na istim ili sličnim poslovima
  • znanje engleskog jezika
  • osnovno poznavanje rada u MS Officeu
  • tehnička stručnost i sposobnost samostalnog rješavanja kvarova
  • dobre organizacijske sposobnosti, odgovornost i pouzdanost
  • sposobnost organiziranja i praćenja rada drugih zaposlenika
  • spremnost na timski rad.

Prednost imaju kandidati koji posjeduju:

  • znanje njemačkog jezika
  • osposobljenost za rad s viličarom, dizalicom, hidrauličnom platformom ili sličnom opremom.

Zamolbe i životopise šaljite na hr@enikonaerospace.com s naznakom "za natječaj poslovođa održavanja"

title: OPERATER/OPERATERKA ODRŽAVANJA
description:
Opis poslova:

  • obavljanje preventivnog i interventnog održavanja opreme i postrojenja u proizvodnom pogonu
  • dijagnosticiranje i otklanjanje kvarova na strojevima, uređajima i drugoj opremi
  • sudjelovanje u provedbi godišnjih remonta postrojenja
  • sudjelovanje u izradi i unapređenju radnih uputa za održavanje, u suradnji s Poslovođom održavanja
  • suradnja s drugim članovima tima i ostalim odjelima radi osiguravanja nesmetanog rada proizvodnje
  • vođenje brige o zaduženoj radnoj opremi, alatima i materijalu
  • rad u skladu s propisanim procedurama i dokumentacijom sustava upravljanja
  • pridržavanje pravila zaštite na radu te korištenje propisane osobne zaštitne opreme
  • pridržavanje pravila zaštite okoliša, zaštite od požara i pravilnog postupanja s otpadom
  • obavljanje drugih poslova održavanja u okviru stručnosti i radnog iskustva.

Potrebne kvalifikacije i kompetencije:

  • završena srednja stručna sprema, poželjno tehničkog usmjerenja
  • poželjno najmanje 1 godina radnog iskustva na poslovima održavanja ili sličnim tehničkim poslovima
  • znanje engleskog jezika
  • osnovno poznavanje rada u MS Officeu
  • tehnička spretnost i sposobnost dijagnosticiranja i rješavanja problema
  • odgovornost, pouzdanost i samostalnost u radu
  • spremnost na timski rad i suradnju s drugim odjelima.

Prednost imaju kandidati koji posjeduju:

  • iskustvo u održavanju proizvodnih strojeva i postrojenja
  • elektrotehnička, strojarska, mehatronička ili druga odgovarajuća tehnička znanja
  • osposobljenost za rad s viličarom, dizalicom, hidrauličnom platformom ili sličnom opremom
  • osposobljenost za rad s kemikalijama odnosno opasnim tvarima.

Zamolbe i životopise slati na hr@enikonaerospace.com s naznakon "za operatera održavanje"

title: DISPONENT (DISPEČER) M/Ž
description:
Tražimo disponenta za organizaciju međunarodnog cestovnog prijevoza. Radno mjesto je u uredu i nije predviđena mogućnost rada od kuće / remote rada. Disponent je odgovoran za svakodnevnu organizaciju i praćenje rada kamiona – od pronalaska utovara i dogovaranja prijevoza do praćenja isporuke. Opis posla
  • pronalazak utovara i prijevoznih naloga putem platforme TIMOCOM
  • komunikacija i dogovaranje prijevoza s klijentima i poslovnim partnerima
  • organizacija i planiranje ruta
  • svakodnevna komunikacija s vozačima
  • komunikacija s utovarnim i istovarnim mjestima
  • praćenje kamiona putem navigacijskog sustava
  • praćenje termina utovara i istovara
  • rješavanje svakodnevnih situacija i problema tijekom prijevoza
  • kontrola i praćenje transportne dokumentacije Što očekujemo? Prednost imaju kandidati s prethodnim iskustvom u disponiranju, logistici, transportu ili špediciji. Obavezno je:
  • aktivno znanje engleskog jezika
  • dobro poznavanje rada na računalu
  • dobro snalaženje s digitalnim alatima, programima i tehnologijom
  • organiziranost, odgovornost i komunikativnost
  • sposobnost brzog reagiranja i rješavanja problema
  • Znanje talijanskog jezika je prednost. Što nudimo?
  • mogućnost dugoročnog zaposlenja
  • stjecanje konkretnog praktičnog iskustva u međunarodnom cestovnom transportu
  • učenje organizacije prijevoza, rada s burzama tereta, planiranja ruta i svakodnevne koordinacije vozila
  • upoznavanje s cjelokupnim procesom transporta – od pronalaska naloga do završetka isporuke
  • mogućnost da s vremenom samostalno organizirate i vodite dodijeljena vozila Ako imate iskustva u logistici ili transportu i odgovara vam dinamičan uredski posao, veselimo se vašoj prijavi.

title: VODITELJ/VODITELJICA ODRŽAVANJA
description:
Opis poslova:
  • Planiranje i organiziranje održavanja: izrada plana godišnjeg preventivnog održavanje, definira godišnje ciljeve i aktivnosti koji su uključeni u pripremu strategije tvrtke, sudjeluje u pripremi pokazatelja vrijednosti za ciljeve, sudjeluje u pripremi programa upravljanja okolišem koji su uključeni u planiranje i organiziranje investicijskih projekata, organiziranje provođenja redovitih mišljenja o stanju strojeva i opreme te otklanja pronađene pogreške.
  • Vodi i kontrolira provedbu investicijskih projekata i nadgleda provedbu redovitih preventivnih pregleda strojeva i uređaja, prati i daje izvješća o zastojima u radu i poteškoćama, kontrolira otklanjanje kvarova, potvrđuje interne naloge za održavanje, upravlja troškovima održavanja za postizanje ciljeva i maksimiziranje dobiti, priprema sve potrebne izvještaje.
  • Planira i izrađuje ciljeve za podređene zaposlenike, sudjeluje u izradi plana obrazovanja i osposobljavanja i osposobljavanja na radnom mjestu, utvrđuje učinkovitost obrazovanja i osposobljavanja, ocjenjuje rad i izvedbu podređenih zaposlenika, predlaže nagrade i promocije, organizira vođenje evidencije prisutnosti i odsutnosti s rada svojih podređenih, potiče zaposlenike na davanje korisnih prijedloga, organizira mentorstvo, potiče zaposlenike da prijavljuju eventualne opasnosti od nezgode i ozljede na radu.
  • Komunicira interno, te prema vani, voditelj je u procesu rada prema podređenim zaposlenicima i dobavljačima.
  • Sudjelovanje u procesu racionalizacije potrošnje energije.
  • Sudjelovanje u projektnim timovima, praćenje provedbe, kontrola projektne dokumentacije.
  • Poznavanje propisa i promjena u zakonodavstvu i njihovo uvođenje u provedbu postavljenih zadaća.
  • Za vrijeme svoje odsutnosti, iz bilo kojeg razloga, dužan je osigurati da se rad obavlja bez problema i osigurati zamjenu.
  • Obavlja i druge poslove po nalogu rukovoditelja.
  • Odgovornost za realizaciju planova održavanja u pogonu.
  • Odgovornost za funkcioniranje elektro i strojnog održavanja.
  • Odgovornost za rad u skladu sa Zakonom o radu, Zakonom o očuvanju okoliša i zahtjevima sustava ISO standarda.
  • Odgovornost za funkcionalnu i pouzdanu raspoloživost strojeva za proizvodnju.
  • Odgovornost za racionalno i učinkovito korištenje i naručivanje rezervnih dijelova.
  • Odgovornost za remonte i planirane zastoje stroja dogovara s voditeljem pogona i svojim nadređenim.
  • Odgovornost za upotrebu osobne zaštitne opreme i za poštovanje uputa za siguran rad svih podređenih.

title: UNUTARNJI REVIZOR / UNUTARNJA REVIZORICA
description:
Gradonačelnik Grada Umaga – Umago, pročelnica Upravnog odjela za financije i proračun i pročelnica Upravnog odjela za imovinskopravne poslove na temelju članka 19. Zakona o službenicima i namještenicima u lokalnoj i područnoj (regionalnoj) samoupravi („Narodne novine“, broj 86/08., 61/11., 4/18., 112/19. i 17/25. – u nastavku teksta: ZSN), raspisuju JAVNI NATJEČAJ za prijam u službu na sljedeća radna mjesta:
  1. unutarnji revizor (1 izvršitelj - m/ž), na neodređeno vrijeme, uz obvezni probni rad u trajanju od tri mjeseca.
Posebni uvjeti za prijam u službu:
  • sveučilišni diplomski studij ili sveučilišni integrirani prijediplomski i diplomski studij ili stručni diplomski studij ekonomske ili pravne struke,
  • stručno ovlaštenje ministra financija za obavljanje poslova unutarnje revizije u javnom sektoru,
  • najmanje pet godina radnog iskustva na odgovarajućim poslovima, od čega najmanje tri godine na poslovima unutarnje revizije ili revizije,
  • položen državni ispit za II. razinu.
Posebni uvjet za prijam u službu za gore navedena radna mjesta je i poznavanje rada na računalu. Kandidati moraju ispunjavati i opće uvjete za prijam u službu, propisane u članku 12. ZSN-a (punoljetnost, hrvatsko državljanstvo i zdravstvenu sposobnost za obavljanje poslova radnog mjesta na koje se osoba prima). Za prijam u službu osobe koja je strani državljanin ili osobe bez državljanstva, pored ispunjavanja uvjeta propisanih posebnim zakonom, potrebno je prethodno odobrenje tijela državne uprave nadležnog za službeničke odnose. Za dokumentaciju na stranom jeziku potrebno je dostaviti ovjereni prijevod. Radnim iskustvom na odgovarajućim poslovima razumijeva se radno iskustvo (služba u upravnim tijelima jedinica lokalne ili područne /regionalne/ samouprave, državna služba, javna služba, radni odnos kod privatnog poslodavca, samostalno obavljanje profesionalne djelatnosti u skladu s posebnim propisima ili obavljanje poslova u međunarodnim organizacijama) ostvareno na poslovima odgovarajuće razine obrazovanja i struke, sukladno članku 13. ZSN-a. Natjecati se mogu i kandidati koji nemaju položen državni ispit propisane razine, uz obvezu da ga, ako zadovolje na probnom radu, polože u roku godine dana od dana početka rada u službi utvrđenog rješenjem o rasporedu na radno mjesto. Kandidati koji nemaju certifikat, uvjerenje, svjedodžbu ili drugu odgovarajuću potvrdu o poznavanju rada na računalu, a ispunjavaju ostale natječajne uvjete, mogu biti primljeni u službu i raspoređeni na radno mjesto pod uvjetom da u roku određenom Pravilnikom o unutarnjem redu gradske uprave („Službene novine Grada Umaga – Umago“, broj 9/23., 13/23., 22/23., 5/24., 7/24., 11/24., 16/24., 17/24., 1/25., 7/25. i 7/26. – u nastavku teksta: Pravilnik) steknu odgovarajući certifikat, uvjerenje, svjedodžbu ili drugu odgovarajuću potvrdu. U službu ne može biti primljena osoba za čiji prijam postoje zapreke iz članka 15. i 16. ZSN-a. Kandidat koji ima pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju prema posebnom zakonu dužan je u prijavi na natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i priložiti odgovarajuće isprave kao dokaz o statusu te druge dokaze sukladno posebnom zakonu kojim je uređeno to pravo, a ima prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate samo pod jednakim uvjetima. Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 101. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji („Narodne novine“, broj 121/17., 98/19., 84/21. i 156/23.), člankom 47. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata („Narodne novine“, broj 84/21. i 13/26), člankom 48.f Zakona o zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata („Narodne novine“, broj 33/92., 57/92., 77/92., 27/93., 58/93., 2/94., 76/94., 108/95., 108/96., 82/01., 103/03., 148/13. i 98/19.), člankom 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom („Narodne novine“, broj 157/13., 152/14., 39/18. i 32/20.) i člankom 22. Ustavnog zakona o pravima nacionalnih manjina („Narodne novine“, broj 155/02., 47/10., 80/10. i 93/11.) dužan se u prijavi na natječaj pozvati na to pravo te ima prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate samo pod jednakim uvjetima. Prilikom pozivanja na pravo prednosti kod prijma u službu prema posebnom zakonu, kada pravo prednosti ovisi o načinu prestanka radnog odnosa kod posljednjeg poslodavca (primjerice: da radni odnos nije prestao krivnjom radnika ili sporazumnim raskidom), potrebno je dostaviti preslik dokaza o načinu prestanka prethodnog radnog odnosa. Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 101. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji i člankom 47. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata, uz prijavu na natječaj dužan je, osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, priložiti i sve potrebne dokaze dostupne na poveznicama Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages//dokumenti/Nikola//popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20ZOHBDR%202021.pdf odnosno https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/dokumenti/Nikola/popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti prilikom zapošljavanja u skladu s člankom 48.f Zakona o zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata uz prijavu na natječaj dužan je, osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, priložiti i rješenje o priznatom statusu odnosno potvrdu o priznatom statusu iz koje je vidljivo navedeno pravo. Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom uz prijavu na natječaj dužan je, osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, priložiti i dokaz o utvrđenom statusu osobe s invaliditetom. Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 22. Ustavnog zakona o pravima nacionalnih manjina uz prijavu na natječaj, osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, nije dužan dokazivati svoj status pripadnika nacionalne manjine. Prijavi na natječaj potrebno je priložiti:
  • životopis
  • dokaz o hrvatskom državljanstvu (presliku važeće osobne iskaznice, važeće putovnice, domovnice ili vojne iskaznice),
  • presliku diplome kojom se potvrđuje ispunjavanje uvjeta razine obrazovanja (stručne spreme) i struke određene ovim natječajem
  • elektronički zapis (u slučaju da je osiguranik podnio zahtjev u elektroničkom obliku preko korisničkih stranica Hrvatskoga zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje), odnosno potvrdu o podacima evidentiranim u matičnoj evidenciji Hrvatskoga zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje koju Zavod na osobno traženje osiguranika izdaje na šalterima područnih službi/ureda Hrvatskoga zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje (ne starije od trideset dana, računajući od dana objave natječaja u Narodnim novinama),
  • običnu presliku dokaza o radnom iskustvu na odgovarajućim poslovima za cijeli period koji je kao uvjet naveden u javnom natječaju (rješenje o rasporedu, ugovor o radu ili uvjerenje poslodavca o radnom iskustvu na odgovarajućim poslovima koje mora sadržavati: vrstu poslova koju je obavljao, koja struka i stupanj stručne spreme je zahtijevan za njih i vremensko razdoblje u kojem je kandidat obavljao navedene poslove), za radna mjesta pod rednim brojem 1, 2 i 3,
  • ako je u elektroničkom zapisu ili potvrdi o podacima evidentiranim u bazi podataka Hrvatskoga zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje (stvarna/potrebna stručna sprema / vrsta i razina obrazovanja) evidentiran radni staž, potrebno je priložiti dokaz da je osoba bez radnog iskustva ili s radnim iskustvom kraćim od 12 mjeseci na odgovarajućim poslovima u traženom zvanju i struci, koji mora sadržavati podatke o vrsti poslova koje je osoba obavljala, s kojim zvanjem i strukom te u kojem razdoblju (rješenje, ugovor o radu, potvrda poslodavca ili druga isprava kojom to dokazuje), za radno mjesto pod rednim brojem 4,
  • presliku dokaza o položenom državnom ispitu propisane razine (ako kandidat ima položen državni ispit propisane razine),
  • presliku stručnog ovlaštenja ministra financija za obavljanje poslova unutarnje revizije u javnom sektoru (za radno mjesto unutarnji revizor),
  • presliku dokaza o poznavanju rada na računalu (certifikat o poznavanju rada na računalu koji se priznaje u zemljama Europske unije ili uvjerenje o osposobljenosti za Računalnog operatera poslovne primjene računala ili svjedodžbu odgovarajućeg razreda srednje škole ili iskaz ocjena sveučilišnog ili stručnog studija (visokoškolske ustanove) iz koje je vidljivo da je uspješno položen predmet informatike ili drugu odgovarajuću potvrdu ovlaštenog organizatora tečaja informatike iz koje je vidljivo da je uspješno završen tečaj informatike u čijem su nastavnom sadržaju obuhvaćene osnove rada na računalu i operacijski sustav Windows, Microsoft Word, Microsoft Excel, Microsoft Outlook-elektronička pošta i rad na internetu,
  • vlastoručno potpisanu izjavu kandidata da kod njega ne postoje zapreke za prijam u službu iz članka 15. i članka 16. ZSN-a (izjavu nije potrebno ovjeravati).
Ako kandidat uz prijavu priloži isprave u kojima osobni podaci nisu istovjetni, dužan je dostaviti i dokaz o njihovoj promjeni (vjenčani list, rodni list i sl.). U prijavi na natječaj navode se osobni podaci podnositelja prijave (ime i prezime, adresa stanovanja, broj telefona, odnosno mobitela, po mogućnosti mail-adresa) i naziv radnog mjesta na koje se osoba prijavljuje. Prijavu je potrebno vlastoručno potpisati. Kandidati koji se istovremeno prijavljuju na više radnih mjesta dužni su za svako pojedino radno mjesto podnijeti posebnu prijavu sa svim traženim prilozima. Dopunu prijavi moguće je podnijeti zaključno do dana isteka natječajnog roka. Za ocjenu ispunjavaju li podnositelji prijave uvjete naznačene u natječaju, mjerodavan je posljednji dan roka za podnošenje prijava na natječaj (osim za prijam vježbenika, obzirom da kandidati ne smiju imati 12 ili više mjeseci radnog iskustva na odgovarajućim poslovima, stoga taj uvjet ispunjava podnositelj prijave koji potrebno radno iskustvo nije imao barem prvog dana roka za podnošenje prijava na javni natječaj za prijam u službu vježbenika). Prije donošenja rješenja o prijmu u službu izabrani kandidat pozvat će se da u primjerenom roku dostavi uvjerenje nadležnog suda da se protiv njega ne vodi kazneni postupak i uvjerenje o zdravstvenoj sposobnosti za obavljanje poslova radnog mjesta na koje se prima te dostavi na uvid izvornike dokaza o ispunjavanju formalnih uvjeta iz javnog natječaja, čije su preslike priložene uz prijavu na javni natječaj. Nedostavljanje traženih isprava smatrat će se odustankom od prijma u službu. Troškove izdavanja uvjerenja o zdravstvenoj sposobnosti snosi Grad (osim u slučaju odustanka kandidata od prijma u službu). Nakon izbora kandidata, a prije donošenja rješenja o prijmu u službu, provjerit će po službenoj dužnosti postoji li zapreka za prijam u službu zbog pravomoćne osuđivanosti izabranog kandidata za kazneno djelo iz članka 15. ZSN-a te zapreke iz članka 16. ZSNa. Uredna prijava je ona prijava koja sadrži sve podatke i priloge navedene u natječaju, u obliku navedenom u natječaju. Osoba koja nije podnijela pravodobnu i urednu prijavu ili ne ispunjava formalne uvjete iz natječaja, ne smatra se kandidatom prijavljenim na natječaj i njena prijava neće biti razmatrana, te će joj o tome biti dostavljena pisana obavijest. Osoba nema pravo podnošenja pravnog lijeka protiv te obavijesti. Osoba koja je podnijela nepotpunu prijavu, neće biti pozvana na dopunu prijave. Za kandidate prijavljene na javni natječaj, koji ispunjavaju formalne uvjete iz natječaja, bit će provedena prethodna provjera znanja i sposobnosti putem pisanog testiranja i intervjua. Ako kandidat ne pristupi prethodnoj provjeri znanja i sposobnosti, smatra se da je povukao prijavu na natječaj. Prijave s dokazima o ispunjavanju uvjeta natječaja podnose se u zatvorenim omotnicama na adresu: Grad Umag – Umago, Povjerenstvo za provedbu natječaja, Trg slobode 7, 52470 Umag, u roku od 15 dana od dana objave natječaja u „Narodnim novinama“, s obveznom naznakom „ZA NATJEČAJ ZA PRIJAM (upisati naziv radnog mjesta na koji se kandidat prijavljuje) – NE OTVARAJ“. Prijave se mogu neposredno predati i u pisarnicu Grada Umaga – Umago, Trg slobode 7 (prizemlje). Rješenje o prijmu u službu izabranog kandidata dostavlja se javnom objavom na mrežnoj stranici Grada Umaga – Umago (www.umag.hr) najkasnije 60 dana od isteka roka za podnošenje prijava na javni natječaj, a dostava se smatra obavljenom istekom osmoga dana od dana javne objave navedenog rješenja. Opis poslova i podaci o plaći radnog mjesta koje se popunjava ovim natječajem, način obavljanja prethodne provjere znanja i sposobnosti kandidata, područje provjere te pravni i drugi izvori za pripremanje kandidata za provjeru navedeni su na mrežnoj stranici Grada Umaga –Umago www.umag.hr (lokacija „Zapošljavanje“). III. PROVJERA ZNANJA I SPOSOBNOSTI KANDIDATA Za kandidate prijavljene na natječaj, koji ispunjavaju formalne uvjete, provest će se prethodna provjera znanja i sposobnosti, sukladno članku 22. ZSN-a. Prethodna provjera znanja i sposobnosti kandidata obavlja se putem pisanog testiranja i intervjua. Smatra se da je kandidat, koji nije pristupio prethodnoj provjeri znanja, povukao prijavu na javni natječaj. Pravila provjere znanja i sposobnosti Po dolasku na provjeru znanja, od kandidata će biti zatraženo predočenje odgovarajuće identifikacijske isprave radi utvrđivanja identiteta. Po utvrđivanju identiteta i svojstva kandidata, kandidatima će biti podijeljena pitanja. Za svaki dio provjere znanja kandidatima se dodjeljuju bodovi od 1 do 10. Intervju se provodi samo s kandidatima koji su ostvarili najmanje 50% bodova na pisanom testiranju. Smatra se da je kandidat zadovoljio ako je na intervjuu ostvario najmanje 5 bodova. Za vrijeme provjere znanja i sposobnosti nije dopušteno: - koristiti se bilo kakvom literaturom odnosno bilješkama, - koristiti mobitel ili druga komunikacijska sredstva, - napuštati prostoriju u kojoj se provjera odvija, - razgovarati s ostalim kandidatima niti na bilo koji način remetiti koncentraciju kandidata. Ukoliko pojedini kandidat prekrši naprijed navedena pravila bit će udaljen s provjere znanja, a njegov rezultat Povjerenstvo neće priznati niti ocjenjivati. U Listi kandidata koja će biti objavljena zajedno s vremenom održavanja prethodne provjere znanja i sposobnosti, biti će navedeni inicijali kandidata, s godinom rođenja i mjestom prebivališta.
