title: Er du vores nye kollega i dagtid
description:
Vi er et bosted Holstedgaard, beliggende i Næstved og rummer 69 beboere med forskellige diagnoser inden for det psykiatriske område. I tillæg til dette har mange af vores beboere også kompliceret somatiske lidelser. Alle vores beboere har det til fælles, at de ikke er udadreagerende.

Vores beboere er fordelt på flere teams. Det er i et af disse teams, du vil skulle arbejde sammen med en personalegruppe, af tværfaglige stærke mennesker. Dine fremtidige kollegaer kan og vil rigtig meget og vi værdsætter og værner om, at vores teams skal arbejde på at være selvkørende

Dine vigtigste opgaver hos os vil være: 

  • Grundlæggende sygepleje hos beboerne

  • Medicin administration og injektioner

  • Sundhedsfaglig og socialpædagogisk dokumentation

  • Indgå i tværfagligt teamsamarbejde og arbejde med afsæt i Holstedgaards socialpædagogiske metoder

Dine kompetencer: 

  • Uddannet og autoriseret social og sundhedsassistent.

  • Drives af at arbejde med mennesker, med forskellige behov og udfordringer.

  • Har overblik og kan handle selvstændigt 

  • Har lysten til at udvikle dig og ser fælles succes som målet

  • Ønsker at modtage elever og evt. ønsker at tage en efteruddannelse som vejleder, hvis du ikke allerede har det. 

  • Du må gerne have arbejdet med, eller have kendskab til principperne i Low Arousal, Recovery og KRAP-modellen, men det er ikke et krav, da du vil få kendskab til dem hos os.

Det får du hos os:

  • En skøn samling af beboere, som altid byder på gode udfordringer og godt samvær. 

  • En personalekultur præget af en uformel omgangstone, faglig og personlig udvikling, nysgerrighed, fleksibilitet, åbenhed, klar kommunikation, engagement, samt humor og glæde

  • Regelmæssig ekstern supervision

  • Intern opkvalificering, gennem intern og ekstern undervisning

  • Sundhedsforsikring.

  • Adgang til motionsrum

  • Pædagogiske måltider, så maden er inkluderet som en del af arbejdet

  • Personale arrangementer og rigtige julegaver, ingen honninghjerter hos os!!  

Som udgangspunkt er stillingen med arbejdstider i dagstid, hver 2. weekender og helligdage. Vi har en forventning om at du arbejder hos os mellem 25 og 37 timer. Alt dette drøftes nærmer ved en evt. samtale.

Straffeattest: Stillingen er omfattet af loven om pligt til at indhente straffeattest. Ansættelsen kan først påbegyndes, når attesten er indhentet

Kørekort: ikke et must, men en fordel.

Er denne stilling noget for dig, vil vi glæde os til at modtage din ansøgning.

Vi afholder ansættelsessamtaler løbende. Bemærk: Vi sender ikke bekræftelse for modtagne ansøgninger.

Hvis du ikke har hørt fra os inden annoncens udløb, er stillingen besat til en anden ansøger.

Dine oplysninger bliver gemt i 60 dage, hvorefter de destrueres.

title: Rustfri Smed
description:
Rustfri smed

 

Er du erfaren indenfor rustfri svejsning ? Du behøver ikke nødvendigvis at være udlært smed – det vigtigste er, at du har praktisk erfaring og kan levere et godt stykke håndværk, og er en kompetent og alsidig håndværker, som har fokus på kvalitet. Vil du gerne indgå som et ansvarligt medlem af et team i en professionelt ledet virksomhed? Så er du måske én af vores nye medarbejdere.

 

Dine opgaver vil blandt andet bestå af:

  • Svejsning og bearbejdning af emner i rustfrit stål

  • Arbejde ud fra tegninger og arbejdsbeskrivelser

  • Kontrol af kvaliteten på de færdige emner

  • Samarbejde med kolleger om at få opgaverne sikkert og effektivt gennem produktionen

Har du også erfaring med aluminium, er det en fordel – men det er ikke et krav.

 

IQ Metal er i vækst, og for at møde vores kunders forventninger om leveringsfleksibilitet og -sikkerhed, har vi besluttet at øge antallet af medarbejdere og investere i en række nye maskiner. Du vil blive en del af et team med mere end 450 medarbejdere i IQ Metal, som samarbejder med store kunder i hele Europa. Vi leverer typisk samlede løsninger af produkter og fokuserer på at give kunderne den bedste oplevelse ved at sikre komplet levering til tiden, i rette kvalitet.

Kan du se dig selv i virksomheden?

Du indgår som en fast del af et godt team med 10-15 mand, som selv planlægger hverdagen og skaber overblik over ordreplanen. Vores maskinpark sikrer, at alt kører som det skal. En del af vores maskiner er fuldautomatiske, mens andre er semi-automatiske. Vi inviterer gerne på en kop kaffe og tur rundt i produktionen, hvis du er interesseret i et job hos os.

Vi tilbyder:

Løn og ansættelsesforhold er gode og konkurrencedygtige, og indeholder udover pension også en sundhedssikring. Alle fastansatte på nathold tilbydes årligt sundhedstjek. Der er kaffe og vand tilgængeligt i kantinen, og vi har en god stemning på virksomheden, som er professionelt ledet.

Kan du se dig selv i jobbet?

Vi tilbyder selvstændigt arbejde i moderne faciliteter. Det er et krav, at du er en erfaren smed, som har arbejdet inden for faget inden for de sidste par år. Du skal have tegningsforståelse, samt selv kunne udvikle og fremstille fiksturer og værktøjer til at sikre optimal håndtering af emner.

Vi forventer at du er en god kollega, som hjælper til når det er krævet af hensyn til teamet og opfyldelse af kunders forventninger. Du har humor og smil på læben i hverdagen, også når der er travlt. Bopæl nær Hasselager/Århus vil være en fordel, men ikke nødvendigvis et krav.

Interesseret?

Læs mere om virksomheden hjemmesiden www.iqmetal.com eller kontakt vores produktionsleder Lars Holm på telefon 8738 9036 for en uforpligtende og fuldt fortrolig snak. Ansøg ved at sende dit CV eller skriv lidt om din erfaring på: lh@iqmetal.com.

title: Sygeplejerske søges til Holstebro-Alstrup Friplejehjem
description:
Sygeplejerske søges til Holstebro-Alstrup Friplejehjem

30–32 timer om ugen · Opstart 1. november 2026 · Ingen weekendarbejde

Har du lyst til at gøre en forskel for vores beboere og samtidig være med til at styrke den sygeplejefaglige kvalitet? Så har vi måske jobbet til dig.

På Holstebro-Alstrup Friplejehjem søger vi en engageret og fagligt stærk sygeplejerske til 30–32 timer om ugen med opstart 1. november 2026.

Stillingen er en opnormering af vores sygeplejefaglige indsats, og du bliver vores anden sygeplejerske. Du kommer til at arbejde tæt sammen med vores nuværende sygeplejerske, ledelsen og det øvrige personale.

En hverdag tæt på beboerne

Hos os er sygeplejersken en aktiv del af hverdagen. Vi tror på, at den bedste sygepleje opstår, når faglighed og nærvær går hånd i hånd. Derfor skal du have lyst til både at varetage sygeplejefaglige opgaver og tage del i den daglige pleje.

Dine opgaver vil blandt andet være:

  • Sygepleje, kliniske vurderinger og opfølgning på beboernes helbredstilstand

  • Observation, tidlig opsporing og forebyggelse

  • Medicinhåndtering og opfølgning

  • Dokumentation og kvalitetssikring

  • Koordinering med læger, hospital og øvrige samarbejdspartnere

  • Vejledning og faglig sparring med social- og sundhedsfagligt personale

  • Medvirken til at udvikle og fastholde vores faglige standarder

Den nye Ældrelov sætter fokus på selvbestemmelse, livsglæde, helhedspleje og tillid til fagligheden. Hos os skal du være med til at omsætte værdierne til praksis ved at se hele mennesket, tage udgangspunkt i beboerens ønsker og ressourcer og arbejde forebyggende og rehabiliterende.

Vi ser Ældreloven som en mulighed for at styrke det, vi allerede tror på: faglighed, nærvær og det gode hverdagsliv.

Vi tilbyder dig

  • 30–32 timer om ugen og ingen weekendarbejde

  • Opstart 1. november 2026 eller efter aftale

  • En ny opnormeret sygeplejerskefunktion med mulighed for at sætte dit præg

  • Tæt fagligt samarbejde med vores nuværende sygeplejerske

  • Mulighed for indflydelse på arbejdsgange og faglig udvikling

  • En hverdag med tæt kontakt til beboere, pårørende, frivillige og kolleger

  • Et godt tværfagligt samarbejde og mulighed for faglig udvikling

Vi søger dig, der

  • Er uddannet sygeplejerske og har lyst til at arbejde med ældre mennesker

  • Har et godt klinisk blik og kan bevare overblikket

  • Trives med både selvstændigt ansvar og teamsamarbejde

  • Er engageret, omsorgsfuld og fagligt nysgerrig

  • Har lyst til at være en aktiv del af plejen

  • Arbejder helhedsorienteret med udgangspunkt i den enkelte beboer

  • Har lyst til at bidrage til et godt arbejdsmiljø og en positiv kultur

  • Kan se mulighederne i den nye Ældrelov og omsætte den til praksis

Har du lyst til at være en del af teamet så send en ansøgning, vi tager ind til samtale løbende.

Ansøgningsfrist: 23 september kl 8
Tiltrædelse: 1. november 2026 eller efter aftale.

Har du spørgsmål, er du meget velkommen til at kontakte plejehjemsleder Karina Laursen på 2195 4644 eller knl@holstebro-alstrup.dk.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig – måske er det netop dig, der skal være vores nye kollega.

title: Lagermedarbejder - Videbæk

description:
Danmark Protein i Nr. Vium og HI Park i Herning søger en kvalitetsbevidst lagermedarbejder. Vi er 730 medarbejdere i en topmoderne og højteknologisk virksomhed, der producerer valle proteinpulver og mælkesukker til en bred vifte af levnedsmidler. Vi er en del af Arla Foods Ingrediens, der er en uafhængig virksomhed i Arla Foods med ambitioner om at blive verdens førende leverandør af vallebaserede ingredienser til fødevareindustrien.

Har du styr på logistik og lager? Så bliv en del af Danmark Protein, hvor sikkerhed, medarbejdertrivsel og kvalitet ligger øverst på prioriteringslisten. Her får du mulighed for at bruge din faglighed inden for logistik og lager i et uformelt og stemningsfyldt arbejdsmiljø. 
 

Du bliver en del af et team på 39 kolleger, heraf 12 i HI Park i Herning. Vi møder hinanden med respekt og åbenhed, hvor alle bidrager til en hjælpsom tone og god stemning.

 

  • Det er dig, der har det store overblik

  • Du arbejder i SAP og finder pallerne til ordrerne – alt er lokationsstyret.

  • Du finder løsninger og er proaktiv når nye udfordringer opstår.

  • Du har en indstilling til at hjælpe og sikre godt arbejdsklima.

Som person er du hjælpsom og glad for at give en hånd med, hvor der er behov for det. Du går til arbejdet med seriøsitet og påtager dig gerne ansvar for opgaverne i afdelingen.

title: Assistant Professor in Operations and Supply Chain Digitalisation
description:
The Center for Supply Chain Digitalisation (CSD), at the Department of Technology and Innovation, University of Southern Denmark (SDU) invites applications for an Assistant Professor in Operations and Supply Chain Digitalization with special focus on simulation and/or artificial intelligence applied to operations and supply chains.

The targeted start date is February 2027.

The successful candidate will be responsible for collaboratively building up the area of operations and supply chain digitalisation with a primary focus on quantitative methods such as discrete-event and agent-based simulation, process automation, data science, and machine learning.

Successful candidates will drive internationally recognized and competitive research, work closely with industry, and are expected to attract external research funding. The position has a strong focus on experimental and applied research in production systems and supply chain fields. The candidate will play a key role in providing outstanding education, supervising bachelor's and master’s students, and developing junior research staff.

SDU CSD is a highly international group of faculty members, embedded in a region with a strong network of companies, including some of Denmark's largest global industrial players (i.e. Danfoss, Linak, Siemens) and many manufacturing SMEs. Projects currently run by the group cover a range of topics within the field of operations and supply chain digitalization.

The successful candidate must have a background in engineering. PhD degree preferably in industrial engineering, supply chain, operations management, operations research, or the like.

The application deadline is October 15, 2026, at 11.59 PM/23.59 (CET/CEST) 

 

We expect

A highly motivated, collaborative person, who can work in an international, interdisciplinary team, with documented research skills in the field of operations and supply chain. The candidate needs to be a team player and, at the same time, be able to work independently. The successful candidate is active in publishing in engineering journals.

The ideal candidate can connect research with practical technology application and has demonstrated skills and competencies in one or more of the following areas:

  • Discrete-event and/or agent-based simulation

  • Artificial intelligence, machine/deep learning applied to operations and supply chain (AI-applications in other fields are not relevant for this position) 

  • Agentic AI applied to operations and supply chain

  • Business and intelligent process automation

Further information is available from Associate Professor Elias Ribeiro da Silva elias@iti.sdu.dk.

 

We offer

  • A professional workplace culture that values equality, mutual respect, and is designed to accommodate and encourage work-life balance

  • A vibrant social environment with structured activities and informal routines that promote cross-disciplinary interaction and cultivate an inclusive, supportive atmosphere.

  • An engaging, dynamic, and international interdisciplinary environment with extensive collaboration opportunities across national, international, and industrial partners

  • Opportunities for continued professional development and education for all staff members.

  • Access to a well-developed research infrastructure

  • A strong institutional commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion in all aspects of the workplace

 

About the workplace

The position is within the SDU Center for Supply Chain Digitalisation (CSD) at the Faculty of Engineering on the international campus Sønderborg. The center conducts research at the intersection of supply chain management, data science, and digital technologies. Our work applies quantitative, data-driven methods to analyse, design, and optimise complex supply chains.

In close collaboration with industry partners, the center focuses on the full data journey across the supply chain, developing tools and methods based on advanced analytics, simulation, and artificial intelligence to enable stronger coordination, end-to-end transparency, and more sustainable and efficient supply chain operations.

SDU CSD is situated in a region with a robust network of companies, including some of Denmark’s largest global industrial players as well as numerous SMEs. The group’s current projects mainly focus on building quantitative models and methods to support better decisions or on turning data-driven optimisation, simulation, and digital tools into practical use in operations. 

The SDU CSD is a highly international and interdisciplinary group of faculty members, with international students. The campus is in Sønderborg, an attractive coastal town with an open Scandinavian culture, and affordable housing and living costs.

 

Special benefits when working in Denmark

  • The average weekly working hours are 37 hours per week

  • 30 days of paid holiday per year

  • The yearly salary for a full-time assistant professor is between DKK 502.905 and DKK 566.647 depending on the years of working experience. Postdoc experience may place you on a higher salary step. The salary includes a base salary, a position-related supplement and pension (18.07 %). Additional supplement(s) for special qualifications can be negotiated. Authorisation supplement(s) will be granted, if relevant for the position. Your local eligible trade union representative at SDU negotiates your salary on your behalf.

  • Subsidized preschool childcare and a free education system from primary school up to university level

  • Universal health insurance as a resident of Denmark, including family members officially residing in Denmark

  • In relation to childbirth, employees are entitled to a combined total of 52 weeks of parental leave, shared between parents, with full or partial salary depending on circumstances.

  • Researchers recruited from abroad are offered a special researcher tax scheme with a lower tax rate. 

  • Travel and moving expenses may be partially covered.

 

Living in Denmark

The International Staff Office (ISO) at SDU provides a variety of services for new employees, guests and people who consider applying for a job at the University of Southern Denmark. Among other things, the staff answers questions concerning salary, taxation, housing and accompanying family.

We recommend that international applicants also take the time to visit Work in Denmark.

The University of Southern Denmark wishes to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position.

 

Application and assessment

Applications will be assessed by an expert committee. When the expert committee issues its assessment, applicants will receive the portion of the assessment pertaining to them personally.

The committee assesses candidates only based on the application materials. Please include the following documents in English: 

  • Brief motivation letter

  • Curriculum vitae

  • Full list of publications

  • Copies of the three publications on which the applicant wishes to be evaluated. Please attach one pdf-file for each publication

  • Diplomas/Certificates (Master and PhD degree)

  • Summary and documentation of teaching experience. You may attach a Teaching Portfolio.

  • Documentation of other qualifications relevant to the position

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

 

The application deadline is October 15, 2026, at 11.59 PM/23.59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Shortlisting may be used in the assessment process. Read about shortlisting at SDU.  An interview may be included as part of the overall evaluation of the applicant’s qualifications. If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support. Applicants are advised to read the SDU information on how to apply and specific faculty information for application at the Faculty of Engineering.

 

Employment terms

Appointment as an assistant professor is temporary and for an initial 3-year period. The preferred start date is from February 2027.

During employment, the assistant professor will complete the Lecturer Training Programme. 

Employment as an assistant professor requires academic qualifications at a minimum of PhD level at the time of employment. Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for assistant professor as described therein. 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

 

SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s).

Further information about The Faculty of Engineering.

title: Social og Sundhedshjælpere søges til Hårby Friplejehjem - De syv dale
description:
Har du passion, er med til at skabe trivsel og lokalt engagement og har du et godt humør så er det dig vi mangler.


Er du uddannet social- og sundhedshjælper så kom og vær med i vores team.

Vi søger nye kolleger, som har lyst til at blive en del af vores team og være med til at skabe en tryg, meningsfuld og god hverdag for beboerne på Hårby Friplejehjem.

Beboerne kommer med deres egen historie, personlighed, ønsker og behov. Det er dét, vi tager udgangspunkt i hver dag, hvor vi møder dem med ligeværdighed og ligeværd.

Hos os arbejder vi med at skabe mest muligt liv i livet hele livet.
Vi arbejder personcentreret og med stor respekt for den ældres selvbestemmelse.
Vi tror på, at mennesker skal have mulighed for at være sig selv og have indflydelse på deres eget liv – også når de får brug for hjælp og støtte.
Vi nysgerrige på den enkelte beboers livshistorie, vaner, værdier og ønsker. Vi leder efter det, der giver mening for den enkelte – og vi tør tænke kreativt, når det kræver noget andet end det sædvanlige.

Du bliver en del af et stærkt fagligt fællesskab
Vi tror på, at høj faglighed og godt samarbejde går hånd i hånd.
Vi har tillid til hinanden og forventer, at du tager ansvar, bruger din faglighed og bidrager aktivt til fællesskabet.
Samtidig forventer vi, at vi hjælper hinanden og samarbejder tæt på tværs af faggrupper og vagtlag. For det er sammen, vi skaber de bedste muligheder for beboerne.
Vi lægger også stor vægt på et tæt og respektfuldt samarbejde med de pårørende og på at være en del af de lokale fællesskaber omkring vores hus.

Som kollega hos os får du mulighed for at:

  • være med til at skabe en hverdag med tryghed, nærvær og livskvalitet

  • være kontaktperson og skabe kontinuitet for beboerne

  • arbejde personcentreret med respekt for den ældres selvbestemmelse

  • bringe din faglighed i spil og udvikle dig sammen med dine kolleger

  • samarbejde tæt med kolleger på tværs af fagligheder og vagtlag

  • have et tæt samarbejde med beboernes pårørende

  • være med til at skabe aktiviteter, fællesskab og gode stunder

  • bruge både dit faglige hoved og dit varme hjerte


Vi håber, du er en kollega, der:

  • der er uddannet social- og sundhedshjælper

  • er fagligt nysgerrig og har lyst til at lære nyt

  • kan arbejde selvstændigt og samtidig værdsætter et tæt teamsamarbejde

  • tager ansvar og tør bruge din faglighed

  • møder mennesker med respekt, ro, varme og godt humør

  • har lyst til at arbejde med at skabe mest muligt liv i livet for beboerne


Hvad får du hos os?
Du får kolleger, der brænder for deres arbejde, og en arbejdsplads hvor faglighed, tillid, humor og omsorg er en naturlig del af hverdagen.
Vi tror på, at arbejdsglæde smitter – og at vi skal have det godt sammen, samtidig med at vi har et fælles ansvar for at levere høj faglig kvalitet.

Kan du mærke, at det her kunne være noget for dig?
Så vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig.

Skriv til:

Forstander Jeanette Routhe

jemar@haarbyfriplejehjem.dk

mobil: 23803137

Der afholdes løbende samtaler

title: Cleaning Supervisor
description:
Cleaning Supervisor – Full-Time Position in Copenhagen

We are looking for a responsible, well-organised and motivated Cleaning Supervisor to join our team in Copenhagen.

This is a hands-on position combining team supervision, customer communication, quality control and daily cleaning operations. We are looking for someone who enjoys working with people, takes responsibility and can effectively organise both their own work and the work of others.

Your responsibilities

  • Preparing and managing staff schedules and organising shift coverage

  • Maintaining regular contact with employees and coordinating their daily work

  • Communicating with clients and responding to their requests and needs

  • Training, onboarding and supporting new employees

  • Organising training and providing ongoing guidance to the cleaning team

  • Performing regular quality checks and ensuring that our cleaning standards are maintained

  • Ordering cleaning products, equipment and other necessary supplies

  • Cleaning at client locations when required

  • Handling day-to-day operational issues and finding practical solutions

  • Supporting and motivating employees in their daily work

  • Ensuring good communication between employees, management and clients

  • Supporting the company in acquiring and onboarding new clients

We are looking for someone who:

  • Speaks English confidently

  • Is willing and motivated to learn Danish

  • Has strong organisational and communication skills

  • Is comfortable communicating with both employees and clients

  • Is responsible, reliable and able to work independently

  • Can make decisions and solve problems in a busy working environment

  • Is flexible regarding working hours and willing to work in shifts

  • Is available to work every second weekend

  • Is willing to take part in cleaning duties when necessary

  • Living in Denmark is an advantage, but not a requirement. However, you must be willing and able to relocate to Copenhagen for the position

  • Has, or is able to obtain, the legal right to work in Denmark

  • Previous experience in cleaning, supervision, team coordination or a similar position is an advantage

What we offer

We offer a responsible and varied position in a stable and established cleaning company in Copenhagen, where you will play an important role in our daily operations and future development.

Salary: DKK 37,500 gross per month
Working hours: 38 hours per week
Schedule: Shift work, including every second weekend
Location: Copenhagen, Denmark
Employment: Full-time

The work will primarily take place at different client locations across Copenhagen, so flexibility and the ability to organise your working day are important.

We are looking for someone who is not afraid to take responsibility, enjoys working with people and is committed to maintaining high standards of cleaning and customer service.

How to apply

If you are interested in joining our team, please send your CV together with a motivation letter or a short video introducing yourself to:

info@teamclean.dk

We look forward to hearing from you!

title: CAD Engineer

title: Allmänmedicin läkare till Danmark - Vi skräddarsyr ditt nästa äventyr!
description:
Går du i tankarna på att arbeta i Danmark, antingen nu eller i framtiden? Vi söker kontinuerligt duktiga specialister i allmänmedicin för kommande och långsiktiga uppdrag över hela Danmark.

Vi vet att livet består av mer än bara jobb. Därför utgår vi alltid från dina personliga önskemål. Om du har familj, vill bo på en specifik ort eller har specifika önskemål kring ditt schema, så anpassar vi vårt sökande efter dig, inte efter en fast låst list

Vill du arbeta i ett hälso- och sjukvårdssystem som värnar om din arbetsmiljö? Här får du chansen till ett meningsfullt arbete med stor flexibilitet, rimliga patientflöden och ett starkt team av sjuksköterskor runt dig. Du kommer att få mer stöd från övrig vårdpersonal och hanterar mindre administration. Det gör att du äntligen kan fokusera på det medicinska!

Vi erbjuder ett års visstidsanställning, men ser gärna att det leder till en tillsvidareanställning.

Arbetstider och balans i livet:

Arbetet är som utgångspunkt heltid, måndag till fredag kl. 08–16, men det finns möjlighet att arbeta på minst 75 % tjänstgöringsgrad. Du arbetar alltså vardagar 08–16, med betald lunch och helt utan jour, övertid eller helgarbete. Du får en mer förutsägbar arbetsdag och betydligt bättre möjligheter att planera livet utanför arbetet.

Ekonomi och förmåner:

Som svensk specialistläkare kan du, om du uppfyller kraven, omfattas av den danska expertskatten med en fast skattesats på 32,8 %. Det innebär mer pengar kvar i plånboken och större frihet på fritiden.

Vi löser det praktiska åt dig:

Att flytta till ett annat land ska inte behöva vara krångligt. Du behöver inte börja om, du tar med dig din erfarenhet och kompetens, så hjälper vi dig genom hela processen:

    Auktorisation & myndigheter: Vi hjälper dig med det administrativa inför din start i Danmark.
    Möblerat boende: Vi ordnar boende inför din ankomst och presenterar alternativ som passar din placering.
    Språk & introduktion: Du får en intensiv språkutbildning på ca 20 timmar med erfarna språklärare samt en introduktionsvecka där du kommer in i arbetssättet, systemen och den danska vården.
    Personligt stöd: Du har en personlig kontakt genom hela processen, från första samtalet tills du är etablerad.

Din erfarenhet:

    Legitimerad läkare
    Specialist i allmänmedicin
    Kunna prata och skriva på flytande svenska
    Meriterande att kunna förstå och prata danska

Låter det intressant för dig? Ansök genom att skicka ditt CV till mig Felix på felix.hellstrom@vbsverige.se eller göra en intresseanmälan på vår hemsida (https://vbsverige.se/lakare-i-danmark/).

Vi ser fram emot att starta en dialog med dig!

OM OSS

Vårdbemanning Sverige startade sin verksamhet 2014 och är idag ett av Sveriges största bemanningsföretag inom hälso- och sjukvård. Sedan 2019 har vi utsetts till ett av landets Gasellföretag av Dagens Industri, och utmärker oss som ett av landets snabbast växande företag. Vi erbjuder bemannings- och rekryteringslösningar till Sveriges regioner, privata vårdgivare och kommuner.

Så fungerar det

Det första steget till att arbeta via oss i Danmark är att vi startar en profil på dig i vårt verksamhetssystem. Vi börjar processen med ett initialt telefonsamtal där vi får veta mer om dig, din bakgrund och dina erfarenheter, samtidigt som du får svar på alla dina frågor om oss och om hur allt fungerar. För att kunna starta din profil och gå vidare behöver vi också få in ett antal handlingar från dig, såsom ditt CV och dina referenser.

Under våra samtal går vi även igenom vilket/vilka ställen du vill eller kan tänka dig jobba på, vilket geografiskt område som passar dig bäst samt ramarna för lönepaketen. När vi har hittat rätt matchning och samlat in alla uppgifter, sammanställer vi detta till en presentation för Nordic Medicare.

När presentationen är klar lämnar vi över till Nordic Medicare som då tar vid för den fortsatta processen. De kommer att hålla en uppföljande intervju med dig och sköta den konkreta dialogen kring själva anställningen. Det är också direkt med Nordic Medicare som du går igenom alla slutgiltiga arbetsrättsliga villkor, avtalsspecifika bestämmelser, juridik och eventuella frågor kring forskarskatteordningen. På så sätt får du en samlad, trygg och tydlig dialog om alla kontraktets detaljer direkt med din kommande arbetsgivare.

När du är ute och arbetar har du kontinuerlig dialog med din närmsta kontaktperson hos oss, som vägleder och stöttar dig genom uppdraget från början till slut. Vi sätter stort värde på att vara tillgänglig för dig. Du kan alltid nå oss på telefon eller mejl när du behöver.

Vårdbemanning Sverige startade sin verksamhet 2014 och är idag ett av Sveriges största bemanningsföretag inom hälso- och sjukvård. Sedan 2019 har vi utsetts till ett av landets Gasellföretag av Dagens Industri, och utmärker oss som ett av landets snabbast växande företag. Vi erbjuder bemannings- och rekryteringslösningar till Sveriges regioner, privata vårdgivare och kommuner.

Så fungerar det

Det första steget till att arbeta via oss i Danmark är att vi startar en profil på dig i vårt verksamhetssystem. Vi börjar processen med ett initialt telefonsamtal där vi får veta mer om dig, din bakgrund och dina erfarenheter, samtidigt som du får svar på alla dina frågor om oss och om hur allt fungerar. För att kunna starta din profil och gå vidare behöver vi också få in ett antal handlingar från dig, såsom ditt CV och dina referenser.

Under våra samtal går vi även igenom vilket/vilka ställen du vill eller kan tänka dig jobba på, vilket geografiskt område som passar dig bäst samt ramarna för lönepaketen. När vi har hittat rätt matchning och samlat in alla uppgifter, sammanställer vi detta till en presentation för Nordic Medicare.

När presentationen är klar lämnar vi över till Nordic Medicare som då tar vid för den fortsatta processen. De kommer att hålla en uppföljande intervju med dig och sköta den konkreta dialogen kring själva anställningen. Det är också direkt med Nordic Medicare som du går igenom alla slutgiltiga arbetsrättsliga villkor, avtalsspecifika bestämmelser, juridik och eventuella frågor kring forskarskatteordningen. På så sätt får du en samlad, trygg och tydlig dialog om alla kontraktets detaljer direkt med din kommande arbetsgivare.

När du är ute och arbetar har du kontinuerlig dialog med din närmsta kontaktperson hos oss, som vägleder och stöttar dig genom uppdraget från början till slut. Vi sätter stort värde på att vara tillgänglig för dig. Du kan alltid nå oss på telefon eller mejl när du behöver.

title: Workshop Mechanic - Gadbjerg, near Vejle, Denmark
description:
About us

We run a workshop about 15 km from Vejle in East Jutland, Denmark, in close partnership between GMT and Nordic Rebar ApS. You will be employed by Nordic Rebar ApS, which is based at the workshop.
GMT trades in used machinery for the rebar industry and is a well-known player in the industry across most of the world.
Together, we hold a large stock of used machines that continuously need to be inspected and refurbished, and we are therefore looking for a mechanic who will make the workshop his or her permanent base.

About the job

As a workshop mechanic, you will be responsible for keeping the workshop running and the machines in good order. Your tasks will include:

-Repair and preparation of used machines for the rebar industry
-Loading and unloading machines and accessories using a forklift truck (a valid forklift/truck licence is required)
-General maintenance and tidiness in the workshop

The workshop has an office attached to it, so you will have good colleagues around you, and we have lunch together.

The workshop has modern facilities, including a laser cleaner for removing rust and dirt, and we place great emphasis on the work being carried out safely and properly.

In the workshop itself you will typically be the only mechanic on a daily basis, so you must be able to plan and carry out your tasks independently.

We expect you to

-Have a technical/trade background, e.g. as a car or truck mechanic, industrial electrician, or mechatronics technician, with good mechanical aptitude
-Have at least 10 years of relevant work experience
-Hold a valid forklift/truck licence
-Be responsible and have a can-do attitude
-Be able to work independently and organise your own working day
-Not be afraid of getting dirty
-Understand and speak English
-Be an EU citizen

Terms of employment

This is a permanent position with Nordic Rebar ApS, on the terms and under the rules and legislation applicable in Denmark.
-Starting salary: EUR 25 per hour, paid monthly
-Weekly working hours: 37 hours - overtime may occur and can possibly be compensated with time off, among other things to allow for more frequent trips home, if needed
-Start date: as soon as possible
-Workplace: Gadbjerg, approx. 15 km from Vejle
-Accommodation (a smaller apartment/room) can be arranged locally - expected rent approx. DKK 4,000-5,000 per month max

Application

Applications should be sent by e-mail to ud@gmtaps.com.

Questions are welcome and can be directed to Ulrich Deichmann, GMT, tel. +45 20 98 94 44, or Arne Hansen, Nordic Rebar ApS, tel. +45 51 46 20 50.

title: Financial Controller
description:
Har du starka kunskaper inom redovisning och ekonomi, och motiveras du av att skapa struktur, kvalitet och insikter i finansiella processer? Trivs du i en roll där du får ansvar för rapportering, controlling och ekonomisk uppföljning? Då kan detta vara rätt möjlighet för dig.

Om rollen

Tjänsten är baserad på vårt nordiska huvudkontor i Albertslund, Danmark. Som Financial Controller får du en viktig roll i den löpande ekonomistyrningen och rapporteringen av våra verksamheter. Ditt huvudsakliga ansvarsområde blir att stötta och följa upp våra svenska och finska bolag samt säkerställa hög kvalitet i den finansiella rapporteringen och ekonomiska uppföljningen.

Du ansvarar för finansiell uppföljning, månads- och årsbokslut samt för att säkerställa noggrannhet och kvalitet i våra redovisningsdata och finansiella rapporter. Du kommer att delta aktivt i budget- och prognosprocesser, analysera ekonomiska resultat och bidra med insikter som stödjer ledningens beslutsfattande.

Du kommer även att arbeta med processförbättringar och interna kontroller för att säkerställa effektiva och robusta finansiella processer. Rollen innebär nära samarbete med både interna och externa intressenter, och du kommer att bidra till att säkerställa efterlevnad av gällande redovisningsprinciper och interna riktlinjer.

Ditt arbete kommer att vara avgörande för att skapa transparens, kvalitet och kontroll i våra finansiella processer.

Vem är du?

Vi söker dig som inte bara är erfaren, utan även har ett genuint intresse för att skapa struktur och kvalitet i ekonomiska processer. Du har en relevant utbildning inom ekonomi, redovisning eller finans samt erfarenhet från en liknande roll.

Du behärskar engelska och minst ett skandinaviskt språk och har stark analytisk förmåga. Du arbetar strukturerat och noggrant och är bekväm med att hantera stora datamängder och finansiella analyser. Erfarenhet av ERP-system och Excel är meriterande.

Som person är du proaktiv, ansvarstagande och självständig. Du trivs med att samarbeta över organisatoriska gränser, skapar förtroende genom din professionalism och har ett naturligt intresse för att förbättra processer och arbetssätt. Du tar ägarskap för dina uppgifter och levererar resultat med hög kvalitet inom överenskomna tidsramar.

Intresserad?

Vi genomför intervjuer löpande, så skicka in din ansökan och ditt CV redan idag.

Har du frågor om tjänsten är du välkommen att kontakta Heidrun Thorsteinsdottir på +45 2234 6657.

title: Senior Automation Manager, Nørresundby, Denmark
description:
Are you our new Automation Manager with a passion for technology, leadership, and scalable automation solutions?

At DESMI, you will play a key role in strengthening and scaling our automation capabilities across the organization. You will be part of product development & innovation leading a skilled engineering team in Denmark and China to develop reliable and future-proof automation solutions for both products and customized needs.
Working closely with Product Management, Projects, Production, and Service, you will ensure strong alignment between technical solutions and business requirements. You will be responsible for setting direction, creating structure across projects, and ensuring high quality delivery of automation solutions across DESMI's global operations.
DESMI is a dynamic and innovative company where collaboration, continuous learning, and professional development are at the core of our culture. In this role, you will have the opportunity to influence the direction of our automation landscape, develop your team, and contribute to building scalable and efficient solutions that support our continued growth.

Ideally, we are looking for someone who is:
Technically grounded
Possess strong leadership and people management skills
Structured and organized

A glimpse into the role
You will lead a team of automation engineers while ensuring that our solutions are robust and aligned with business needs. Your primary responsibilities will include:
-Team Leadership & Development: Lead, motivate, and develop a high-performing automation team, fostering a culture of collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement.
-Project Execution & Prioritization: Plan, structure, and drive execution across multiple automation projects, ensuring clear priorities, efficient resource allocation, and on-time delivery.
-Technical Direction & Quality Assurance: Set the technical direction for automation solutions across hardware and software, ensuring reliable, serviceable, and future-proof designs.
-Operational Ownership of Automation Solutions: Oversee the development and maintenance of automation systems, translating business and product requirements into standardized, scalable technical solutions.
-Stakeholder Management: Act as the key point of contact for stakeholders across Product Management, Projects, Production, and Service, ensuring alignment and clear communication on scope, expectations, and deliverables.
-Process & Solution Optimization: Drive structured and transparent workflows across projects, continuously improving processes and enabling efficient and consistent delivery of automation solutions.
-Innovation & Continuous Improvement: Support the ongoing development of DESMI's automation portfolio by promoting a solution-oriented mindset and identifying opportunities for innovation and standardization.

Your next opportunity starts here
We're looking for an experienced and driven leader with a strong technical foundation in automation and a passion for developing both people and solutions. You thrive in a dynamic, international environment and are motivated by creating structure, driving progress, and delivering high-quality results together with your team.

We also imagine that you:
Have minimum 5 years of leadership experience managing technical teams
Bring a strong technical background within automation, electrical engineering, or a similar field, combined with hands-on experience in both hardware and software design
Are structured and capable of creating clarity and overview in complex project environments with multiple ongoing activities
Have strong planning and resource management skills, enabling you to prioritize effectively and ensure successful project execution
Communicate clearly and proactively with stakeholders across functions and organizational levels
Take a solution-oriented approach and are comfortable setting direction while supporting your team in delivering robust and scalable solutions
Have experience working in a dynamic environment where priorities can shift, and where adaptability is key to success
Are fluent in English, as it is DESMI's corporate language

The perks of being at DESMI
Flexible working hours - including possibilities for remote work.
Global career prospects - work with colleagues across Europe, Asia, and the U.S.
Skills development and career growth - Training, job rotation, and internal mobility
Pension - attractive employer contributions
Private healthcare and life insurance
On-site canteen - light breakfast, lunch buffet, and snacks
Company sports & social activities - from badminton and bowling to art clubs and summer parties

What we're about
But we're more than just pumps. At DESMI, we believe teamwork and innovation drive success.
When you join DESMI, you can expect:
A collaborative and supportive team environment.
Opportunities for continuous learning and professional development.
A chance to contribute your ideas and make a real impact.
A company that values sustainability and innovation.

We are a flat organization with an open-door policy, where decisions are made together, and ideas are always welcome. Here, doers thrive - if you see an opportunity for improvement, you have the freedom to act on it.
As innovators in reliable and sustainable flow solutions, we serve a wide range of industries from Aquaculture and Defense to Green Technologies - the list goes on. Sustainability is highly appreciated while developing high-performance and long-lasting technologies that help industries adapt to evolving markets while reducing environmental impact.

Ready to apply?

title: Work flexibly, earn extra - Join Imercos Black Friday Team!
description:
Are you looking for a temporary job in November and December, with the opportunity to earn extra money and gain valuable work experience? Do you enjoy being physically active and working at a fast pace? Then now is the time to seize the opportunity!

We are looking for motivated and hardworking temporary workers for Imerco’s warehouse in Vallensbæk. You will help ensure that thousands of Danes receive their Christmas presents on time.

The job requires that you can work 4 shifts per week during the period from November 20 to December 12. It is essential that you are available to work on the weekends of November 28–29 and December 5–6.

Your primary task will be packing online orders for private customers. You will work at a packing station and handle a wide range of products – from Christmas decorations and kitchen equipment to electronics and gift items. The products must be securely packed in cardboard boxes so that they arrive safely at the customer.

On a typical working day, you will pack approximately 100–150 boxes, depending on the size of the orders.

We expect you to:

  • Enjoy routine-based and independent work

  • Have a good eye for detail – especially during the busy Christmas period, when accuracy is important

  • Be reliable, punctual, and able to take responsibility for your shifts

  • Be physically fit enough to stand and work actively throughout the day

  • Have good energy and a positive attitude, even when the pace is high

  • Be available for 4 shifts per week from November 20 to December 12

  • Be available to work on November 28–29 and December 5–6

Experience from warehouse work, retail, or other physically demanding jobs is an advantage, but not a requirement. The most important things are that you are hardworking and willing to put in an effort during the busiest months of the year.

We also offer an exciting temporary position in a well-established and busy retail company, where you will become part of a strong team with great team spirit. You will have the opportunity to work morning, evening, or night shifts, while earning extra money during the busy season.

We offer a total hourly wage of DKK 156.39 per hour. In addition, evening, night, and weekend supplements are provided.

Employment terms

We conduct interviews and onboard new employees on an ongoing basis, so don’t hesitate to submit your application.

title: Pædagog til Eventyrhuset - Børnehave i Dragør
description:
Brænder du for nærvær, fællesskab og faglighed?
Drømmer du om en hverdag, hvor du kan gøre en forskel - og samtidig have tid og rum til at udvikle din pædagogiske praksis? Så læs videre!

Vi søger en engageret og fagligt stærk pædagog til vores børnehave i Eventyrhuset - en privat, integreret daginstitution i smukke Dragør. Hos os får du ikke bare et arbejde, men en arbejdsplads med hjerte, højt til loftet og stor mulighed for både medbestemmelse og udvikling.

Om Eventyrhuset

Eventyrhuset består af to afdelinger med i alt ca. 110 børn - ca. 44 vuggestuebørn og ca. 66 børnehavebørn. Vores personalegruppe tæller omkring 30 dedikerede medarbejdere: pædagoger, medhjælpere, køkkenpersonale, gårdmand og administration.

Eventyrhuset har som privat institution en institutionsbestyrelse med det øverste ansvar for driften, økonomien og personalet, samt en engageret forældrebestyrelse som sikrer forældrenes stemme i beslutningsprocesserne og står for de sociale aktiviteter som sommerfest, julefest mm.

Børnehaven - hvor tryghed, leg og læring går hånd i hånd

I vores børnehave er der tre grupper med, hver med en normering på 22 børn. Hver gruppe har en fast stab bestående af to pædagoger og to medhjælpere.

Vi prioriterer fællesskab og samarbejde - både mellem børn og voksne og på tværs af stuerne. Hos os kender alle børn alle voksne, og det giver en tryg og tillidsfuld atmosfære i hverdagen.

Vi arbejder løbende med at styrke vores pædagogiske praksis, og vi har et fælles fokus på relationer, nærvær og det enkelte barns trivsel og udvikling.

Din rolle som pædagog

Som pædagog i Eventyrhusets børnehave bliver du en del af en fast gruppe, hvor du - sammen med dine 3 stuekollegaer - får ansvaret for ca. 22 børn.

Vi tror på, at kvalitet kræver tid og forberedelse. Derfor har du som pædagog hos os hver uge 2 timer afsat til "andet arbejde", som f.eks. planlægning, refleksion og dokumentation - uden børn.

Du bliver en del af et stærkt fællesskab, hvor vi løfter i flok og hjælper hinanden på tværs af stuer og faggrupper.

Hvem er du?

Vi forestiller os, at du:

·       Har en uddannelse som pædagog.

·       Er professionel, omsorgsfuld og initiativrig.

·       Brænder for relationer, leg og nærvær i det pædagogiske arbejde.

·       Er god til at samarbejde og bidrager positivt til fællesskabet.

·       Har IT-kompetencer på brugerniveau (fordel, men ikke et krav).

Hvad får du hos os?

·       Mulighed for selv at vælge ugentligt timeantal.

·       2 timers forberedelsestid hver uge.

·       Betalt madordning med sund og lækker frokost.

·       Firma-betalt sundhedsforsikring - også for dine hjemmeboende børn.

·       Betalt ICDP-kursus, hvis du ikke allerede er uddannet.

·       En hverdag i skønne omgivelser med masser af udeliv.

·       Et sted, hvor nytænkning og faglig udvikling er en del af kulturen.

·       Ingen lukkedage i sommerferien, så du er selv med til at styre hvornår du holder ferie.

Ansættelsesvilkår

·       Stillingen er på det antal timer, som passer dig bedst.

·       Start: Hurtigst muligt - men vi venter gerne på den rette.

·       Løn og vilkår efter overenskomst med BUPL og Børneringen.

·       Vi indhenter børne- og straffeattest og referencer som en del af processen.

Klar til nye eventyr?

Hvis du har spørgsmål eller er nysgerrig på stillingen, så kontakt os endelig. Vi giver gerne en rundvisning, så du kan mærke stemningen selv. Du kan også læse mere om Eventyrhuset på vores hjemmeside: www.eventyrhuset.info.

Send din ansøgning og CV til post@eventyrhuset.info eller kontakt os på tlf. 28760260, hvis du vil besøge os først.

Vi holder samtaler løbende, og lukker annoncen, når vi har fundet den rette kollega. Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

Eventyrhuset… Her bliver hverdagens øjeblikke til noget helt særligt

title: Assistant Professor in Operations and Supply Chain Digitalisation
description:
The Center for Supply Chain Digitalisation (CSD), at the Department of Technology and Innovation, University of Southern Denmark (SDU) invites applications for an Assistant Professor in Operations and Supply Chain Digitalization with special focus on simulation and/or artificial intelligence applied to operations and supply chains.

The targeted start date is February 2027.

The successful candidate will be responsible for collaboratively building up the area of operations and supply chain digitalisation with a primary focus on quantitative methods such as discrete-event and agent-based simulation, process automation, data science, and machine learning.

Successful candidates will drive internationally recognized and competitive research, work closely with industry, and are expected to attract external research funding. The position has a strong focus on experimental and applied research in production systems and supply chain fields. The candidate will play a key role in providing outstanding education, supervising bachelor's and master’s students, and developing junior research staff.

SDU CSD is a highly international group of faculty members, embedded in a region with a strong network of companies, including some of Denmark's largest global industrial players (i.e. Danfoss, Linak, Siemens) and many manufacturing SMEs. Projects currently run by the group cover a range of topics within the field of operations and supply chain digitalization.

The successful candidate must have a background in engineering. PhD degree preferably in industrial engineering, supply chain, operations management, operations research, or the like.

The application deadline is October 15, 2026, at 11.59 PM/23.59 (CET/CEST) 

 

We expect

A highly motivated, collaborative person, who can work in an international, interdisciplinary team, with documented research skills in the field of operations and supply chain. The candidate needs to be a team player and, at the same time, be able to work independently. The successful candidate is active in publishing in engineering journals.

The ideal candidate can connect research with practical technology application and has demonstrated skills and competencies in one or more of the following areas:

  • Discrete-event and/or agent-based simulation

  • Artificial intelligence, machine/deep learning applied to operations and supply chain (AI-applications in other fields are not relevant for this position) 

  • Agentic AI applied to operations and supply chain

  • Business and intelligent process automation

Further information is available from Associate Professor Elias Ribeiro da Silva elias@iti.sdu.dk.

 

We offer

  • A professional workplace culture that values equality, mutual respect, and is designed to accommodate and encourage work-life balance

  • A vibrant social environment with structured activities and informal routines that promote cross-disciplinary interaction and cultivate an inclusive, supportive atmosphere.

  • An engaging, dynamic, and international interdisciplinary environment with extensive collaboration opportunities across national, international, and industrial partners

  • Opportunities for continued professional development and education for all staff members.

  • Access to a well-developed research infrastructure

  • A strong institutional commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion in all aspects of the workplace

 

About the workplace

The position is within the SDU Center for Supply Chain Digitalisation (CSD) at the Faculty of Engineering on the international campus Sønderborg. The center conducts research at the intersection of supply chain management, data science, and digital technologies. Our work applies quantitative, data-driven methods to analyse, design, and optimise complex supply chains.

In close collaboration with industry partners, the center focuses on the full data journey across the supply chain, developing tools and methods based on advanced analytics, simulation, and artificial intelligence to enable stronger coordination, end-to-end transparency, and more sustainable and efficient supply chain operations.

SDU CSD is situated in a region with a robust network of companies, including some of Denmark’s largest global industrial players as well as numerous SMEs. The group’s current projects mainly focus on building quantitative models and methods to support better decisions or on turning data-driven optimisation, simulation, and digital tools into practical use in operations. 

The SDU CSD is a highly international and interdisciplinary group of faculty members, with international students. The campus is in Sønderborg, an attractive coastal town with an open Scandinavian culture, and affordable housing and living costs.

 

Special benefits when working in Denmark

  • The average weekly working hours are 37 hours per week

  • 30 days of paid holiday per year

  • The yearly salary for a full-time assistant professor is between DKK 502.905 and DKK 566.647 depending on the years of working experience. Postdoc experience may place you on a higher salary step. The salary includes a base salary, a position-related supplement and pension (18.07 %). Additional supplement(s) for special qualifications can be negotiated. Authorisation supplement(s) will be granted, if relevant for the position. Your local eligible trade union representative at SDU negotiates your salary on your behalf.

  • Subsidized preschool childcare and a free education system from primary school up to university level

  • Universal health insurance as a resident of Denmark, including family members officially residing in Denmark

  • In relation to childbirth, employees are entitled to a combined total of 52 weeks of parental leave, shared between parents, with full or partial salary depending on circumstances.

  • Researchers recruited from abroad are offered a special researcher tax scheme with a lower tax rate. 

  • Travel and moving expenses may be partially covered.

 

Living in Denmark

The International Staff Office (ISO) at SDU provides a variety of services for new employees, guests and people who consider applying for a job at the University of Southern Denmark. Among other things, the staff answers questions concerning salary, taxation, housing and accompanying family.

We recommend that international applicants also take the time to visit Work in Denmark.

The University of Southern Denmark wishes to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position.

 

Application and assessment

Applications will be assessed by an expert committee. When the expert committee issues its assessment, applicants will receive the portion of the assessment pertaining to them personally.

The committee assesses candidates only based on the application materials. Please include the following documents in English: 

  • Brief motivation letter

  • Curriculum vitae

  • Full list of publications

  • Copies of the three publications on which the applicant wishes to be evaluated. Please attach one pdf-file for each publication

  • Diplomas/Certificates (Master and PhD degree)

  • Summary and documentation of teaching experience. You may attach a Teaching Portfolio.

  • Documentation of other qualifications relevant to the position

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

 

The application deadline is October 15, 2026, at 11.59 PM/23.59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Shortlisting may be used in the assessment process. Read about shortlisting at SDU.  An interview may be included as part of the overall evaluation of the applicant’s qualifications. If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support. Applicants are advised to read the SDU information on how to apply and specific faculty information for application at the Faculty of Engineering.

 

Employment terms

Appointment as an assistant professor is temporary and for an initial 3-year period. The preferred start date is from February 2027.

During employment, the assistant professor will complete the Lecturer Training Programme. 

Employment as an assistant professor requires academic qualifications at a minimum of PhD level at the time of employment. Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for assistant professor as described therein. 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

 

SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s).

Further information about The Faculty of Engineering.

title: Process Engineer - Cold Forming

title: Tenure-track Assistant Professor or Associate Professor of Food and Ingredient Biochemical Processing
description:
Tenure-track Assistant Professor or Associate Professor of Food and Ingredient Biochemical Processing
Department of Food Science
Faculty of Science
University of Copenhagen

The Department of Food Science (FOOD), Faculty of Science (SCIENCE), University of Copenhagen (UCPH) invites applications for a position as Tenure-track Assistant Professor or Associate Professor in Food and Ingredient Biochemical Processing. The research areas of FOOD have a shared mission to contribute to new pathways for society and industry to support the development of solutions based in biology to improve sustainable food production, food security and food safety. FOOD is recognized for excellence in food research, education and industrial collaboration. The Department is an international workplace with Danish and English as parallel working languages, however it is expected that the successful candidate will be able to contribute to teaching in Danish within 3 to 6 years. FOOD has the ambition to reinforce our teaching and research in designing and optimizing biology-based solutions as future sustainable food and ingredient technologies. UCPH is strengthening this area by offering the new MSc Biosolutions program in Kalundborg, Denmark, the largest bio-based manufacturing hub in Scandinavia, home to large fermentation-based manufacturers, and a vibrant innovation environment. The candidate for this position is expected to significantly contribute to this new Biosolutions initiative.

The aim of the position is to explore the production and use of new solutions based on both biology and engineering addressing sustainability challenges inherent in food systems today. Although we welcome a diverse range of applicants, the focus of the position will be processing in relation to biochemically based solutions and could include the following disciplines:

  • Food process technology, ideally with an emphasis on fermentation & downstream processing
  • Food process system engineering
  • Use of sensor technologies such as in-line or at line spectroscopic tools
  • Large-data, modelling and prediction of food and ingredient processes.
  • Understanding of biological production systems and their use, and with an emphasis on downstream processing
A central part of the activities anchored to this position will be taking place in Campus Kalundborg, and it is crucial that the candidate is able to leverage the local ecosystem to foster strong collaboration with industry. Qualifications are expected in the following areas:

  • A collaborative and innovative mindset
  • Documented scientific impact and outreach in past research work
  • A proven track record in attracting external funding at both national and international level
  • Experience with international collaborations
  • Ability to establish industrial collaboration
  • Excellent interpersonal and communicative skills
Tenure-track assistant professor
The tenure-track assistant professor’s duties will primarily include research, including obligations regarding publication/scientific communication and research-based teaching with associated examination obligations within Ingredient Biochemical Processing. To a limited extent the position may also include other duties.

The tenure-track assistant professor must have an academic standing showing internationally competitive research, and/or have internationally recognized high potential to make a future impact.

Assessment of applicants for the tenure-track assistant professorship will primarily consider their level of documented, internationally competitive research. The ability to attract external funding will be considered together with outreach qualifications. Teaching qualifications are not mandatory but documented teaching qualifications and teaching experience will be considered.

Associate professor

Applicants are required to have university level teaching experience, documented teaching competencies and must be able to explain and reflect upon own teaching practice and portfolio. Formal pedagogical training or supervision equivalent to the University of Copenhagen teacher training programme for assistant professors is required.

The candidate must be an inspiring teacher with a vision on teaching development, especially in connection with the new MSc Biosolutions program. A new campus with research and teaching facilities is currently being built in Kalundborg and the candidate is expected to contribute to setting up the facilities

Duties include the applicant’s own research, development of the field, assessment tasks, grant applications, and research management such as supervision and training of research fellows and other staff. The successful applicant must also teach, supervise, prepare and participate in examinations, and fulfill other tasks requested by the Department.

Assessment of applicants for the associate professorship will primarily consider their level of documented, original scientific production at an international level, including contributions to developments in their field, as well as their documented teaching qualifications. Managerial and out-reach qualifications of applicants including ability to attract external funding will also be considered.

University of Copenhagen’s criteria for recognising merit
General criteria apply to the appointment of assistant professor / associate professor at the University of Copenhagen. The criteria (research, teaching, Innovation & societal impact, organizational contribution and leadership) are considered as a framework for an overall assessment of the applicant. In addition, each applicant will be assessed according to the specific requirements listed in this advertisement.

Please read more here

For tenure-track assistant professors: https://jobportal.ku.dk/videnskabelige-stillinger/kriterier-for-videnskabelige-stillinger/kriterier-for-meritering-maj-2026/5a_Criteria_for_recognising_merit_-Assistant_professors.pdf

For associate professors: https://jobportal.ku.dk/videnskabelige-stillinger/kriterier-for-videnskabelige-stillinger/kriterier-for-meritering-maj-2026/5b_Criteria_for_recognising_merit_-Associate_professors.pdf

Applicants are encouraged to read the University of Copenhagen's Guidance on the merit criterion Innovation and Societal Impact here

The tenure-track assistant programme
The tenure-track programme is a career programme and an assigned mentor will provide the tenure-track assistant professors with guidance related to career development, other academic topics and administrative procedures.

Performance of the tenure-track assistant professor will be followed via internal yearly evaluations and a mid-term and final international evaluation by an assessment committee. If the ‘final appraisal’ is positive you will be promoted as associate professor. Performance and progression towards the criteria below will be evaluated with due consideration of differences between research fields.

After a 6-year tenure-track period tenure-track assistant professors are expected to meet the criteria for appointment of associate professors at the University of Copenhagen.

Salary and employment conditions
The position is open from 1 May 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.

The position is covered by the Memorandum on Job Structure for Academic Staff.

Employment is as either tenure track assistant professor or associate professor under the applicable collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and The Danish Confederation of Professional Associations on Academics in the State. There will be an opportunity to negotiate supplements based on qualifications. You can read more about salary levels in the state sector www.loenoverblik.dk (in Danish).

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

The Professor will be a part of the Section for Ingredients and Dairy Technology. The section has internationally acknowledged expertise within novel sustainable processing technologies, protein, polyphenol and lipid chemistry, functionality, and modification of food components, kinetics, oxidation, food engineering, rheology, digitalisation, and advanced data analysis. The section is also equipped with pilot facilities for brewing, dairy and bioprocessing. Further information on the Department is linked at Department of Food Science – University of Copenhagen Inquiries about the position can be made to Inquiries about the position can be made to Head of Department, Colin Ray (+45 93565911, colin.ray@food.ku.dk) or Head of Section, Mogens Larsen Andersen (+45 3533 3262, mola@food.ku.dk).

Filing of application
The position may be applied for at the tenure-track assistant professor level or associate professor level. Please note that it is possible to apply at more than one level. If applied at more than one level, separate applications must be submitted (see below).

The application including all attachments must be in English and submitted electronically by clicking APPLY NOW below.

Applying for the tenure-track assistant professorship please include

  • Curriculum vitae including:
    • Please describe and document international network and relations
    • Please describe and document internationally based activities
    • Positions held at universities/research institutions outside Denmark
    • Outreach activities, i.e. popular lectures or other activities in the media
    • Grants held, personal or in part. Career development grants.
  • Diplomas (Master and PhD degree or equivalent)
  • Research plan - description of current and future research plans
  • If available, description and documentation of teaching and supervision experience and qualifications- please describe and document:
    • Experience with supervision of BSc and MSc students
    • Teaching experience
    • Formal pedagogical training
  • Complete publication list
  • Separate reprints of up to 5 particularly relevant papers
Applying for the associate professorship please include

  • Curriculum vitae including information about external funding
  • Diplomas (Master and PhD degree or equivalent)
  • Research plan – description of current and future research plans
  • Description and documentation of teaching experience and qualifications according to university guidelines
  • Complete publication list
  • Separate reprints of 5 particularly relevant papers
The deadline for applications is 28 October 2026, 23:59 GMT +1.

After the expiry of the deadline for applications, the authorized recruitment manager selects applicants for assessment on the advice of the Interview Committee.

You can read about the recruitment process at http://employment.ku.dk/faculty/recruitment-process/.

Interviews will be held on 8 March 2027.

211-0263/26-2N, Tenure-track Assistant Professor Food and Ingredient Biochemical Processing.
