title: Senior Research Adviser for EU, International Funding, Innovation and Impact, Faculty of Health Sciences
description:
Are you curious about how FP10 will change the opportunities and requirements facing universities? Are you interested in the growing expectations for innovation and impact arising from research? And would you like to work both strategically and closely with researchers and projects, with one clear objective: to strengthen SUND’s international position and secure more external funding?

Then you could play a central role in SUND Research Support. We are looking for an experienced research adviser who from 1 December 2026 can serve as our key specialist for EU and international funding opportunities – and help prepare the unit for tomorrow’s requirements in relation to funding, project delivery, innovation and societal impact.

Responsibilities
You will take an overview of EU and international funding: from developments in Horizon Europe and FP10 to specific calls, partnerships and opportunities for SUND researchers. You will translate policy and programme developments into action and help us position ourselves early as new agendas emerge.

The role spans strategic intelligence and portfolio oversight through to hands-on advice and coordination of prioritised initiatives. Some days you will work on long-term EU positioning and pipeline development; on others, closely with a researcher, an international consortium or a specific call. We do not expect you to do everything yourself, but you will need to spot opportunities, bring together the right expertise and drive progress.

Innovation and impact are important parts of the role. You will strengthen our impact-upfront approach and ensure that requirements relating to involvement, uptake, implementation and knowledge valorisation are considered early. At the same time, you will contribute to a smooth transition from pre-award to post-award, so that project delivery is considered from the outset and lessons from funded projects and project implementation feed into new applications.

You will be both a key contributor to specific EU and international initiatives and a co-developer of our shared models, workflows and portfolio overview. The aim is a more coherent approach to international funding – not simply more individual applications.

Qualifications
We are looking for an experienced professional who thrives at the intersection of research, EU policy, funding, innovation and impact. You have solid experience of EU or international funding, research development or research support, and a good knowledge of Horizon Europe or other major international programmes.

You work strategically and analytically but are also keen to turn insight into tangible results. You are a strong coordinator and relationship-builder who can navigate complex processes, bring together expertise and build trust with researchers, colleagues and management. You communicate confidently in both Danish and English.
It is an advantage if you also have experience of areas such as EU policy, international consortia, Brussels networks, post-award, innovation, societal impact or knowledge valorisation. We do not expect you to be an expert in all of these areas. A PhD or other research experience may be an advantage but is not essential.

In addition, you have an understanding of and a desire to work with digitalization and artificial intelligence (AI) in relation to optimizing processes and creating value within the organization. 

About SUND Research Support and the Faculty of Health Sciences
SUND Research Support assists researchers at the Faculty of Health Sciences at SDU from the early idea and funding opportunity through to application, project delivery, innovation and impact.

We aim to work more proactively with funding intelligence, positioning, partnerships and long-term pipelines – and to create stronger links between pre-award, post-award, innovation and impact. At the same time, we want to use data, organisational learning and AI more systematically.

You will have the opportunity both to work directly with researchers and projects and to help shape how a modern research support function should operate in the years ahead. You will play a central role in SUND’s international funding activities in the run-up to FP10 and help create stronger links between EU/international funding, post-award, innovation and impact.

You will work closely with strong health sciences research environments, management teams and colleagues with a range of specialist profiles. We are interested in new ways of working and in how data, digital tools and AI can add value to research support. This is an opportunity both to deliver results today and to help shape how we work tomorrow.

The Faculty of Health Sciences at the University of Southern Denmark is one of Denmark’s leading faculties of health sciences. With nine departments, internationally top‑class research, and a broad range of health‑related study programmes, we contribute to developing the knowledge, treatments, and healthcare system of the future.
As an employee at the faculty, you become part of an ambitious and interdisciplinary environment characterised by high academic standards, strong collaborations, and excellent opportunities for professional development. The faculty has activities in Odense, Esbjerg, and Copenhagen. In Esbjerg and Copenhagen, strong academic communities provide the framework for research and education, while our modern faculty building in Odense brings research, education, and administration together under one roof and is directly connected to Odense University Hospital.

Read more about the Faculty of Health Sciences here.

Contact
If you would like more information about the position, you are welcome to contact head of SUND Research Support Anne Kathrine Overgaard, tlf. 60111043, e-mail: aovergaard@health.sdu.dk or Head of Education and Secretariat Merete Munk på mmunk@health.sdu.dk.

Application Process
The application deadline is 29 September 2026 at 11:59 PM. We expect to conduct interviews 7 October 2026. 

Employment starts on 1 December 2026 or as soon as possible thereafter.

Salary and Terms of Employment
Your place of employment will be the University of Southern Denmark in Odense, Campusvej 55, 5230 Odense M.

There may be limited travel activity to other SDU campus cities.

Employment is in accordance with the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and collective agreement for academics (AC).

The position is full time.

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements.

As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range of the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process.
SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. 

If you are interested in the position, you must submit an application that includes a cover letter, CV indicating months and years (without photo), and diploma. All documents related to the application should not contain photos or CPR numbers – if so, the CPR number must be redacted.

All attached files must be in Adobe PDF format. The cover letter and CV must not exceed 5 MB.

Guidance on the application process can be found here.

The University of Southern Denmark wishes to reflect the surrounding society and therefore encourages all qualified applicants, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position.

About SDU
The University of Southern Denmark exists to create value for and with society. Whether our contribution comes in the form of excellent research, innovative solutions, education, or learning, we aim to make a positive difference for society and contribute to a sustainable future. We do this by nurturing talent and creating the best environments for research and learning. It is therefore crucial that SDU retains, develops, and recruits talent. At the same time, we must ensure consistently high quality in all our activities – and we can only do that with the right people. It is the university’s researchers, teachers, students, leaders, and technical-administrative staff who form the foundation of our success.

title: Tenure-track Assistant Professorship at the Hans Christian Andersen Centre with a Focus on Digital Humanities, Textual Genesis and Nineteenth-Century Literature
description:
A five-year tenure-track assistant professorship is available at the Hans Christian Andersen Centre, Department for the Study of Culture and Language, University of Southern Denmark, with appointment from 1 January 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.

The Hans Christian Andersen Centre is an internationally leading research environment within Andersen studies. Its research encompasses literary, cultural and public dissemination-oriented approaches to Andersen’s works, life and cultural significance. The Centre conducts research at the highest international level with the aim of developing new literary, cultural and dissemination-oriented perspectives on Andersen’s complete artistic oeuvre. The Centre provides a framework for collaboration with Danish and international researchers, cultural mediators and other actors in the field.

Job Content
The assistant professorship is a tenure-track position with a view to obtaining a permanent appointment as associate professor following a positive academic assessment.

The position is affiliated with the project Hans Christian Andersen’s Fairy Tales and Stories – the Digital Manuscript Edition and will, in close interaction with the project’s existing research activities, contribute to integrating digital, philological and literary approaches.

The assistant professor will be part of the Centre’s research environment and collaborate with the project’s editorial group, with responsibility for developing research at the intersection of digital humanities, textual genesis and literary-historical analysis.

Read more about the position here

title: Midwife with International Experience Wanted for the Labour Ward at Aalborg University Hospital
description:
Become Part of a Unique Community – Midwife with International Experience Wanted for the Labour Ward at Aalborg University Hospital
Do you dream of working in a place where professional excellence, compassion, and development go hand in hand?
Where you are surrounded every day by dedicated colleagues, and where your skills and experience are recognised, utilised, and appreciated?
If so, this is your opportunity to join our fantastic maternity team at Aalborg University Hospital.

We are seeking a midwife with international experience and knowledge of different childbirth cultures for a permanent position, starting on 1 September 2026 or as soon as possible. We wish to expand our work on childbirth culture and cultural understanding and are therefore looking for a midwife who can contribute to this development. The position is not a development role, but a standard clinical midwife position on the labour ward with a special professional profile.

We expect you to have experience working as a midwife in a non-European country and to be fluent in a widely spoken world language other than English. You must have completed the Danish adaptation and evaluation employment programme and hold Danish authorisation as a midwife.

Why Choose Us?
At Aalborg University Hospital, you will find more than just a job—you will become part of a strong, supportive, and professionally inspiring community.
We are the largest maternity unit in the North Denmark Region. As a highly specialised department, we provide care for approximately 3,300 pregnant women, women in labour, postpartum women, and their families each year. Here, you will have the opportunity to apply your professional expertise in a dynamic environment with varied responsibilities and room for both specialisation and professional development.

In addition, we offer:
  • A clinical supervising midwife on every shift as a dedicated professional mentor
  • A personal coordinator during your onboarding period
  • A buddy system on every shift
  • Opportunities for professional courses, supervision, and targeted competency development
  • Teams and professional communities that hold regular group meetings with both professional and social content

You will become part of a large and engaged professional community consisting of approximately 150 skilled colleagues—midwives, nurses, healthcare assistants, doctors, and administrative staff—all dedicated to creating safe, coordinated, and professional maternity care pathways.

Opportunities with Us
We understand that a long working life includes changing needs and interests. Therefore, we place great emphasis on flexibility and the opportunity to combine different functions according to your preferences.
This means you may combine work in areas such as:
  • Labour Ward and Midwifery Antenatal Clinic
  • Labour Ward and Maternity Assessment Unit
  • Labour Ward and Postnatal Ward

The majority of our midwives work in combined positions like these, creating professional variety, development opportunities, and job satisfaction.
We highly prioritise education and professional growth, and as a midwife with us, you will be part of a workplace where learning and development are natural parts of everyday practice.

Who Are You?
You are a qualified midwife with substantial professional experience from another country and exposure to a different childbirth culture.
You thrive in a professionally strong environment where teamwork, safety, and professionalism are central values.
You are passionate about working in the birthing suite. You enjoy building new relationships and work confidently both in complex obstetric cases and in births where the most important task is simply “being there” for the woman and her family.
You are able to identify the differences between childbirth cultures and contribute valuable insights and reflections to the daily professional discussions on the labour ward.

In addition, we expect that you are fluent in a widely spoken world language other than English. You must have completed the Danish adaptation and evaluation employment programme and hold Danish authorisation as a midwife.

Most importantly, you:
  • Want to become part of a committed and caring team
  • Contribute positively to a supportive and developmental work environment
  • Are passionate about creating safe and coherent childbirth experiences

Our Values – Your Foundation
Our work is based on the North Denmark Region’s core values: Involvement, Trust, Decency, and Professionalism (I-TOP).
This means that we meet women, families, and relatives with empathy and respect—and we treat each other in the same way.

We Offer You
  • A workplace characterised by high professional standards, warmth, and humour
  • Strong interdisciplinary collaboration where everyone contributes
  • A quality standard that ensures one midwife for every woman in labour
  • A work environment where psychological and physical well-being are prioritised
  • Supervision by trained supervisors in structured group programmes
  • A unique collaboration between Health and Safety Representatives, Union Representatives, and Management, based on openness, respect, and trust
  • A department where ideas are encouraged and where your voice matters
  • A workplace that values your experience and is genuinely curious about your professional background

And last—but certainly not least:
The best colleagues in the world and a workplace you look forward to coming to every day.

Salary and Employment Conditions
Salary and employment terms according to the current collective agreement for non-managing midwives, etc., concluded with the Danish Midwives' Association.

Further Information
For questions about the position, please contact:
Arianne Brandborg Nørhave
Acting Deputy Head Midwife and Manager of the Labour Ward
Phone: +45 20 73 07 50
Email: a.noerhave@rn.dk

Recruitment Process
Application deadline: 20th of september 2026
Please submit your application, CV, and any other relevant documents electronically to this e-mail: m.cederstroem@rn.dk

Interviews: Expected to take place shortly after the application deadline.

Starting date: 1th of October 2026 or earlier by agreement.

Experience transferring complex hardware products from engineering builds through pre-series and into repeatable production Hands-on experience with industrialisation, production ramp-ups, assembly, integration and testing Strong understanding of production workflows, manufacturing-process development, test infrastructure and production readiness Experience defining production layouts, workstations, tooling, fixtures and equipment requirements Experience introducing work instructions, routings, production records, traceability and configuration controls Experience with production planning, capacity analysis, inventory management, material flow and ERP/MRP systems Experience developing make-or-buy strategies and managing specialised suppliers or contract manufacturers Knowledge of structured production and quality processes aligned with ISO 9001 or an equivalent framework Understanding of non-conformance management, corrective actions and controlled engineering changes Experience building, leading and developing manufacturing or operations teams Ability to demonstrate your personal contribution and measurable results from previous industrialisation or production scale-up work Ability to operate effectively at both strategic and hands-on levels Strong cross-functional coordination, prioritisation and problem-solving skills A builder’s mindset and motivation to create new manufacturing capability Professional fluency in English Willingness to reside in Estonia and work primarily onsite in Tallinn Candidates should be prepared to demonstrate results such as establishing a production facility, transferring hardware into serial production, increasing capacity or throughput, improving quality and delivery performance, implementing manufacturing systems, developing test infrastructure, qualifying suppliers or building a production team.

title: Bartender
description:
We are looking for an adult employee for a DJ or bartender position at a karaoke bar located in Tallinn Old Town.

Work tasks: The role includes providing professional, friendly, and efficient service to customers in the karaoke bar and ensuring that the venue’s daily operations run smoothly. Depending on the shift and operational needs, the employee’s duties may include both bar work and tasks related to DJ and karaoke services.
Bartender duties include taking customer orders, preparing and serving alcoholic and non-alcoholic drinks, using the cash register system, accepting payments, and ensuring accurate transactions. The employee is responsible for keeping the bar area clean, organized, and ready for service, replenishing drink supplies and work materials when necessary, and maintaining a tidy workstation throughout the shift. When needed, the employee also helps with clearing tables, collecting glasses, serving customers in the seating area, and carrying out other daily tasks. DJ duties include operating the karaoke and music software, taking song requests from customers and managing the performance queue, selecting suitable background music, and ensuring that the karaoke evening runs smoothly. The employee uses the necessary sound and karaoke equipment, microphones, and computer programs, and assists customers in finding suitable songs when needed. The DJ is also responsible for creating a pleasant, lively, and positive atmosphere in the bar and communicating with customers in a polite and professional manner. The job also includes answering customer questions, introducing the bar’s services and offers, and assisting customers when needed. We expect the employee to be willing to cooperate with other team members and, when necessary, support colleagues with tasks in other areas in order to ensure fast and high-quality service.

We offer: We offer the opportunity to work in a karaoke bar located in Tallinn Old Town in an active and international working environment. The job is well suited to someone who enjoys communication, music, entertainment, and a varied working day.
We offer a flexible work schedule and the opportunity to work mainly in the evenings and on weekends. Previous work experience is not required, as all necessary training is provided on site. We will teach you how to use the cash register system, prepare and serve drinks, work with karaoke and music programs, and use the necessary sound and bar equipment. The employee will receive support from experienced colleagues in their daily work and will have the opportunity to develop customer service, sales, bartending, and communication skills. For a suitable and motivated employee, we offer the opportunity to take on more responsibility over time and develop within the company. Our working environment is youthful, friendly, and informal. The work is not monotonous — every evening brings different customers, songs, and situations. We value good teamwork, a positive attitude, reliability, and a willingness to learn. We offer: • on-site training and guidance; • a flexible work schedule; • an international and communication-focused working environment; • the opportunity to gain practical experience in bartending, customer service, and DJ/karaoke work; • a supportive and friendly team; • opportunities for long-term cooperation and development within the company; • internal employee discounts and benefits according to agreement.

Other requirements: The work takes place mainly in the evenings and at night, as well as on weekends, so the employee must be prepared to work according to a flexible schedule. The role requires good communication skills, friendliness, responsibility, accuracy, and the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment.
Previous work experience as a bartender, DJ, or service employee is not required. All necessary working methods, including use of the cash register system, bar work, karaoke software, and equipment, will be taught on site. The employee will receive the necessary guidance and training when starting work and will be supported by experienced colleagues during the first working days. We are primarily looking for a motivated, reliable, and willing-to-learn person who wants to work in the entertainment and service industry and is comfortable communicating actively with a wide range of customers.

Option to work from home: No

Working load, shifts: 10-20 hours/week
; work includes night shifts

title: Tugiisik
description:
tugiisik 3-aastasele rõõmsale ja armsale poisile

Tööülesanded: Tugiisiku töö toimub peamiselt lapse abistajana heas eestikeelses tavalasteaias. Lapsel on kõne hilistumine, kuid vaatamata kõne puudumisele on ta kõigest huvituv, lustlik ja aktiivne. Ta on liikumisel ja tegevustes osav, ettevaatlik ning vaatlev-uuriv. Vahetevahel võib ta olla ka ulakas ja mitte kohe kuuletuda.
Laps vajab tugiisiku abi ja juhendamist eelkõige: • lasteaia tegevustest osa võtmisel; • lasteaia päevakava ja kodukorra järgimisel; • riietumisel; • söömisel; • hügieenitoimingutel; • turvalisuse ja järelevalve tagamisel. Tugiisiku jaoks on laps väga tore ja pigem kerge klient: ta on hästi kontakteeruv, rõõmsameelne ja koostöövalmis.

Omalt poolt pakume: Tugiisik võetakse tööle Tallina Perekeskuse poolt käsunduslepinguga. Töökoormus, tööaeg ja motivatsioonisüsteem on läbiräägitavad.

Muud nõuded: Tugiisikuks sobib täisealine inimene, kes on läbinud tugiisiku koolituse ja/või töötanud eelnevalt lastega.
Kandidaadilt ootame sobivaid isikuomadusi, head suhtlemisoskust, rahulikku meelt, usaldusväärsust ja valmisolekut lapse igapäevast toimetulekut toetada. Tugiisik peab: • oskama näha last tervikuna; • suutma suhelda lapse, tema pere ja lähedastega; • suutma kanda vastutust lapse ohutuse ja turvalisuse eest; • tegutsema vastavalt olukorrale; • järgima vastastikuse usalduse, lugupidamise ja konfidentsiaalsuse põhimõtteid. Tugiisik peab läbima korrapärase tervisekontrolli nakkushaiguste suhtes, sealhulgas iga kahe aasta järel kopsude röntgenuuringu. Tugiisikul peab olema tervisekontrolli läbimise kohta perearsti väljastatud tervisetõend. Tugiisikuks ei sobi inimene, kes on süüdi mõistetud tahtlikult toimepandud kuriteo eest või kes ei vasta muudele seadustes sätestatud nõuetele.

title: Julgestustöötaja-tegevusjuhendaja
description:
Töö asukoht Valga maakonnas Valga vallas (tööandja pakub majutust, hüvitab transpordikulud).

Tööülesanded: MTÜ Valga Abikeskus avab uue üksuse, kus pakutakse ööpäevaringset erihoolekandeteenust autismispektrihäirega inimestele.
Tegevusjuhendaja on vahetu teenuse osutaja, kelle tegevuse eesmärk on luua turvaline, struktureeritud ja toetav keskkond, mis arvestab kliendi individuaalsete eripäradega. Tööülesannete täitmine eeldab head füüsilist vormi ja aktiivset kaasamõtlemist teenuse arendamisel ning loomulikult kliente toetavat hoiakut.

Omalt poolt pakume: Motiveerivat töötasu; meeldivat meeskonda; vahetustega töögraafikut (paindlik tööaeg); vajadusel tasuta ööbimisvõimalust asutuses (tuba jagatakse); sõidukompensatsiooni igal kuul; tööalaseid koolitusi; kohapealset väljaõpet; tasuta toitlustust.

Muud nõuded: Otsime inimesi, kes on loomult rahulikud, kannatlikud ja järjepidevad, samas aktiivse hoiakuga ning uuendusmeelsed.
Tegevusjuhendaja väljaõpe ei ole otseselt tööle saamisel nõutav, küll aga eeldame valmidust õppima asumiseks ning kvalifikatsiooni omandamiseks. Ka tööandja pakub koolitamisvõimalusi. Oluline on vähemalt keskhariduse olemasolu ja kasuks tuleb eelnev töökogemus sotsiaalvaldkonnas, loomulikult ka varasemalt läbitud vastav väljaõpe. NB! Isik ei tohi töötada tegevusjuhendajana, kui teda on karistatud tahtlikult toimepandud kuriteo eest, mis on suunatud isiku vastu (nt vägivald) või mis seab ohtu teiste inimeste elu ja tervise. Tööle asumisel kontrollitakse alati karistusregistri väljavõtet.

title: Külaliskorterite koristaja
description:
Tööülesanded: Dream Stay OÜ on pikaajalise kogemusega lühiajalise rendiga tegelev ettevõte, kelle hallata on üle 120 külaliskorteri Tallinnas.
Seoses suvise hooaja ja suurenenud töömahuga otsime oma meeskonda külaliskorterite koristajaid nii täis- kui osalise koormusega. Võimalik on töötada ka ainult nädalavahetustel (näiteks laupäevast esmaspäevani) — töö sobib hästi lisatööks või hooajaliseks tööks suveperioodil. Enamik külaliskortereid asub Tallinna vanalinnas ja kesklinnas või nende vahetus läheduses. Pakume tööd külaliskorterites. Palun arvestage, et kõik korterid – kokku umbes 120 – asuvad erinevates hoonetes. Autot tööks vaja ei ole — liikumine objektide vahel toimub ühistranspordiga ning see aeg on samuti tasustatud. Linna peal pesu vedama ei pea: puhta pesu toob kohale meie kuller. Kõik vajalikud puhastusvahendid on olemas apartementides või keldriruumides. Koristaja peab endaga kaasas kandma vaid meilt saadud lappe, kindaid ja mõned švammid. Töö sisaldab vahetusi nädalavahetustel ja pühade ajal — see on turismisektoris töötamise loomulik osa. Esmaspäevast reedeni töögraafikut kahjuks pakkuda ei ole võimalik ning väikeste lastega tööl viibimine ei ole lubatud.

Omalt poolt pakume: * Kaasaegseid töövahendeid
* Sõbralikku ning toetavat kollektiivi * Töötulemustele vastavat töötasu

Muud nõuded: Oled sobiv kandidaat, kui sul on olemas töötahe, armastad puhtust ja korrektsust ning oled võimeline töötama iseseisvalt.
Varasem töökogemus sarnasel ametikohal on väga hinnatud ja annab eelise. Oluline tingimus on nutitelefoni kasutamise oskus, kuna põhiline suhtlus ja töökorraldus toimub grupivestluses.

title: Server
description:
Work tasks: Main areas of work:
- Welcome guests warmly, assist with seating arrangements, and provide exceptional service by answering inquiries and offering menu recommendations for food and beverages. - Prepare and serve food, and hot and cold drinks to established standards, ensuring quality and consistency. - Organize workstations, operate tools and appliances in the serving and work area, and notify the kitchen of low stock levels as needed. - Maintain cleanliness and sanitation in serving and work areas, tools, and equipment; adhere to food safety laws and hygiene protocols - Operate the POS system to process cash, card, and digital payments accurately, providing receipts and resolving customer payment inquiries professionally. - Ensure cleanliness and hygiene by washing dishes, clearing tables, and maintaining dining areas, inspecting and monitoring products to ensure freshness and presentation consistency in accordance with company procedures. - Adhere to food safety, hygiene, and workplace safety protocols, including proper food handling, storage, and waste disposal. - Collaborate with team members, manage multiple tasks efficiently, especially during peak service times to ensure smooth operations, and assist with replenishing stock and supplies. - Provide support during staff absences or high-demand periods, performing duties as assigned to meet business needs. - Perform tasks assigned by the Manager adhering to schedules and deadlines. - Follow company regulations, procedures, and technical guidelines, participate in quality control checks, report issues promptly, and provide updates or reports as required.

We offer: - An opportunity to be part of a dynamic and innovative company with ambitious growth plans.
- A friendly and supportive professional international team with diverse experience that values each member’s contribution. - Modern working conditions and professional-grade equipment. - Competitive pay. - Career opportunities and personal development. - Affordable meals in our restaurant bakery.

Other requirements: - Friendly, professional, and customer-oriented with strong communication skills to provide exceptional service and create a welcoming atmosphere.
- Detail-oriented and proactive, and flexible ensuring accuracy in orders, presentation standards, and anticipating customer needs. - Demonstrates integrity, and punctuality, a reliable team player with strong problem-solving skills, capable of working independently and collaboratively to ensure smooth operations. - Health-conscious and committed to upholding food safety, hygiene, and workplace safety protocols. - Proficiency in coffee preparation (espresso machines) and knowledge of basic alcoholic drink recipes and responsible service practices (preferred). - Experience in operating POS systems, handling payments, and managing accurate transactions efficiently (preferred). - A valid health certificate is required for food handling. - Physical stamina to stand, walk, and carry trays or supplies for extended periods. - Legal eligibility to meet age requirements for serving alcohol. - Flexibility to work evenings, weekends, and holidays as required. Details about the schedules will be provided during the recruitment process.

Part time (0.25 - 0.75)

title: Administratör, tillsvidare 80-100%
description:
Är du noggrann, ansvarstagande med god initiativförmåga? Har du intresse för löneräkning och kan eller vill lära dig mer om kommunala kollektivavtal och lönebestämmelser? Då kan du vara den vi söker!

**Om tjänsten**

Som administratör med fokus på löneräkning hos Finströms kommun har du en viktig roll i att säkerställa att våra medarbetare får rätt lön i rätt tid. Du räknar även lön åt våra bolag och samarbetskommuner. Totalt sett ungefär 220 utbetalningar per månad.

Arbetet innebär att du hanterar löneunderlag från kommunens olika verksamheter och ser till att uppgifterna är kompletta och korrekta innan lönekörning. Du behöver därför ha tålamod med att kontrollera, följa upp och ibland återkomma till verksamheterna för att få underlagen rätt.

Du arbetar med löner enligt kommunala kollektivavtal och andra bestämmelser som påverkar lönehanteringen. Arbetet kräver att du är beredd att sätta dig in i och kontinuerligt lära dig nya regler, avtal och rutiner.

Som löneräknare arbetar du både självständigt och tillsammans med kollegor inom ekonomi och HR. Du behöver kunna ta emot direktiv och arbeta enligt fastställda rutiner, samtidigt som du vågar ställa frågor när något är oklart eller inte stämmer.

**Vi söker dig som:**

- har en relevant utbildning och gedigen erfarenhet av lönehantering.

- är mycket noggrann och har öga för detaljer

- tar ansvar för att dina arbetsuppgifter blir korrekt utförda

- är uthållig och inte ger upp när underlagen behöver kontrolleras eller kompletteras

- tycker om rutiner, struktur och ordning

- har intresse för löner och vill förstå hur löner och ersättningar ska hanteras

- är intresserad av att lära dig kommunala kollektivavtal och de regler som styr lönehanteringen

- kan följa givna direktiv och fastställda rutiner

- har lätt för att samarbeta och kommunicera med kollegor och verksamheter

- har god datorvana och lätt för att lära dig digitala system

- Erfarenhet av Abilitas löneprogram är meriterande


**Vi erbjuder:**

- En tillsvidareanställning på 80-100 % av heltid från 19.10.2026 eller enligt överenskommelse. Lön enligt lönesättningspunkt 01TOI060 3 542,26 (100%)

- Arbetstid enligt byråarbetstid, 36,25 h/vecka (vid 100 %).

- En självständig och ansvarsfull roll i en stimulerande arbetsmiljö.

title: Service Project Manager
description:
**The opportunity**

We are looking for a Service Project Manager to join our Service Business Unit at Hitachi Energy in Finland. In this role, you will work in a hybrid setup, combining remote work, office-based work, and regularly site visits. You will oversee maintenance and service activities, review work on-site, and, when required, take an active role in leading and supporting maintenance work in the field. Regular customer meetings, project reviews, and stakeholder communication are also key aspects of the position.

The primary location for this role is Lappeenranta, Vaasa, or Vantaa, although other locations in Finland may be considered based on the candidate's qualifications. Travel is primarily within Finland.

**How You'll Make an Impact**

\- Managing service agreements with customers.

\- Providing sales and maintenance services related to power distribution in cooperation with Service Sales.

\- Acting as Project Manager for service projects.

\- Providing high-end specialist services.

\- Establishing long-term customer relationships by understanding customers' needs and demonstrating in-depth technical service solutions knowledge.

\- Serve as the primary point of contact for customers, ensuring a seamless and positive customer experience.

\- Building trust and maintaining sustainable relationships with customers by handling and coordinating warranty jobs, ensuring continuous communication and connecting them with our sales team.

**Your background**

\- B.Sc. in electrical engineering and relevant experience with power systems or other suitable education and vast experience with power systems.

\- Service oriented person with solution-oriented approach.

\- Basic IT skills as well as the ability to learn modern engineering applications.

\- High integrity and a strong safety first mindset.

\- Experience from power system service / maintenance.

\- Electrical Qualification Level 1, or eligibility to obtain the required certification is an advantage.

\- Understanding power quality, relay protection and communication is an advantage.

\- Understanding the basics of substation design is seen as an advantage.

\- Knowledge of commercial contracts is an advantage.

\- Excellent written and spoken skills in Finnish. Basic skills in English.

\- Quality-focused, customer-oriented team player who is willing to commit to long-term objectives and development.

\- Valid drivers license.

title: Asiakaspalvelija –liity Valoon tiimiin!
description:
Nautitko ihmisten auttamisesta ja mutkattoman asiakaspalvelun tarjoamisesta? Haluatko olla osa kasvavaa yritystä, jossa asiakaskokemus on kaiken keskiössä? Etsimme uusia asiakaspalvelijoita tuottamaan erinomaisia kohtaamisia Valoon asiakkaille osana motivoitunutta tiimiä.

Valonnopeudella kasvava Valoo on valokuitumarkkinoiden raikkain ja rohkein toimija, joka tuo laadukkaat, nopeat ja kestävät valokuituyhteydet yhä useampaan suomalaiseen kotiin. Asiakkaille tarjoamme markkinoiden parhaan nettiyhteyden - työntekijöille innostavan, lämpimän ja merkityksellisen työympäristön.

Mitä työpäivääsi kuuluu

Asiakaspalvelijana päätehtäväsi on asiakkaiden kontaktoiminen informatiivisella ja ystävällisellä otteella, asiakaspalvelun kasvoina toimiminen eri yhteydenpitokanavissa sekä luonnollisesti Valoon palveluiden myynti. Sinulla on tärkeä rooli Valoon ilosanoman jalkauttamisessa ja laadukkaan asiakaskokemuksen tuottamisessa. Työtä tehdään pääsääntöisesti Seinäjoen toimistolta käsin ja työpäiväsi sijoittuvat arkipäivisin klo 9-17 ja lauantaisin klo 10-16 väliselle ajalle.

Mitä toivomme sinulta

- Sujuvaa suomen kielen suullista ja kirjallista osaamista asiakaspalvelun laadun varmistamiseksi
- Positiivista ja rentoa palveluasennetta - tavoitteenasi on tuottaa mieleenpainuva asiakaskokemus
- Hyvää tilannetajua sekä kiinnostusta asiakasta kohtaan
- Tavoitteellista suhtautumista asiakaspalveluun
- Kykyä toimia erilaisissa vuorovaikutustilanteissa ja kuunnella asiakasta aidosti
- Iloista ja ratkaisukeskeistä lähestymistapaa
Aikaisempi kokemus asiakaspalvelusta on eduksesi, mutta ennen kaikkea etsimme hyvää tyyppiä oikealla asenteella.

Mitä tarjoamme sinulle

- Paikan kasvavassa yrityksessä ja reippaassa, rempseässä työporukassa
- Joustavan työn, jossa arvostetaan yhdessä tekemisen meininkiä
- Kattavan koulutuksen tehtävään -sinun ei tarvitse olla valmis ammattilainen
- Uudet ja raikkaat toimitilat inspiroivassa työympäristössä Seinäjoen keskustassa
- ICT-alan TES:n mukaisen kuukausipalkan 2 184,90 € / kk (osa-aikaisen tuntipalkka 13,83 €) sekä kannustavan bonusjärjestelmän
- Baronan työterveyspalvelut sekä lounasetu
Etsimme tiimiimme kokoaikaista (37,5 h/vko) asiakaspalvelijaa. Työvuorot sijoittuvat asiakaspalvelumme aukioloaikojen mukaisesti. Työt alkavat mahdollisimman pian sopivan henkilön löydyttyä!

Jätäthän hakemuksen pikimmiten, sillä käsittelemme hakemuksia koko rekrytointiprosessin ajan!

Rekrytointiin liittyviin kysymyksiin vastaa Baronan henkilöstökonsultti Anni Kivimäki, anni.kivimaki@barona.fi.

Lisätietoja tehtävästä saat Valoon Severi Mattilalta, puh. 0503218347

title: Johtava tietoarkkitehti
description:
Konsernipalvelujen toimiala, Talouspalvelut
Tiedolla johtamisen yksikkö
Neilikkatie 17 , 01300 Vantaa

Me VAKEssa rakennamme yhdessä rohkeasti hyvinvointialuetta, johon asukkaamme voivat luottaa. Haluamme olla vakaa edelläkävijä, joka uudistaa toimintaa avoimesti ja ihmislähtöisesti. Arvomme oikeudenmukaisuus, vastuullisuus ja rohkeus ohjaavat arjen työtämme. Tunnistatko näistä myös omat arvosi?

Tule sinäkin Hyvantekijät-joukkueeseemme!

Vantaan ja Keravan hyvinvointialue etsii johtavaa tietoarkkitehtia tiedolla johtamisen yksikköön vastaamaan erityisesti tiedolla johtamisen tietoarkkitehtuurin kokonaisuudesta ja sen pitkäjänteisestä kehittämisestä. Määrittelet tehtävässä mm. tietoalustan tietoarkkitehtuurin nyky- ja tavoitetilan, periaatteet, linjaukset ja standardit sekä ohjaat tietoalustan teknistä ja strategista kehittämistä.

Varmistat tehtävässäsi myös terveydenhuollon, sosiaalihuollon ja hallinnon tietomallien yhteentoimivuutta, sekä koordinoit tietojen mallinnusta ja tiedon laadun kehittämistä osana tiedolla johtamisen tiimiä.

Viet alustan teknisiä kehityshankkeita itsenäisesti eteenpäin ja toimit tiedolla johtamisen yksikön johtavana asiantuntijana tietoalustaan, tietovirtoihin, tietomalleihin, tiedon laatuun ja metatietoon liittyvissä kysymyksissä. Arvioit tehtävässä myös kehityshankkeiden ja uusien ratkaisujen vaikutuksia tietoalustan rakenteeseen, tietomalleihin, tiedon laatuun ja ylläpidettävyyteen sekä teet tarvittaessa poikkileikkaavia arkkitehtuuriratkaisuja.

Työskentelet tiiviissä yhteistyössä asiantuntijoiden, johdon, kehityshankkeiden ja teknologiakumppaneiden kanssa ja rakennat toimintamalleja, jotka mahdollistavat hallitun, laadukkaan ja skaalautuvan datan hyödyntämisen.

Odotamme

- Vahvaa kokemusta tietoarkkitehtuurista ja modernien tietoalustojen kehittämisestä
- Osaamista tietomallinnuksesta, tietovarastoinnista ja tietovirroista
- Kykyä hahmottaa laajoja teknisiä datakokonaisuuksia ja niiden riippuvuuksia
- Kokemusta Lakehouse-, Data Warehouse- ja Medallion-arkkitehtuureista
- Kokemusta moderneista pilviarkkitehtuuriratkaisuista

Arvostamme

- Kokemusta data governancesta sekä metadataratkaisuista
- Kokemusta työskentelystä Azure/Microsoft Fabric tietoalustojen kanssa
- Ymmärrystä ja kokemusta sosiaali- ja terveydenhuollon tietojen käsittelystä, tietomalleista tai tietojärjestelmistä

Työskentelet tehtävässä tiedolla johtamisen yksikössä, jonka toimisto sijaitsee Tikkurilassa. Vantaan ja Keravan hyvinvointialueella on käytössä hybridityömalli, joten voit työskennellä osittain myös etänä.

Miksi Vantaan ja Keravan hyvinvointialue?

Meillä hyvinvointi ja arjen sujuvuus ovat aidosti tärkeitä. Tarjoamme lounasedun sekä 400 euron Epassi-edun liikuntaan, kulttuuriin, hyvinvointiin tai työmatkoihin. Lisäksi hyvinvointiasi tukevat lakisääteiset työterveyspalvelumme.

Olemme ihmisläheinen organisaatio, jossa kehitämme toimintaa rohkeasti ja yhdessä. Meillä johtaminen on lupaus selkeistä tavoitteista, arvostavasta kohtaamisesta ja rohkeasta yhdessä uudistamisesta.

Saat selkeän näkymän omaan työhösi sekä mahdollisuuksia kokeilla ja kehittää uusia tapoja tehdä työtä. Tarjoamme mahdollisuuksia myös oman osaamisesi vahvistamiseen ja urasi kehittämiseen. Teemme merkityksellistä työtä joka päivä: autamme, hoidamme ja pelastamme.

title: Product Engineer (Mechanical Design), Dieffenbacher / Lahti, Nastola
description:
About the role

Dieffenbacher is a German, globally operating machinery manufacturer focusing on the design and manufacture of press systems and complete production lines for the panel industry.

In this role, you will play a key part as a member of a \~20-person mechanical design team in Nastola. You will be responsible for specific equipment entities and perform related design work. You will work in close cooperation with automation designers and the chief mechanical designer to ensure projects progress smoothly. Additionally, you will guide external consultants and ensure the quality of the work.

Every project brings something new, giving you the opportunity to challenge yourself with new practices and possibilities.

Why Join Us?
Our mechanical engineering relies strongly on our own expert know-how and a broad network of specialists. We offer you a responsible and diverse role where you can solve interesting technical challenges. With us, you will work in a close-knit atmosphere from the drafting board straight into practice.

Work tasks
- Equipment Responsibility: You will be responsible for designated equipment packages, overseeing equipment improvements, cost tracking, supporting project planning, and equipment documentation.
- Design: You will design custom customer assignments (heavy structures) using Creo & AutoCAD.
- Quality Assurance and Partner Guidance: You will direct design work done by consultants and ensure the output meets high quality standards.
- Practical Collaboration and Inspections: You will collaborate with the workshops, automation design, and R&D, perform equipment inspections, and communicate with customers as needed.
- Fieldwork: You will participate in troubleshooting at installation sites when necessary (site visits approx. 5–15 days per year).

We are looking for

- B.Sc. or M.Sc. in Mechanical Engineering.
- Solid design experience (preferably over 4 years) in heavy structures (1–20 t), machinery, and machine parts manufactured by welding or machining.
- Fluent English skills.
- Ability to work full-time at the Nastola office during the trial period. Option for 2 remote workdays per week after the trial period.
- Readiness to travel abroad approx. 5–15 days per year.
- Accountability, a proactive and precise working style, and good interpersonal skills.

Considered an Advantage:

title: Teollisuuden kunnossapitoasentaja, Eckes-Granini Finland Oy Ab, Turku
description:
_Eckes-Granini Finland Oy Ab:n tuotemerkit Marli, Mehukatti, Juissi, Vital, Natur, God Morgon ja Brazil ovat luonnollinen osa suomalaisten arkea. Jokaisella meistä on mehujen joukossa omat suosikkituotteemme ja monet niistä tuovat mieleen mukavan nostalgisia muistoja._

_Eckes-Granini Finland Oy Ab on osa Euroopan johtavaa mehuliiketoimintakonsernia Eckes-Granini Group GmbH:ta, jonka pääkonttori sijaitsee Saksassa. Eckes-Granini Finlandin juomatehdas sekä muut liiketoiminnot sijaitsevat Turussa. Tavoitteemme on olla Suomen vastuullisin mehutalo_.

**Eckes-Granini Finland Oy Ab etsii teollisuuden kunnossapitoasentajaa Turun tuotantolaitokselle kolmivuorotyöhön.**

Teollisuuden kunnossapitoasentajana vastaat tuotantolaitteiden ja automaatiojärjestelmien toimivuudesta ja kehittämisestä. Työ on monipuolinen ja sisältää sekä kunnossapidon että tuotannon kehittämisen tehtäviä.

**Tehtävänkuva**

· Mekaanisten ja sähköautomaatioon liittyvien vikojen korjaus sekä häiriöiden poisto koko tuotannon ja logistiikan alueella

· Ennakkohuoltojen toteutus

· Tuotantolinjojen kehittäminen ja parantaminen yhteistyössä esihenkilösi, muiden tuotantoasentajien sekä kunnossapitoasentajien kanssa

**Edellytämme sinulta**

· Sähkö- ja automaatioalan ammatillista koulutusta tai riittävää kokemusta teollisuuden automaatiotehtävistä

· Halua ja kykyä itsenäiseen työskentelyyn

· Hyviä ongelmanratkaisutaitoja

· Yhteistyökykyä muun henkilöstömme sekä urakoitsijoiden henkilöstön kanssa

Sähkö- ja automaatiotekniikan osaaminen on tehtävässä keskeinen perusvaatimus. Yrityksellä on mahdollisuus perehdyttää ja kouluttaa tehtävän mekaanisiin osa-alueisiin sekä laitteisiin, mutta sähkö- ja automaatiotekniikan perustaidot tulisi hakijalla olla jo valmiiksi hallussa.

**Tarjoamme**

· Vakituisen työn kansainvälisessä yrityksessä kaikkien suomalaisten tuntemien tuotebrändien parissa

· Yrityksen palkkausjärjestelmän mukaisen palkkauksen, kattavan sairaskuluvakuutuksen sekä liikunta- ja kulttuuriedun

· Monipuolisen ja vastuullisen tehtävän modernissa tuotantoympäristössä

· Hyvät mahdollisuudet kehittyä työssäsi

**Palkkaus**

Tehtävän palkkahaarukka on 15,13 €/h - 18,20 €/h. Huomioimme palkkauksessa henkilön osoittaman osaamisen sekä työkokemuksen. Lisäksi palkkaukseen vaikuttavat TES:n mukaiset ilta- ja yötyölisät, yrityskohtainen kolmivuorolisä sekä työsuhteen aikana osoitettu monityötaitoisuus.

_Työkuutio toimii rekrytoinnissa Eckes-Granini Finland Oy Ab:n kumppanina. Pyydämme lähettämään hakemuksen ja CV:n osoitteeseen toimisto@tyokuutio.fi viimeistään 10.9.2026 mennessä. Aloitamme hakemusten läpikäynnin ja haastattelut jo hakuaikana ja täytämme paikan sopivan ehdokkaan löytyessä – toimi siis ripeästi!_

title: Försäljingsförhandlare
description:
För att förstärka vårt försäljarteam söker vi nya heltids försäljningsagenter. Tillsammans med våra samarbetspartners vill vi göra det möjligt för varje arbetstagare att få sälja och marknadsföra den produkt som passar bäst. Du kan själv påverka valet av produkt. Våra produkter är välkända och vi får kundregister från våra samarbetspartners, som är:

Otavamedia Oy Sanoma Magazines Bonnier Publications Terramedia

Vi betalar nya anställda 10 euro i timmen. Du kan tjäna ännu mer enligt vår vanliga ersättningsmodell, men du får minst 10 euro i timmen oavsett försäljningsresultat.

Du behöver ingen tidigare arbetserfarenhet, vi utbildar var och en med vår 30-åriga arbetserfarenhet och yrkeskunnighet. För oss är ålder bara en siffra och i vårt arbetsteam erbjuds bra arbetsro för såväl ungdomar som seniorer.

Heltidsarbetare arbetar 7 timmar varje dag antingen morgon- eller kvällsskift. Till arbetsskiften tar vi hänsyn till varje arbetares personliga behov och du får också själv vara med och påverka dina skift.

Vi skolar varje arbetare enskilt och du får personlig rådgivning under hela din arbetstid. Vår personals trivsel och välbefinnande är viktig för oss så vi försäkrar oss om att alla arbetstagare trivs arbeta hos oss.

Om du söker en ny riktning i livet och vill lära dig ett nytt yrke, så erbjuder vi också möjlighet för läroavtalsutbildning. Du får både lön och arbetserfarenhet, under merkonom-utbildningen.

HL-Family Oy belönades med Platinum AAA-certifikatet, vilket betyder att vi har AAA-klassats 10 år i rad. Sama certifikatet har bara delats ut till mindre av en tusendel av finländska företag.

Vi ringer upp alla som skickar in en ansökan. Om du tar kontakt per telefon tar kontorets förman gärna emot ditt samtal. Du kan skicka en friformad ansökan direkt till vår e-post eller fylla i ansöknings-formuläret på vår webbplats https://hl-family.fi/rekrytointi/

title: Laboratory Sales Manager to GC Nordic
description:
GC Corporation was founded in 1921 in Japan and has developed itself into one of the most prominent companies in the development, production and distribution of a very wide range of dental products. GC Europe (Leuven, Belgium) supports and leads our different sales offices and dealers in EMEA territory. Our Nordic Team is currently looking for a

Laboratory Sales Manager, NordicPurpose of the job

As a Laboratory Sales Manager you will drive sales growth and business development for our laboratory and CAD/CAM product portfolio across the Nordic region. The ideal candidate brings strong commercial experience within the dental laboratory sector and a solid understanding of digital CAD/CAM workflows used in laboratories and dental clinics.

Your Role

    

Lead and develop our business in laboratory and CAD/CAM segment: Drive sales and business development activities across Nordic, ensuring achievement of sales targets and growth objectives. Geographically main focus is on Sweden, Norway and Denmark.

    

Account management: Build and maintain strong relationships with dental laboratories, digitally focused distributors, and key opinion leaders.

    

Product trainings and presentations: Conduct product demonstrations and training sessions that showcase customer-focused solutions, drive sales growth, and clearly demonstrate the value of the GC portfolio.

    

Market insights: Stay up-to-date with market trends, customer needs, and competitor activities to identify opportunities and mitigate challenges.

    

Team collaboration: Support and work closely with the broader GC Nordic team to ensure alignment and knowledge-sharing across markets.

What You Bring?

    

Proven experience (minimum 4 years) within the dental laboratory industry, including CAD/CAM workflows, ideally gained in a sales role.

    

Strong relationship-building and negotiation skills.

    

Results-oriented and proactive person who enjoys working independently in a fast-paced environment where multiple priorities need to be managed simultaneously.

    

Excellent communication skills in Swedish and English.

    

Willingness to travel on weekly basis, being 60%-80% of the working time in the field.

    

Resident of Sweden (working remote).

Why Join GC Nordic?

• An opportunity to play a pivotal role in shaping our growth journey in the Nordic region.

• A vibrant company culture rooted in mutual respect, camaraderie, and a shared drive for success.

• A supportive team environment that values joy and celebrates collective and individual achievements.

• Chance to enjoy autonomy in your role, with the freedom to innovate and inspire across our various territories.

• An opportunity to contribute to a better, healthier world in collaboration with colleagues who are passionate about what they do.

🚀 Take your next career step✅ Apply without CV today, and supplement with an updated CV in English later.

📅 Application deadline: 2026-09-22

This recruitment is handled by GC Nordic and Odonti. Odonti handles the initial application and the first selection process and GC handles the second selections, interviews and hiring process.

If you have any questions please contact

Jashar Samadi at Odonti (hej@odonti.se) or Jyrki Kurokallio at GC (jyrki.kurokallio@gc.dental)

About Odonti

Odonti is a recruitment and staffing company in the dental industry. We recruit for permanent positions, and hire out consultants for time-limited assignments, based entirely on the consultants' availability and wishes.

Over 10,000 dental professionals in Sweden have connected and are in our candidate database and network. Feel free to connect with us at 👉🏼 Odonti.se

Your profile is handled confidentially according to GDPR and is never shared without your approval.

title: Strategic Project Manager
description:
Drive Strategy. Lead Growth. Make an Impact.

Instabee is changing the way last-mile deliveries work in Europe. We make online shopping faster, smarter, and more convenient. In Finland, we’ve scaled quickly—but we’re just getting started. Now, we need a strategic powerhouse to help shape our expansion, drive high-impact projects, and turn opportunities into growth.

If you’re an analytical problem solver who thrives on tackling complex business challenges, working cross-functionally, and translating strategy into execution, let’s talk.

What You’ll Do 📈 Shape the Strategy – Assess market opportunities, identify challenges, and help define the roadmap for Instabee Finland’s growth.

🔍 Lead High-Impact Projects – Take ownership of complex, cross-functional initiatives that drive business performance and scale our operations.

🤝 Work with Leadership – Collaborate closely with the Country Manager and senior team to set targets and implement strategic plans.

📊 Use Data to Drive Decisions – Monitor performance, track key business metrics, and adjust strategies based on insights.

⚡ Remove Roadblocks – Identify challenges, resolve bottlenecks, and ensure our strategic initiatives run smoothly.

🚀 Think Big, Plan for the Future – We’re looking for someone with the ambition and potential to grow into a larger leadership role over time.

Who You Are

✅ A Strategic Thinker with a Commercial Edge – You have experience in strategy, management consulting, investment banking, or business development. Start-up/scale-up experience is a bonus.

✅ A Problem-Solver Who Gets Things Done – You thrive in ambiguity, take ownership, and know how to move projects forward.

✅ A Data-Driven Decision Maker – You use insights, analytics, and performance tracking to sharpen your approach and drive measurable impact.

✅ An Effective Communicator – You can turn complex ideas into clear, actionable plans and collaborate across teams.

✅ Experience Matters Most, but Education Helps – you have probably Master’s degree in business, economics, engineering, or a related field

✅ Fluent in English (Finnish is a bonus) – You can communicate clearly and persuasively in a fast-moving, international environment.

Why Instabee?

🌍 Join a Fast-Growing Company – Be part of a team that’s reshaping e-commerce logistics in Europe.

🚀 Advance Your Career – This role is built for growth, with a path toward broader leadership.

🏢 Work Flexibly – Hybrid setup with a modern Helsinki office centrally located in Kluuvi.

💡 Work with Cutting-Edge Tech – Shape the future of logistics with smart, data-driven solutions.

🎉 A Culture That Values Action – We move fast, make decisions quickly, and focus on what works.

Ready to Make an Impact? We’re looking for someone who’s ready to own projects, drive strategy, and shape the future of Instabee in Finland. If that’s you, apply today.

About Instabee

Instabee was founded in 2022 after combining Budbee and Instabox — two leading last-mile delivery companies with three consumer-facing brands: Budbee, Instabox and Porterbuddy. Instabee is present in six countries, serving thousands of online merchants, including ASOS, Zalando, Inditex and H&M and is on track to become the most admired European e-commerce enabler.

In Finland, Budbee has been a key player since 2018 — and we’re moving fast.

title: Senior Software Engineers and Architects
description:
Nolwenture was established in 2012 and continues to grow and adapt, with an exciting portfolio of national and international clients across many industry sectors. We work together to make our clients' vision a reality and enable their core operations to be more efficient. In 2025 we became part of the ProVerse Group, who were a customer and for whom we continue to work with to create immersive experiences, with the communication and visualisation needed for remote operations. Nolwenture remains independent to offer a wide range of software development services. We are now looking for:

**Senior Software Engineers and Architects**

The Senior Software Engineers at Nolwenture are responsible for supporting both client and internal projects, playing to the individual's strengths within the project team – in the role of Lead Developer, Product Owner or Project Manager.

As a senior developer, you will work with modern technologies that are kept up-to-date by the entire team's contributions in order to keep our best practices current and ahead of the game. You will also support mid-level, junior and trainee level team members with their project tasks and broader learning and development.

You will work directly with our clients throughout the project lifecycle; gathering requirements, managing expectations, and helping to plan and coordinate delivery alongside the wider team.

For even more experienced and skilled candidates we also offer Architect level appointments.

**Why work with us?**

We are more than just software coders. At the core of our value proposition is the strength of our team, highly experienced and with diverse backgrounds and interests. We invest in our people, tools and processes, technical skills and capabilities.

Our shared mindset and strong ethics are reflected in our working culture. Everyone has a voice across the company, as it should be in a creative industry, where we have trust and a safe environment to innovate.

**Requirements**

We expect you to

- possess a strong understanding about software development

- have a desire to work on both web and mobile applications

- comply with our documentation processes and best practices

- be fluent in English as it is our operating language

- have good communication skills; at Nolwenture we work very closely with our clients

- be comfortable working directly with clients and confident taking on light project management responsibilities (e.g. previous experience as a Scrum Product Owner or had Scrum Master duties or having run sessions on story mapping or requirement gathering)

- be willing to adapt to our ways, learn new stuff and challenge yourself

- (and this is important!) readily ask others for help and return help where needed

- be familiar with, or keen to work with, Claude Code and other AI-assisted development tools as part of our everyday workflow


We work with a variety of programming languages, but a JavaScript background will suit us well as we use a lot of NodeJS, JavaScript, TypeScript, React and React Native.

You will benefit from knowing additional languages (e.g. Swift, Kotlin and Python) and being familiar with Scrum project methodology and tools within the Atlassian suite (Jira, Tempo, Confluence). A background in areas such as Unity, WebRTC stream processing, DevOps, UI, robotics or GIS, or other data visualisation and physics / simulations experience, DB (sql/postgres etc.), administration (DBA) is of interest to us too.

Furthermore, an interest or experience in AI/ML will be highly appreciated.

**Work location**

Joensuu headquarters ideally. Other possible locations include Kuopio and Helsinki, and working remotely is also a long-term option.

**How to apply**

We are only accepting applications from candidates with a Finnish residence permit for work or EU/EEA/Swiss citizenship. Please send an email with a covering note along with your CV to recruitment@nolwenture.com and we will explain the process further from there onwards.

**_Want to know more about us? Please visit our website for further information https://nolwenture.com/_**

title: Software Test Engineers – Trainee to Mid-Level (QA Focus)
description:
Nolwenture was established in 2012 and continues to grow and adapt, with an exciting portfolio of national and international clients across many industry sectors. We work together to make our clients' vision a reality and enable their core operations to be more efficient. In 2025 we became part of the ProVerse Group, who were a customer and for whom we continue to work with to create immersive experiences, with the communication and visualisation needed for remote operations. Nolwenture remains independent to offer a wide range of software development services. We are now looking for:

**Software Test Engineers – Trainee to Mid-Level (QA Focus)**

The Test Engineers at Nolwenture play a key role in our project teams, working closely with developers, Product Owners and clients to make sure the software we build is reliable, high quality and fit for purpose. This role is open to candidates ranging from trainee level, just starting out in their QA career, through to mid-level engineers with a few years of testing experience.

You will design and execute test plans and test cases, perform manual and automated testing across our web and mobile applications, and help build out our automated test suites and CI/CD test pipelines alongside the rest of the team.

As you grow with us, you'll take on more responsibility for planning testing activities, liaising directly with clients on quality and acceptance criteria, and supporting the project team with light project coordination; there is a genuine path here into more senior QA, project management or engineering roles.

**Why work with us?**

We are more than just software coders. At the core of our value proposition is the strength of our team, highly experienced and with diverse backgrounds and interests. We invest in our people, tools and processes, technical skills and capabilities.

Our shared mindset and strong ethics are reflected in our working culture. Everyone has a voice across the company, as it should be in a creative industry, where we have trust and a safe environment to innovate.

**Requirements**

We expect you to

- have an interest in, or some experience with, software testing and quality assurance (trainee and junior candidates welcome – we will support your development)

- understand, or be keen to learn, testing fundamentals: test case design, exploratory testing, regression testing and bug reporting

- be comfortable working with, or eager to learn, test automation tools and frameworks such as Jest, Cypress, Playwright, Selenium or Appium

- have some familiarity with API testing tools (e.g. Postman) and issue tracking in Jira

- comply with our documentation processes and best practices

- be fluent in English as it is our operating language

- have good communication skills and be comfortable working directly with our clients, including supporting light project management tasks as you gain experience (e.g. assisting with story mapping, requirement gathering or sprint and task coordination)

- be willing to adapt to our ways, learn new things and challenge yourself

- (and this is important!) readily ask others for help and return help where needed

- a background in development and coding

- be familiar with, or keen to work with, Claude Code and other AI-assisted tools as part of our everyday workflow


Our engineering team works mainly in NodeJS, JavaScript, TypeScript, React and React Native, so exposure to testing within a JavaScript-based stack is a bonus, though not essential – we're happy to teach the specifics.

You will benefit from being familiar with Scrum project methodology and tools within the Atlassian suite (Jira, Tempo, Confluence). Testing experience within games, simulation or data visualisation environments (e.g. Unity, WebRTC stream processing, DevOps, UI, robotics or GIS) is also of interest to us.

Furthermore, an interest in AI/ML, or in exploring how AI tools can support testing and quality assurance, will be highly appreciated.

**Work location**

Joensuu headquarters. Other possible locations include Kuopio and Helsinki, and working remotely is also a long-term option.

**How to apply**

We are only accepting applications from candidates with a Finnish residence permit for work or EU/EEA/Swiss citizenship. Please send an email with a covering note along with your CV to recruitment@nolwenture.com and we will explain the process further from there onwards.

**_Want to know more about us? Please visit our website for further information https://nolwenture.com/_**

title: Ompelija
description:
Ompelimon yrittäjä on jäämässä eläkkeelle vuoden vaihteessa ja etsii yritystoimen jatkajaa.

Tarvittaessa nykyinen yrittäjä voi myydä liiketilan laitteet uudelle yrittäjälle.

Edellytetään hyviä ammattitaitoja monipuolisista ompelijan tehtävistä: korjausompelu, tarvittaessa mittatilaustyöt (sisältäen kaavoitustyöt), sovitus. Asiakastöitä on niin naisten- kuin miestenmuodin puolelta.

Ompelimo on toiminut pitkään samassa osoitteessa ja sillä on kiinteä asiakaskunta.

Liiketilalla on iso näyteikkuna, joten sen somistus on osa yrittäjän työnkuvaa.

Liiketila sijaitsee Helsingin Töölössä osoitteessa Ruusulankatu 19.

Kiinnostuitko? Jos haluat keskustella lisää, soita minulle: Anita Berg / 040-5288315.

title: Mekaanikko Tampereelle
description:
Etsimme mekaanikkoa Tampereen tiimiimme.

title: Eräopas
description:
Haemme Eräoppaita Northern Lights Village Leville! Etsimme tiimiimme innostavia ja ystävällisiä eräoppaita Northern Lights Village Leville. Tämä työ sopii sinulle, joka olet intohimoinen luonnosta, ulkoilusta ja seikkailuista.

Työnkuvaasi kuuluu asiakkaiden lämmin vastaanotto Safaritalossa ja heidän avustamisensa. Johdat ulkoiluaktiviteetteja ja retkiä asiakkaiden kiinnostuksen ja kokemustason mukaisesti, varmistaen samalla kaikkien osallistujien turvallisuuden ja mukavuuden, sekä tarvittaessa ensiavun. Jaat laajaa tietoa paikallisesta luonnosta, maantiedosta ja kulttuurista sekä kuvaat revontulia asiakkaiden kanssa. Huolehdit myös ulkoiluvälineiden ja -laitteiden huollosta sekä safaritalon siisteydestä.

Odotamme sinulta kokemusta eräoppaana tai vastaavasta roolista, voimassa olevaa B-ajokorttia, sujuvaa suullista ja kirjallista englannin kielen taitoa sekä ensiapukorttia. Sinulla on erinomaiset viestintä- ja vuorovaikutustaidot, olet joustava työskentelemään eri vuoroissa (iltaisin, viikonloppuisin ja pyhäpäivinä) ja pystyt työskentelemään ulkona kylmissä olosuhteissa. Olet luonteeltasi ystävällinen ja kykenet työskentelemään niin itsenäisesti kuin tiimissäkin.

Eduksi katsomme eräopetuksen koulutuksen tai vastaavan alan tutkinnon, valokuvausosaamisen, aikaisemman asiakaspalvelukokemuksen sekä muiden kielten taidon englannin lisäksi.

Mitä tarjoamme: Kilpailukykyinen palkka Positiivinen ja tukeva työympäristö NLV:n työsuhde-edut

Palkka, kesto ja edut: Työ alkaa marraskuussa ja päättyy tammikuun puolessa välissä tai maalis- / huhtikuussa Vähintään 90 tuntia / 3 vkon jaksossa Tuntipalkka neuvotellaan haastattelussa osaamisen ja kokemuksen mukaan Muita etuja työehtosopimuksen mukaisesti Tarvittaessa tarjoamme majoituksen jaetussa huoneessa 300€ /kk

Ennen hakemista varmista, että sinulla on oikeus työskennellä Suomessa.

Tule mukaan tekemään asiakkaidemme lomasta unohtumaton elämys ja täytä hakemus!

title: SprinDrive: Manufacturing Engineer (Electromechanics)
description:
**Type:** Full-time, permanent

**Location:** Laserkatu 6, 53850 Lappeenranta, Finland

**Application deadline:** 24.9.2026

Want to bridge the gap between engineering and manufacturing in cutting-edge magnetic bearing technology?

**What will you be doing?**

SpinDrive is looking for a Manufacturing Engineer to join its R&D team in Lappeenranta. In this role, youll support the development and production of Active Magnetic Bearing (AMB) components by combining practical assembly work with manufacturing development, workstation setup, documentation, and supplier coordination. You will report to SpinDrives Lead Mechanical Engineer and collaborate closely with mechanical and electrical engineers, suppliers, and supply chain stakeholders.

A key part of the role is to help establish and organize SpinDrives own practical test assembly and test winding capabilities. As SpinDrive develops its in-house workshop, you will help define the workspace, identify and source suitable tools, equipment, measuring instruments, consumables, insulation materials, and other workshop requirements as well as establish practical ways of working. You will use your industrial experience and knowledge of local suppliers and subcontractors to help us build an efficient and well-organized manufacturing environment.

The role includes hands-on coil winding and related electrical assembly, but it is broader than winding alone. We are looking for a practical manufacturing professional who can take ownership of day-to-day assembly test activities, organize the workstation and tooling, and support engineers during prototype builds. Serial production is later outsourced to SpinDrive international subcontractors, and you will help to support technical discussions with them.

**Key responsibilities:**

In this role, you will test, manufacture, and improve precision coil winding solutions for Active Magnetic Bearing (AMB) components while supporting prototype production and assembly activities. You will perform test coil winding, preparation, soldering, insulation, impregnation, and related assembly processes, while helping establish and organize the required workspace, tooling, equipment, materials, and workflows.

Working closely with the engineering team, you will develop practical fixtures, tooling, work instructions, and assembly methods, interpret technical documentation, and provide feedback on manufacturability. You will establish appropriate quality, testing, documentation, and traceability practices and collaborate with local suppliers and subcontractors to source equipment, materials, tooling, and manufacturing services. You will also support technical discussions with SpinDrive international subcontractors for volume manufacturing.

**What kind of person thrives in this role and why?**

You might be the person we are looking for if you enjoy hands-on technical work and taking responsibility for making a workshop and manufacturing process work in practice. You are comfortable operating in an environment where processes, tooling, and workspaces are still being developed, and you enjoy finding practical solutions rather than waiting for predefined procedures.

We especially value practical manufacturing experience, good organizational skills, initiative, and the ability to work independently while communicating effectively with engineers and suppliers. Experience with local Finnish manufacturing suppliers and subcontractors is particularly valuable, as the role will involve building the practical infrastructure around our in-house assembly activities.

**We hope you have:**

- At least 3 years of practical experience in industrial manufacturing, assembly, maintenance, electrical or mechanical production, or related hands-on work.

- Experience with electrical motors, coils, wires, electrical components, or similar industrial equipment.

- Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, electrical schematics, and manufacturing documentation. Experience organizing workspaces, production areas, tooling, equipment and materials.

- Experience sourcing or working with local suppliers, subcontractors, tools, equipment, or manufacturing services.

- Good communication skills and full working proficiency in English.

- Solution-oriented, self-driven, and well-organized working style.

- Willingness to perform hands-on work while also taking ownership of broader manufacturing and workshop-development activities.


**We consider as an asset:**

- Experience with precision coil winding, electric motor manufacturing, or electrical assembly.

- Experience developing or improving tooling, fixtures, insulation, winding, or assembly methods.

- Established knowledge of Finnish/local suppliers for industrial tools, equipment, materials, machining, fabrication or specialist manufacturing services.

- Experience with prototype manufacturing and low-volume production.

- Experience in international manufacturing environments.

- Experience with CAD tools or the ability to work effectively with CAD-based technical documentation.


**What SpinDrive offers you:**

- Work closely with experienced engineers developing next-generation magnetic bearing technology for industrial applications

- Shape practical manufacturing solutions where your hands-on expertise has a direct impact on product quality

- Grow your technical skills in an international team collaborating across engineering, R&D, and supplier networks

- Travel internationally and build relationships with manufacturing partners across Europe

- Join a scaling technology company where you can contribute beyond a narrow role definition

- The compensation will include the salary and stock options to share the benefits of SpinDrives growth.


**Practicalities:**

This is a full-time and permanent position, and you will be employed directly by SpinDrive Oy. The role is based mainly onsite in Lappeenranta, Finland, and includes some travel to supplier locations. We hope you can work mainly from the office, with the possibility for occasional remote workdays. The onboarding period will take place primarily in Lappeenranta and is expected to last approximately 2–3 months. The start date is as soon as possible, but the latest in November 2026.

title: Power Electronics Simulation Engineer, Tampere
description:
About the role

This is a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of power electronics and electrical grid technology. You will join a niche team of experts where your work directly impacts how high-voltage grids operate globally.

In this position, you will be part of the NPI (New Product Introduction) team, focusing on the simulation and validation of advanced grid solutions. Your main tool will be the RTDS (Real-Time Digital Simulator), and your daily work involves Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) simulations. Because the role requires hands-on management of RTDS hardware and laboratory equipment, this position is fully office/lab-based in Tampere.

Work tasks

Your main responsibilities include:
- Running and designing Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) simulations.
- Managing and developing RTDS hardware setups.
- Using Matlab & Simulink for simulation and building test benches.
- Analyzing fault situations and system performance in a high-voltage grid context.
- Collaborating closely with design engineers to validate control systems.

You are offered...
- Long-term Mentorship: A thorough and supportive onboarding process into a niche technology area.
- International Opportunities: While the base role is in Tampere, there is a possibility for global site assignments (1–2 years down the line) for those interested in international travel.
- Cutting-edge Tech: Access to the latest simulation hardware and the chance to work on large-scale grid projects.

We are looking for

We value potential and learning agility above all else. This is a highly specialized field, and we are prepared to provide long-term onboarding for the right person. Whether you are a recent graduate with a strong academic background or a professional looking to pivot into grid technology, your ability to grasp complex systems is what matters.

Requirements:
- Technical Education: A University degree (M.Sc.) in Electrical Engineering, Power Electronics, or Control Engineering.
- Control Theory: A deep understanding of the interface between power electronics and the electrical grid (control side expertise is critical).
- Software Tools: Proficiency in Matlab & Simulink.
- Communication: Ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly in English (our primary working language).
- Location: Readiness to work onsite in Tampere (no remote work option due to hardware requirements).

We appreciate if you'll have...
- Previous experience with RTDS, HIL testing, or high-voltage laboratories.
- Familiarity with the power electronics industry

Our recruitment process

This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our clients wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.

Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.
