title: Research Assistant
description:
The iCell (Immune Cell Therapy Research Group) at the Finnish Red Cross Blood Service, Research and Development, invites applications for a one-year fixed-term position as a Research Assistant. Our laboratory is located at the Biomedicum 1, Helsinki.
The iCell research group at Finnish Red Cross Blood Service is a dynamic research group dedicated to advancing novel immunotherapies against cancer. Our primary interest lies in the research and development of CAR-T and CAR-NK cell therapies, aiming at addressing current clinical needs through innovative product development.

Our research focuses on NK cell modifications, expansion, persistence, and killing efficacy. We employ various techniques, including primary cell culture, base editing, flow cytometry, lentiviral transduction, cytotoxic assays, and in vivo models.

We have an opening for a motivated Research Assistant to work on genetic modifications and gene editing of CAR-NK cells to enhance their efficacy against cancer.

Main responsibilities

Performing laboratory experiments related to immune cell engineering and characterization
Conducting cell culture, molecular biology, and gene editing procedures
Assisting in data collection and documentation
Maintaining laboratory records and inventories
Supporting laboratory organization, equipment maintenance, and general operations
Collaborating with researchers and other team members in ongoing projects

Qualifications

The successful candidate holds a relevant degree in life sciences, biotechnology, biomedicine, or a related field and has practical laboratory experience, particularly in cell culture techniques.

Experience in one or more of the following areas is considered an advantage:
Immunology
Molecular biology
Gene editing technologies
GLP/GMP-compliant laboratory work

Bioinformatics expertise is considered an additional asset when combined with experience in one or more of the areas listed above.

The ideal candidate is a self-motivated and proactive individual with a strong interest in laboratory-based research and development. They should be eager to learn new methods and technologies and possess excellent collaboration and communication skills.

What we offer

At the Blood Service, you will become part of a unique chain of help with voluntary donors and healthcare staff. We offer you an interesting and meaningful task as part of a motivated and professional team. Comprehensive orientation and support from your supervisor and team will help you get started in your work and develop in your own role. The well-being of our employees is particularly important to us: we invest in the well-being of our personnel e.g. by offering a wide range of sports and well-being benefits (see the list of benefits below). Read more about Blood Service as a workplace [here.](https://www.veripalvelu.fi/en/work-with-us/)

The position has a fixed term of one year with the possibility of extension subject to project funding.

The salary for this position is determined in accordance with the Collective Agreement for the Terveyspalveluala. The position is classified in Salary Grade 4, with a base salary of EUR 2847,83 per month for a full-time employee. In addition to the base salary, remuneration includes a personal salary component, which incorporates a length-of-service guarantee.

In this position, lentiviruses are handled, which might cause a health risk to an HIV-positive person. Therefore, this position is not suitable for an HIV-positive person, and the selected individual must regularly present an acceptable statement from occupational health services regarding their medical fitness.

How to apply and inquiries

In your application, please detail your experimental skills in cell culture, immunology, molecular biology, GLP/GMP-work, and gene editing, the duration of your experience with these techniques, and your motivation for research, development and lab work. Include preferably two possible references.

For more information on the position, please contact iCell group leader Helka Göös (helka.goos@bloodservice.fi).
Please submit your application through our electronic recruitment system. Applications submitted by email will not be considered.


Benefits


- Culture, sports, well-being and commuting benefits (Epassi)

- Extended occupational health care

- Lunch benefit

- Commuting exercise incentive

- Long vacations

- Employee sports benefits



Finnish Red Cross Blood Service

The Finnish Red Cross Blood Service provides hospitals with safe and effective blood products and laboratory services that are essential for patient care. We also maintain the Stem Cell Registry and the Blood Service Biobank.

The Finnish Red Cross Blood Service is a non-profit organization. Our annual budget is approximately EUR 60 million, and we employ around 500 people.

The Finnish Red Cross Blood Service conducts active scientific research to advance biomedical knowledge in our areas of expertise. Read more about our Research Strategy [here](https://www.veripalvelu.fi/en/research/research-strategy/).

title: Purchaser
description:
Are you motivated by keeping materials moving, solving supply challenges and working closely with suppliers?

In this role, you will play an important part in ensuring material availability and reliable supply chain execution across Tanas operations.



Your responsibilities:

As a Purchaser, you are responsible for day-to-day operational purchasing. You ensure that materials and components are ordered, confirmed and delivered according to business needs, supplier agreements and production requirements.

You create, maintain and follow up purchase orders based on material demand, purchase requisitions, stock requirements and agreed supplier terms. You actively monitor supplier confirmations, delivery schedules and open orders, and work proactively to secure timely deliveries.

You also maintain accurate purchasing information in our ERP system and support the resolution of discrepancies between invoices, receipts and purchase orders.

You communicate regularly with suppliers to follow order status, delivery schedules, shortages, and possible changes. When needed, you coordinate corrective actions, identify delivery risks and escalate critical shortages, delays or supplier performance issues to the relevant stakeholders.

You collaborate closely with internal stakeholders in operations, production, logistics, finance and other relevant functions, as well as with external suppliers. Through your work, you help ensure that information flows smoothly and operations can run reliably across the organization.



What we expect from you:

We are looking for someone with relevant education in supply chain management, logistics, business administration, engineering or a related field. Equivalent practical experience may also provide a strong foundation for succeeding in the role.

You have previous experience in purchasing, supply chain coordination, logistics, production planning or a similar operational role. You understand order-to-delivery processes and have basic commercial knowledge of prices, lead times and delivery terms.

Experience in ERP systems is required, and previous experience with NetSuite is considered a strong advantage. Experience in heavy machinery, industrial equipment, manufacturing or a similar operational environment is strongly preferred.

You work systematically and accurately, but you are also able to react quickly and prioritize when urgent material needs or delivery challenges arise. You communicate confidently with suppliers, take ownership of open issues and approach problems with a practical and solution-oriented mindset.

Success in this role also requires strong cooperation skills and the ability to work effectively with different functions and stakeholders. Fluency in written and spoken Finnish and English is required.



What we offer:

You will join a professional and collaborative Operations team where your work has a direct impact on material availability, operational continuity and the reliability of our global supply chain.

This role offers an excellent opportunity to deepen your purchasing and supply chain expertise in an international technology company. You will work with a broad supplier network and collaborate across functions, giving you a comprehensive view of Tanas operations and supply chain.

Our working culture is down-to-earth and pragmatic, with a strong focus on openness, cooperation and getting things done together. At Tana, you will contribute to solutions that improve efficiency in waste management and support a more sustainable future.

If you are ready to take on an important role in operational purchasing and help us build a reliable, responsive supply chain, we would love to hear from you!

Location: Preferably Jyväskylä, other locations negotiable.



For more information, please contact Henrik Häggblom, VP Services & Operations, tel. +358 40 75 19027, during the following times:

Friday 11th September 12:00-13:00, Monday 14th September 12:00-13:00 or Tuesday 22nd September 13:00-14:00.



Please submit your application as soon as possible, but no later than 27 September 2026. Please note that interviews may be conducted during the application period as suitable candidates are identified.

Tana Oy is a Finnish environmental technology company founded in 1971. We are one of the leading developers and providers of mobile equipment and solutions for solid waste management focusing on waste treatment companies and waste yards.

The company slogan is TANA From Waste to Value®. title: Process Engineer
description:
Are you ready to embark on a transformative journey to decarbonize the maritime industry?
We are looking for a Process Engineer willing to mix creativity and engineering skills to develop design of fuel systems for the marine industry.
The preferred location for this position is Vaasa (Finland) but also Helsinki, Turku (Finland), Trieste (Italy) are negotiable.

Your role and responsibilities
As a Process Engineer you will have the possibility to follow the entire lifecycle of our products from initial design to operational support through manufacturing, installation and commissioning at shipyard.
Your work will mainly focus on engineering solutions for fuel supply systems for LNG, Methanol and Ammonia.
You will be responsible of the design of piping & instrument diagrams (P&ID) and defining process equipment (pumps, heat exchangers, compressors etc.). You will also be responsible for creating thermodynamic and pressure drop calculations/simulations, developing operating procedures and other supporting technical documents for the fuel supply system.
In this position you will be part of an international team working in close collaboration with other engineering disciplines as well as with customers, classification societies, suppliers and other stakeholders. Youll also have the opportunity to play an active role in the constant development activities for the fuel supply systems for all the fuels.

Requirements for the position:
* MSc in Chemical and Process Engineering or Energy Technology
* Knowledge of the marine/shipbuilding industry is seen as an advantage
* Experience with AutoCAD
* Experience with Process simulation software (AspenTech, MATLAB, AFT Fathom)


Qualifications/to be able to succeed in the position we expect you to have:
* Good technical knowledge and problem-solving skills
* Ability to work independently
* Responsible, flexible, proactive, stress-resistant and planning skills
* Fluency in the English language, both written and verbal
* Good communication and collaboration skills


The primary location for this role is Finland but this role can also be based in Italy where the annual salary range would be 27 887 EUR – 39 270 EUR , depending on seniority, and in accordance with the salary provisions in the National Collective Labor Agreement for workers in the metalworking and plant installation industry (CCNL Metalmeccanico). At Wärtsilä, we are committed to fair and transparent pay. This range reflects the expected compensation for the role, based on market data and our job architecture. The final salary offered will depend on factors such as the scope and responsibilities of the role, the required competencies, and your relevant education, skills, and experience. We also take internal equity into account to ensure fairness across our organisation.

Why you and us?
You are valued – as your true self. At Wärtsilä YOU matter. We value diversity and are committed in supporting inclusive work community.
Your growth is supported. We believe in continuous learning & teamwork. Wärtsilian community has your back when it comes to development opportunities – so you can develop beyond your potential.
You get to make a difference. Innovation and sustainability are important for us. Every day, we - Wärtsilians - put our hearts and minds into enabling sustainable societies through innovation in technology and services into reality.

Contact and next steps
Please submit your application before the application deadline 22nd of September 2026 through our Careers portal. Applications through email will not be considered. After submitting your application, you will receive a confirmation email.

title: SprinDrive: Manufacturing Engineer (Electromechanics)
description:
**Type:** Full-time, permanent

**Location:** Laserkatu 6, 53850 Lappeenranta, Finland

**Application deadline:** 24.9.2026

Want to bridge the gap between engineering and manufacturing in cutting-edge magnetic bearing technology?

**What will you be doing?**

SpinDrive is looking for a Manufacturing Engineer to join its R&D team in Lappeenranta. In this role, youll support the development and production of Active Magnetic Bearing (AMB) components by combining practical assembly work with manufacturing development, workstation setup, documentation, and supplier coordination. You will report to SpinDrives Lead Mechanical Engineer and collaborate closely with mechanical and electrical engineers, suppliers, and supply chain stakeholders.

A key part of the role is to help establish and organize SpinDrives own practical test assembly and test winding capabilities. As SpinDrive develops its in-house workshop, you will help define the workspace, identify and source suitable tools, equipment, measuring instruments, consumables, insulation materials, and other workshop requirements as well as establish practical ways of working. You will use your industrial experience and knowledge of local suppliers and subcontractors to help us build an efficient and well-organized manufacturing environment.

The role includes hands-on coil winding and related electrical assembly, but it is broader than winding alone. We are looking for a practical manufacturing professional who can take ownership of day-to-day assembly test activities, organize the workstation and tooling, and support engineers during prototype builds. Serial production is later outsourced to SpinDrive international subcontractors, and you will help to support technical discussions with them.

**Key responsibilities:**

In this role, you will test, manufacture, and improve precision coil winding solutions for Active Magnetic Bearing (AMB) components while supporting prototype production and assembly activities. You will perform test coil winding, preparation, soldering, insulation, impregnation, and related assembly processes, while helping establish and organize the required workspace, tooling, equipment, materials, and workflows.

Working closely with the engineering team, you will develop practical fixtures, tooling, work instructions, and assembly methods, interpret technical documentation, and provide feedback on manufacturability. You will establish appropriate quality, testing, documentation, and traceability practices and collaborate with local suppliers and subcontractors to source equipment, materials, tooling, and manufacturing services. You will also support technical discussions with SpinDrive international subcontractors for volume manufacturing.

**What kind of person thrives in this role and why?**

You might be the person we are looking for if you enjoy hands-on technical work and taking responsibility for making a workshop and manufacturing process work in practice. You are comfortable operating in an environment where processes, tooling, and workspaces are still being developed, and you enjoy finding practical solutions rather than waiting for predefined procedures.

We especially value practical manufacturing experience, good organizational skills, initiative, and the ability to work independently while communicating effectively with engineers and suppliers. Experience with local Finnish manufacturing suppliers and subcontractors is particularly valuable, as the role will involve building the practical infrastructure around our in-house assembly activities.

**We hope you have:**

- At least 3 years of practical experience in industrial manufacturing, assembly, maintenance, electrical or mechanical production, or related hands-on work.

- Experience with electrical motors, coils, wires, electrical components, or similar industrial equipment.

- Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, electrical schematics, and manufacturing documentation. Experience organizing workspaces, production areas, tooling, equipment and materials.

- Experience sourcing or working with local suppliers, subcontractors, tools, equipment, or manufacturing services.

- Good communication skills and full working proficiency in English.

- Solution-oriented, self-driven, and well-organized working style.

- Willingness to perform hands-on work while also taking ownership of broader manufacturing and workshop-development activities.


**We consider as an asset:**

- Experience with precision coil winding, electric motor manufacturing, or electrical assembly.

- Experience developing or improving tooling, fixtures, insulation, winding, or assembly methods.

- Established knowledge of Finnish/local suppliers for industrial tools, equipment, materials, machining, fabrication or specialist manufacturing services.

- Experience with prototype manufacturing and low-volume production.

- Experience in international manufacturing environments.

- Experience with CAD tools or the ability to work effectively with CAD-based technical documentation.


**What SpinDrive offers you:**

- Work closely with experienced engineers developing next-generation magnetic bearing technology for industrial applications

- Shape practical manufacturing solutions where your hands-on expertise has a direct impact on product quality

- Grow your technical skills in an international team collaborating across engineering, R&D, and supplier networks

- Travel internationally and build relationships with manufacturing partners across Europe

- Join a scaling technology company where you can contribute beyond a narrow role definition

- The compensation will include the salary and stock options to share the benefits of SpinDrives growth.


**Practicalities:**

This is a full-time and permanent position, and you will be employed directly by SpinDrive Oy. The role is based mainly onsite in Lappeenranta, Finland, and includes some travel to supplier locations. We hope you can work mainly from the office, with the possibility for occasional remote workdays. The onboarding period will take place primarily in Lappeenranta and is expected to last approximately 2–3 months. The start date is as soon as possible, but the latest in November 2026.

title: Power Electronics Simulation Engineer, Tampere
description:
About the role

This is a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of power electronics and electrical grid technology. You will join a niche team of experts where your work directly impacts how high-voltage grids operate globally.

In this position, you will be part of the NPI (New Product Introduction) team, focusing on the simulation and validation of advanced grid solutions. Your main tool will be the RTDS (Real-Time Digital Simulator), and your daily work involves Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) simulations. Because the role requires hands-on management of RTDS hardware and laboratory equipment, this position is fully office/lab-based in Tampere.

Work tasks

Your main responsibilities include:
- Running and designing Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) simulations.
- Managing and developing RTDS hardware setups.
- Using Matlab & Simulink for simulation and building test benches.
- Analyzing fault situations and system performance in a high-voltage grid context.
- Collaborating closely with design engineers to validate control systems.

You are offered...
- Long-term Mentorship: A thorough and supportive onboarding process into a niche technology area.
- International Opportunities: While the base role is in Tampere, there is a possibility for global site assignments (1–2 years down the line) for those interested in international travel.
- Cutting-edge Tech: Access to the latest simulation hardware and the chance to work on large-scale grid projects.

We are looking for

We value potential and learning agility above all else. This is a highly specialized field, and we are prepared to provide long-term onboarding for the right person. Whether you are a recent graduate with a strong academic background or a professional looking to pivot into grid technology, your ability to grasp complex systems is what matters.

Requirements:
- Technical Education: A University degree (M.Sc.) in Electrical Engineering, Power Electronics, or Control Engineering.
- Control Theory: A deep understanding of the interface between power electronics and the electrical grid (control side expertise is critical).
- Software Tools: Proficiency in Matlab & Simulink.
- Communication: Ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly in English (our primary working language).
- Location: Readiness to work onsite in Tampere (no remote work option due to hardware requirements).

We appreciate if you'll have...
- Previous experience with RTDS, HIL testing, or high-voltage laboratories.
- Familiarity with the power electronics industry

Our recruitment process

This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our clients wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.

Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.

title: Wärtsilä: Development Specialist / Manager (Supply Chain data)
description:
**Type:** Full-time - Fixed term, 12 months

**Location:** Helsinki, Vaasa or Turku

**Application deadline**: 20.9.2026

Interested in using data to improve supply chain processes? Join Wärtsilä Energy to develop reporting, data solutions and smarter ways of working across supply chain management.

**Key responsibilities**

In this position, your focus will be on developing more data-driven ways of working within Wärtsilä Energys Supply Chain Management organisation, particularly in procurement and strategic sourcing. You will work hands-on with data and Power BI, develop reports and data products, define KPIs and help improve how supply chain data is structured and used.

You will work closely with supply chain professionals and data specialists to develop ideas further and turn business needs into practical data solutions. You will coordinate development projects and explore how new tools, including AI and intelligent agents, could support supply chain processes. You will be supported by Wärtsiläs data experts on more technically demanding topics, but you are also expected to be a hands-on contributor who develops solutions and drives improvements from idea to implementation.

**What makes you a great fit?**

You are a proactive and curious person who enjoys working with data, learning new topics and finding better ways of doing things. You are comfortable taking ownership, bringing structure to development work and moving things forward independently. You communicate clearly with different stakeholders and are willing to test and learn when working with new tools and topics. You are also comfortable coordinating projects and keeping development work moving forward in collaboration with others.

**What we are looking for:**

- Several years of experience in project coordination or development work

- A relevant academic background in engineering, supply chain, business or a similar field, combined with an understanding of supply chain processes

- Hands-on experience with data, reporting and Power BI

- A proactive, independent and analytical working style with the ability to structure information and drive improvements forward

- Good communication and collaboration skills in English


**Additionally valued:**

- Previous experience working with procurement, purchasing or strategic sourcing, as it will help you understand the business context and related data

- Experience with automation and AI solutions, intelligent agents or applying AI in a business environment

- Familiarity with SAP, Salesforce, Databricks or other ERP and data platforms

- Good skills in Finnish


**We can offer you:**

- Broad opportunities to build expertise by working with supply chain, procurement, data and digitalisation professionals

- Versatile responsibilities where you can develop new ways to use data across supply chain management and turn ideas into practical improvements

- A truly international working environment where you will get to collaborate with a variety of colleagues from different departments

- An opportunity to continue discussions of future employment before ending the 12-month period

- Good introduction to Wärtsiläs operations and processes, helping you understand development needs and contribute to meaningful improvements


**Practicalities:**

This is a full-time, fixed-term position for 12 months, where you will join Wärtsilä Energy as aTalents employee. We hope you are available to start as soon as possible.

Your immediate team is split between Helsinki and Vaasa, but you can be based in Helsinki, Vaasa or Turku. Wärtsilä offers a flexible hybrid working model, and we hope you can work from the office regularly.

title: Open Application: Domestic Helper Opportunity in the Capital region
description:
OPEN APPLICATION: DOMESTIC HELPER / HOUSEKEEPER – HELSINKI, ESPOO & VANTAA

Are you looking for meaningful work where you can support families in their everyday lives?

Curon Helpperi is continuously looking for experienced Domestic Helpers to join our friendly and supportive team in the Capital Region. This is an open application, which means that we may not have a suitable position available immediately. We review applications as our staffing needs change and new work opportunities become available.


ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Domestic Helper, you provide practical day-to-day support that helps households run smoothly and makes everyday life easier for families.

The work is varied, and your tasks depend on each clients individual needs. Your working week could include cooking, cleaning, laundry care, organizing, ironing, childcare support, or helping seniors with their everyday routines.

Your tasks may include:

* Cleaning and maintaining clients homes

* Meal planning and cooking

* Laundry care, ironing and folding clothes

* Childcare and/or support for seniors

* Light gardening and outdoor tasks

* Pet care, such as walking a dog


WORKING HOURS AND LOCATION

* Work is mainly available from Monday to Friday between 8:00 and 17:30

* Occasional evening or weekend work may also be available

* The work takes place in several client homes across the Capital Region

* Most clients are located in Helsinki and Espoo, but work may also be available in Vantaa, Kauniainen and other nearby areas


WE OFFER

* Opportunities for gig work, part-time work or full-time employment, depending on our current staffing needs and your availability

* A supportive working environment and a caring team

* Training, guidance and support in your work

* An ongoing employment contract when applicable

* Salary according to the Facility Services Collective Agreement

For example, the salary for a full-time position with 100% working hours is €2,074 per month. The hourly salary is €13 per hour.


WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

* At least two years of experience as a domestic helper or housekeeper, or at least two years of cleaning experience combined with strong cooking skills

* Ability to prepare both Western dishes and food from other cuisines

* Ability to work independently and take initiative

* Fluent English or Finnish — you must be able to communicate well in at least one of these languages

* You are already living in Finland and have the right to work in Finland

* A positive attitude, reliability and respect for clients privacy

A valid driving licence and access to a car are considered an advantage but are not required.


APPLICATION PROCESS

If this type of work feels right for you, please submit an open application through the link below.

Please note that this is an ongoing open application, and we may not have a suitable position available immediately. Applications are accepted only through the application form. We will contact suitable candidates when work opportunities become available.

Thank you for your interest in working with Curon Helpperi. We look forward to receiving your application!

Location: Helsinki, Espoo, Vantaa, Kauniainen and other nearby areas
Start date: According to our staffing needs and the candidates availability
Application period: Ongoing

title: Area IT Manager Finland and Europe
description:
Ruukki Construction aims to drive the construction industry towards carbon neutrality with its products. Our 1,350 employees in 10 European countries and 14 specialized manufacturing sites provide steel-based building products and services for roofs and walls in sustainable buildings. We serve our customers locally under our main brands Ruukki and Plannja. Our net sales in 2024 were approximately EUR 481 million. We are of Nordic origin and share our values and long experience in the steel and construction industry with our parent company SSAB.

Do you want to be part of building a more sustainable future and be part of a professional and successful team in an international company? Maybe this is your new challenge!

We are looking for a strategic minded and hands-on Area IT Manager to manage local IT development and support activities in Finland and to oversee our regional IT operations across Ruukki locations in Central Eastern Europe. This role combines leadership, operational responsibility, and strategic execution in a dynamic international environment.

We are looking for a strategic minded and hands-on Area IT Manager to manage local IT development and support activities in Finland and to oversee our regional IT operations across Ruukki locations in Central Eastern Europe. This role combines leadership, operational responsibility, and strategic execution in a dynamic international environment.

The role has two main managerial responsibility areas; Firstly, oversee local IT development and support activities in Finland, ensuring business continuity from the IT perspective. And in this context act as line manager for the area IT team: manage performance, recruitment, budgeting, and other HR responsibilities. Secondly, you will lead a team of regional IT managers in Central and Eastern Europe: you will set goals, monitor progress, optimize resource allocation and ensure that best practices are evaluated and implemented as part of the knowledge sharing process.

All in all, you will contribute to the implementation of Ruukkis IT and business strategies and roadmaps. And when fit for purpose act as project manager for selected initiatives, such as IT and production capability development, acquisitions, and carve-outs.

The preferred location is Alajärvi, or any of our location in South Ostrobothnia, Finland.

Key Responsibilities

Ensure day-to-day IT support and development activities are aligned with Ruukki and SSAB IT policies (executed by internal teams and external vendors).

Lead the development of the Area Europe IT roadmap and resource planning.

Manage team-level IT costs, including annual budgeting and development proposals.

Oversee contracts and vendor management, including invoicing.

Collaborate with SSAB common IT on infrastructure and application development.

Define and implement collaboration models with business stakeholders across Europe.

Act as a general point of contact for infrastructure-related topics within Ruukki Construction IT management.

What we are looking for

· Strong knowledge of business applications and IT infrastructure (including security).

· Experience in strategy and roadmap execution.

· Solid understanding of business process development.

· Strong project management skills.

· Familiarity with agile methodologies and service delivery frameworks (e.g., ITIL).

· Proven vendor management skills.

· Strong leadership and team management capabilities.

· Has excellent communication and interpersonal abilities.

· The ideal candidate communicates fluently in Finnish and in English both written and oral.

We Offer

Our workplace fosters collaboration and personal growth, and everything we do is guided by our commitment to sustainability. Safety, innovation and reliability are at the heart of our business and ensure that everyone in our community thrives. Great colleagues and a supportive work community. Healthy work-life-balance and flexibility (hybrid working model). Lunch and wellbeing benefits. Occupational health services and much more!

Location

Your home base will be Ruukki Alajärvi (South Ostrobothnia) Finland. Some domestic and international travel is required.

How to Apply

Our recruitment partner Barona IT Talent will handle the application process and candidate communication. Please submit your application no later than 4th of October, 2026.

For more information, please contact:

Arja Martikainen, +358 40 7621564 (best reached Tue-Thu between 1-3 PM) or via emailat arja.martikainen(at)barona.fi

Please note: Background check may be a part of the recruitment process.

We decline contacts from recruitment agencies and ad sellers regarding this advertisement. Equally due to GDPR, please do not submit your application directly to recruiter email.

title: Kiertävä lähihoitaja - määräaikainen, Attendo Oma, Oulun seutu
description:
Kiertävä lähihoitaja Attendo-koteihin ja kotihoitoon Oulun alueelle – Olemme täällä sinua varten!

Me Attendolla olemme Matkalla kodiksi. Se merkitsee sitä, että haluamme olla ennen kaikkea koti ikäihmisille, vammaisille ja vammautuneille sekä mielenterveys- ja päihdekuntoutujille. Viimeisten vuosien aikana olemme onnistuneet johtamiseen, asiakaskokemukseen ja kohtaamisiin satsaamalla kasvattamaan niin läheis- ja asukastyytyväisyytemme kuin henkilöstötyytyväisyytemmekin historialliseen huippuun.

Jokainen asukkaamme ansaitsee tulla kohdatuksi omana itsenään ja elää täyttä elämää. Attendolaisena olet tärkeä osa tätä tehtävää.

Oulun alueella on 6 ikääntyneiden, 6 kehitysvammaisten ja 6 mielenterveys-ja päihdekuntoutujien Attendo-kotia, sekä kotihoidon palvelut. Tutustu Oulun alueen Attendo-koteihin: Attendo-kodit [https://www.attendo.fi/yksikot/?culture=fi&ancestors=26013&pageSize=20&take=0&pageIndex=1&skipAmount=0&root=348689&contentType=contentType-0&currentPageId=26577&location=Oulu]

Voit olla vasta valmistunut tai jo kokenut konkari. Pääasia, että teet työtäsi iloisella ja avoimella mielellä. Kiertävänä lähihoitajana tärkeintä on joustavuus ja rohkeus tarttua toimeen.

Meillä on mukava ja rento kiertävien hoitajien tiimi ja oman tiimin lisäksi saat kuulua kiertoalueen Attendo-kotien tiimeihin.

Attendo Oma-tiimiläisten tehtävänä on olla aina siellä missä tarve on sillä hetkellä suurin. Sinulle nimetään alueelta kotiyksikkö, jossa olet silloin kun sijaistukselle muualla ei ole tarvetta.

Palkkaus sisältää kiertävän työntekijän tehtäväkohtaisen lisän 337,11 e/kk, sekä maksamme verottoman kilometrikorvauksen työajoista. Työsuhde on kokoaikainen määräajalle 31.12.2027 saakka, aloitus tehtävässä sopimuksen mukaan. Työ on pääsääntöisesti kaksivuorotyötä.

Meillä pääset vaikuttamaan työvuoroihisi – autonominen listojen suunnittelu tukee työhyvinvointia ja arjen sujuvuutta.

Mitä edellytämme sinulta?

* Sosiaali- ja terveysalan perustutkintoa (lähihoitaja)

* Tartuntatautilain 48§:n tarkoittama rokotussuoja asiakkaiden ja potilaiden suojaamiseksi koko työsuhteen voimassaoloajan ajaksi

* Hygieniapassi

* Rikosrekisteriote tarkistetaan työsuhteen alkaessa

* Sote-ammattikortti eli varmennekortti

* Ajokortti ja oman auton käyttömahdollisuus

* Sujuvaa suullista ja kirjallista suomenkielentaitoa, vähintään tasolla B1.1.

Lähihoitajat ovat sydämellisiä tiimityöskentelijöitä, jotka tarttuvat rohkeasti toimeen ja innostuvat uusista ideoista. Asiakaslähtöisyys, ystävällisyys ja vastuuntuntoisuus kuvaavat hyvin näitä hoiva-alan rautaisia ammattilaisia. He ottavat itsenäisesti vastuuta ja tuovat positiivista, avuliasta energiaa tiimeihimme.

Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?

Kuljemme rinnallasi
Attendolla esihenkilösi ei ole kaukana, vaan mukana arjessa – tukemassa ja kulkemassa rinnallasi. Meillä olet tärkeä osa moniammatillista tiimiä, joka tekee kodista kodin asukkaillemme.

Tuemme kehittymistäsi
Attendolla kehittymismahdollisuudet ovat täyttä totta, eivät pelkkää puhetta. Meillä on laaja koulutustarjonta, ja kannustamme kaikkia työntekijöitämme kouluttautumaan ja halutessaan myös etenemään urallaan.

Joustamme kanssasi
Tasapaino työelämän ja muun elämän välillä on meille tärkeää. Meillä saat vaikuttaa työvuoroihisi ja sovittaa työn elämäsi eri vaiheisiin.

title: CLEANER
description:
**About the position**

Safai Cleaning Services is looking for a reliable and motivated Cleaner to perform cleaning and facility service duties at our customer locations.

The work includes maintaining clean, safe, and hygienic premises in accordance with the employers instructions and customer requirements.

**Main duties**

The Cleaners duties may include:

- Perform a variety of cleaning duties (including nursing home, Airbnb, residential, and regular cleaning).

- Regular cleaning and maintenance of customer premises

- Cleaning floors, surfaces, sanitary facilities and common areas

- Vacuuming, mopping and dusting

- Waste collection and disposal according to workplace instructions

- Maintaining cleanliness and hygiene standards

- Using cleaning equipment and materials safely

- Following employer instructions and work schedules

- Following occupational safety regulations

- Following customer-site rules and security instructions


**Requirements**

We are looking for a person who:

- Previous working experience in cleaning filed at Finland

- Due to work location the driving license is must

- Working with elderly required criminal certificate

- Is reliable, responsible and punctual

- Is able to work independently

- Has good attention to cleanliness and quality

- Is physically able to perform cleaning duties

- Is willing to work at different customer locations when required

- Follows occupational safety and workplace instructions

- Has a professional attitude towards customers and colleagues


Previous experience in cleaning or facility services is considered an advantage.

**Working hours**

Working hours are scheduled according to operational and customer needs and in accordance with the applicable collective agreement.

The position involves an average working time arrangement of 8 hours per week.

Depending on work requirements and the applicable collective agreement, work may include:

- Additional working hours

- Weekdays, Night and Sunday work

- Other scheduled shifts in accordance with the agreement


**Salary and benefits**

Salary and applicable supplements are paid in accordance with the Collective Agreement for the Facility Services Sector (Kiinteistöpalveluala TES).

The applicable hourly wage at the commencement of employment is €12.26 per hour, or the valid TES minimum wage applicable at the time of payment.

Applicable supplements, such as evening, night, Sunday and overtime compensation, are paid according to the collective agreement.

**Work location**

The work is performed primarily at Safai Cleaning Services customer locations in the Pirkanmaa region. Work may also be assigned to other customer locations in Finland when reasonably required by the employers business operations.

description:

_Ramirent Finland Oy on Suomen suurin palveluyritys, joka tarjoaa konevuokrauksen rinnalla laaja-alaisesti palveluita rakennusalan ja teollisuuden asiakkailleen. Palvelemme asiakkaitamme maanlaajuisesti yli 500 luotettavasta ammattilaisesta koostuvan henkilöstön voimin. Ramirent kuuluu Loxam-konserniin, joka on yksi maailman suurimmista konevuokraamoista. Haluamme panostaa toimintamme ensiluokkaiseen asiakaskokemukseen sekä pitkiin asiakassuhteisiin, mikä onnistuu osaavien ja innostuneiden työntekijöiden avulla. Ramirent on arvostettu ja pidetty työpaikka, mistä tunnustuksena meille on myönnetty kansainvälisesti arvostettu Great Place to Work -sertifikaatti. Toimimme työnantajana vastuullisesti, teemme töitä turvallisessa työympäristössä ja huolehdimme henkilöstön ammatillisesta kehityksestä, terveydestä sekä hyvinvoinnista. title: Vastuumyyjäksi S-market Tikkulaan
description:
Primary location:
PORI

Haemme S-market Tikkulaan osa-aikaista vastuumyyjää (32 h/vko) määräaikaiseen työsuhteeseen 31.12.2027 asti.

Tule kanssamme tekemään ihan tavallista marketkaupan työtä, jonka seurauksena syntyy poikkeuksellisen hyvä kauppa asiakkaillemme sekä sujuva, mutkaton työarki Tikkulan huipputiimillemme! Tarjoamme sinulle mahdollisuuden työskennellä vastuullisessa ja monipuolisessa roolissa osana ammattitaitoista työyhteisöä.

Vastuumyyjän roolissa työtä tehdään koko viikon akselilla ja Tikkulan S-market palvelee asiakkaita 24h, joten kyseessä on vaihteleva vuorotyö sisältäen myös yötyötä.Tehtävän aloitus on marraskuussa 2026 sopimuksen mukaan ja määräaikaisen työsuhteen kesto on 31.12.2027 asti.

Vastuumyyjä vastaayksikön tuloksellisesta toiminnasta yhdessä muun vastaavatiimin kanssa, esihenkilön johdolla. Toimit tärkeässä roolissa yksikön päivittäisessä johtamisessa varmistaen, että myymälän arki sujuu tehokkaasti ja asiakaslähtöisesti. Työssäsi osallistut aktiivisesti asiakaspalveluun, myyntityöhön, hyllytyksiin, verkkokauppakeräilyyn ja muihin myymälän ylläpidon työtehtäviin. title: Vaski Group: Business Controller (Seinäjoki)
description:
Type: Full-time, permanent

Location: Seinäjoki

Application deadline: 10.9.2026

Would you like to take ownership of business controlling in an international industrial company? Vaski Group is looking for a **Business Controller** to join its financial team in Seinäjoki.

Vaski Group is a fast-growing company in the industrial machinery sector, specialising in flat bar and sheet metal processing and automation. Over the past five years, the company has grown from €0 to over €50 million in revenue and from a team of just four people to 270 skilled professionals – all while maintaining strong profitability. Of the Groups 270 employees, approximately 150 are based in Finland. Vaski combines the strengths of three established brands, Vaski, Pivatic, and Ursviken.

Vaski Groups growth creates an ambitious and fast-paced environment where things evolve quickly and expectations are high. Success requires the ability to thrive under the pressure that comes with rapid growth, take ownership and remain effective as the organisation continues to develop and scale. This makes the role rewarding: it offers the opportunity to have an impact and grow alongside Vaski in a significant phase of its journey.

**What will you be doing?**

As Business Controller, you will work at the intersection of finance, projects and operations, helping Vaski Group turn financial data into better business decisions. You will work closely with project and production teams in Finland and Sweden and report to the Group Finance Director.

Your key responsibilities include monitoring the financial performance and costs of customer delivery projects, developing budgeting and forecasting, and supporting operations with financial insights. You will also follow R&D projects funded by for example Business Finland, ensuring accurate financial administration and reporting.

An important part of your role will be developing Vaski Groups controlling practices. You will have the opportunity to shape your own responsibilities, challenge existing ways of working and contribute to the selection, implementation and development of a new reporting system. You will also handle financial matters related to delivery projects, such as bank guarantees.

**What makes you a great fit?**

We are looking for an experienced controller who enjoys working close to the business and is comfortable operating in an evolving environment. You can discuss financial topics with production and project professionals, translate numbers into practical insights and proactively identify areas for improvement.

You dont expect every process to be ready-made. Instead, you are motivated by the opportunity to build better ways of working and take ownership of developing them together with the finance team and the rest of the Vaski organization.

**We require you to:**

- A relevant degree, for example in finance, accounting, business or industrial engineering

- Approximately 5 years of experience in controlling or business controlling, with the ability to independently take ownership of financial analysis and development

- A proactive and analytical approach, with the confidence to challenge existing practices and drive improvements when necessary

- Strong Excel skills and confidence working with financial data, budgeting, forecasting and monitoring project cost structures

- Professional working proficiency in written and spoken English


**We consider as an asset:**

- Experience from manufacturing, industrial or similar environment

- Experience working in a growing, international organization where processes and practices are still evolving

- Familiarity with Power BI and/or Odoo

- Finnish or Swedish language skills


**Vaski Group offers you:**

- A fast-growing international company that allows working alongside technically advanced products at the forefront of industrial automation

- Ownership of a responsible role where your ideas help build a stronger foundation for Vaski Groups financial processes

- A growing global employer that offers great career development opportunities

- A team where trust, a hands-on mindset and long-term thinking shape the way you work together

- A chance to make your mark in a growth-company environment where you have room to build new practices as the business evolves

- A comprehensive benefits package including medical expense, travel, and occupational and leisure accident insurance, as well as wellbeing, lunch, and mobile phone benefits


**Practicalities:**

In this full-time and permanent position you will be employed directly to Vaski Group.The preferred starting date is as soon as possible or during autumn 2026. The start time will be negotiated based on your availability. The position is based at Vaski Groups Seinäjoki office, and we hope you are able to work at the office approximately three days per week. Typical office days at Vaski are Mondays and Fridays. Since this is a group-level position, occasional traveling within sites in Finland and Sweden is required.

The salary will be agreed based on your experience and expertise. The position is also part of Vaski Groups white collar workers bonus scheme.

**Got interested?**

Please submit your CV and motivation letter in PDF-format by the latest 10th of September via aTalents application system here: https://emp.jobylon.com/applications/jobs/378972/create/ .

Please note that we are actively reviewing applications throughout the application period and processing them in the order they are received. Remember to use the application system, we do not accept applications by email.

We want to ensure that all applicants can participate in the process equally, and we will take individual accessibility needs into account where necessary. You can familiarize yourself with Vaski Group here: https://vaski.com/. For more information about the recruitment process contact aTalents Managing Recruitment Consultant Kiira Dahlström (+358 44 902 0238, kiira.dahlstrom\[at\]atalent.fi).

title: Tekninen asiakaspalvelija / Vuokraamotyöntekijä (Kerava&Espoo)
description:

Asiakkaamme on rakennus- ja työmaakaluston vuokraukseen erikoistunut yritys, joka palvelee rakennusalan ammattilaisia laajalla kone- ja laitevalikoimalla. Tässä tehtävässä pääset työskentelemään monipuolisen kaluston parissa ja auttamaan asiakkaita löytämään oikeat ratkaisut erilaisiin rakennus-, remontti- ja maanrakennusprojekteihin.

Etsimme käytännönläheistä henkilöä, joka viihtyy koneiden, laitteiden ja asiakkaiden parissa. Työpäivät ovat vaihtelevia ja sisältävät sekä asiakaspalvelua että konkreettista tekemistä kaluston kanssa.

Työtehtäväsi:

Vuokraamotyöntekijänä vastaat monipuolisesti kaluston vuokrausprosessista ja asiakkaiden palvelusta. Työhösi kuuluu muun muassa:

- asiakkaiden palvelu ja tarpeisiin sopivan kaluston kartoittaminen

- koneiden ja laitteiden luovutukset sekä vastaanotot

- kaluston tarkastus, järjestely ja käyttökunnosta huolehtiminen

- asiakkaiden opastus laitteiden turvalliseen käyttöön

- kuormaukset, purkamiset ja kaluston siirtely

- vuokrausjärjestelmän käyttö sekä muut päivittäiset vuokraamon tehtävät


Kalusto on erittäin monipuolinen sisältäen esimerkiksi pienkoneita, rakennustyökaluja, henkilönostimia, maanrakennuskoneita, työmaakalustoa sekä erilaisia erikoislaitteita.

Toivomme, että sinulla on:

- teknistä ymmärrystä tai kiinnostusta koneisiin ja laitteisiin

- asiakaslähtöinen ja reipas työote

- oma-aloitteisuutta ja kykyä tarttua erilaisiin tehtäviin

- hyvää fyysistä kuntoa ja valmiutta käytännön tekemiseen

- halua oppia uutta ja kehittyä kaluston osaajaksi


Aikaisempi kokemus esimerkiksi rakennusalalta, koneiden parista, huollosta, logistiikasta tai teknisestä asiakaspalvelusta katsotaan eduksi.

Tarjoamme sinulle

- monipuolisen työn rakennuskaluston ja koneiden parissa

- mahdollisuuden oppia laajasti erilaisesta ammattikalustosta

- vaihtelevan työn, jossa yhdistyvät asiakaspalvelu ja käytännön tekeminen

- hyvän perehdytyksen tehtävään

- mukavan työyhteisön ja pitkäaikaisen työmahdollisuuden

- Työ sijaitsee Keravalla tai Espoossa.


Jos olet käytännönläheinen tekijä, joka viihtyy koneiden, asiakkaiden ja vaihtelevien työpäivien parissa, tässä voi olla sinulle sopiva seuraava askel.

Jätä hakemuksesi jo tänään – haastattelemme sopivia hakijoita jo hakuaikana.

title: IT Service Manager, UPM, Helsinki

- Solid understanding of ITIL and ITSM practices

- Solution-oriented mindset with high accountability under pressure

It is meritorious if you have

To succeed in the role, you also are:

- Great communicator
- Stress tolerant

Other information:

title: Math Modeler
description:
The team of Wärtsilä marine engineering simulators is looking forMath Modeller. You can become part of a team which works on a market leader product (45% market share) that imitates marine engineering functionality for vessels. The preferred location for this position is Helsinki, Finland but also Turku, Finland is negotiable. We offer a possibility to hybrid work.

Main responsibilities:
* Develop from the scratch for dynamic math models of vessel equipment and systems.
* Create front-end side of simulators.
* Compile technical documentation for these models.
* Maintain existing models.
* Take a part in agile activities.


To be successful in this position, we expect you to:
* Bs or MS in physics, applied math, engineering or similar field.
* Practical experience in imitation modelling of physical systems.
* Basic knowledge of numerical methods for solving PDE and DAE.
* Basic knowledge of OOP approach or any OOP language.
* Be able to formulate a problem correctly and plan ways to solve it.
* English intermediate or higher.
* Be agile.


We will be amazed if you have (but not mandatory):
* Be familiar with Open Modelica or any Modelica-based language.
* Be able to quickly master new tools.
* Have a background in marine engineering.


Practical experience in imitation modelling required in one of the areas:
* Hydraulics (gravity flow, pumping through pipeline, pump characteristics, pipeline elements resistance, Bernoulli equation, two-phase media flow (liquid + gas)).
* Heat Transfer (heat capacity of materials – solid, liquids, gases; heat exchange between various media; temperature transfer & temperature resistance of materials).
* Thermodynamics (ideal gas laws; real gas specifics; main thermodynamics parameters and characteristics, its interdependencies; thermodynamics laws; phase transitions).
* Mechanics (kinematics and dynamics of rigid body, rotational dynamics equations; mechanical energy parameters and equations, mechanical energy transitions, inertia characteristics; simple mechanisms).
* Automation and regulation (main principals and parameters; governors (controllers) – main types and work principals; controlled system parameters and dynamic).


Why you and us?
We at Wärtsilä believe in empowerment, ownership and taking responsibility of our work. We support each others growth, and co-creation is the true basis of our innovation. We have courage to see opportunities and take initiative.
We are authentic and honest, and we strongly believe in that by being your own true self you can accomplish so much more. We dont always get it right the first time, and if mistakes are made, we make sure to learn and grow from them. We want everyone to voice their opinions freely. That is why we have built an environment that empowers you and everyone around you, and where you can feel safe and cared for. Are you eager to be part of this ambition?
We have an amazing team, and we are excited about our work and the impact it has on building sustainable societies. We are looking to find a colleague with this shared passion for smart technologies and a sustainable future.

Contact and next steps

We hope to hear from you soon by submitting your application through our careers portal. We aim to keep you updated on the process throughout.
Welcome to join us in shaping the decarbonisation of marine and energy!

title: Työterveyshoitaja, Helsinki
description:
Me Terveystalossa teemme työksemme tärkeintä, terveyttä. Työllämme on suuri merkitys, ei vain asiakkaillemme, vaan koko yhteiskunnalle. Meitä tärkeimmän tekijöitä on Terveystalossa jo yli 14 000 lähes 400 toimipaikassa eri puolilla Suomea. Siellä, missä ihmiset elävät arkeaan ja missä kotimaista työtämme tarvitaan.

Etsimme nyt joukkoomme työterveyshoitajaa Helsingin alueelle rakentamaan vaikuttavaa työterveyttä yhdessä moniammatillisten tiimien kanssa. Helsingin alueeseen kuuluvat Kampin, Ruoholahden, Keskuskadun, Triplan, Redin, Itäkeskuksen ja Herttoniemen toimipisteet.

Mitä työterveyshoitajan työ pitää sisällään?

Terveystalon työterveyshoitajat ovat yritysten ja organisaatioiden työhyvinvoinnin, työkykyjohtamisen ja työterveyden asiantuntijoita. Terveystalossa työterveyshoitajan monipuolinen tehtävänkuva on kiinnostava sekoitus vastaanotto- ja toimistotyötä, asiakastapaamisia sekä työpaikkakäyntejä. Työ on luonteeltaan ennaltaehkäisevää, ja työnkuvaan kuuluu terveys- ja turvallisuustekijöiden arviointikäyntejä sekä työpaikkaselvitysten ja työterveyden toimintasuunnitelmien laatimista, niiden seurantaa ja toteuttamista.

Vastapainoksi työterveyshoitajan työ pitää sisällään myös terveystarkastusten tekemistä, sairausvastaanoton pitämistä, rokotuksia ja pieniä toimenpiteitä. Tärkeä osa työterveyshoitajan työtä Terveystalossa on niin ikään yhteistyö asiakasyrityksen kanssa. Työterveyshoitajamme suunnittelevat ja kehittävät vastuuyritystensä työterveyspalveluita hoitosuositusten ja työarjen muutosten pohjalta yhdessä asiakkaan ja työterveystiimin kanssa.

Terveystalossa sinua odottaa hyvä ja kannustava työilmapiiri, jossa yhteistyötä tehdään tiiviisti moniammatillisessa tiimissä. Työyhteisömme on aidosti moniammatillinen, koska teet tiivistä yhteistyötä työterveyslääkäreiden, työterveyshoitajien, työterveyspsykologien ja työfysioterapeuttien kanssa. Arjessa tämä näkyy esimerkiksi yhteisinä hoitosuunnitelmina, matalana kynnyksenä konsultoida kollegaa sekä avoimena keskustelukulttuurina, jossa kaikki auttavat toisiaan. Uusi työntekijä otetaan vastaan lämpimästi, ja perehdytykseen panostetaan, jotta pääset sujuvasti mukaan tiimiin.

Johtamiskulttuurimme on lähellä arkea ja työntekijää tukevaa. Esihenkilösi on helposti tavoitettavissa ja kiinnostunut työsi sujumisesta. Saat säännöllisesti palautetta ja mahdollisuuden vaikuttaa omaan työhösi sekä kehittää toimintaa yhdessä muun tiimin kanssa. Työilmapiiri on rento, arvostava ja kannustava, mikä tekee arjesta sujuvaa ja mielekästä.

Asiakasyrityksemme ovat monipuolinen joukko niin pieniä kuin suuriakin yrityksiä, tarjoten vaihtelevaa ja merkityksellistä työtä. Asiakaskunta koostuu laajasta kirjosta eri toimialojen työntekijöitä – saman päivän aikana voit kohdata toimistotyöntekijän, rakennusalan ammattilaisen tai vaikkapa ITasiantuntijan. Tämä tuo työhön vaihtelua ja mahdollisuuden kehittää omaa osaamista monipuolisesti.

Työsuhde on kokoaikainen ja toistaiseksi voimassa oleva. Työtä tehdään pääosin virka-aikana klo 8–16. Tehtävässä on myös mahdollisuus osittaiseen etätyöhön.

Terveystalon kokonaispalkitseminen muodostuu tehtäväkohtaisesta palkasta, mahdollisesta henkilökohtaisesta palkanosasta, bonuspalkasta ja työsuhde-eduista.
- Työtehtävässä noudatetaan yksityisen terveyspalvelualan työehtosopimusta (TPTES). Tehtävä on määritetty Terveystalossa vaativuusryhmään VR4 tai VR5. - Lisäksi palkkaan vaikuttavat mahdollinen henkilökohtainen osuus (erityinen osaaminen, aiempi työkokemus) ja erityistekijälisät (lisävastuut työssä) sekä vuosisidonnaisuus (4 vuotta +6 %, ja 7 vuotta +11 % tehtäväkohtaisesta palkasta). - Työterveyshoitajille maksetaan lisäksi mahdollista bonuspalkkaa motivoivan bonusmallimme mukaisesti: erinomaisesta asiakkuuksien hoidosta palkitaan jopa kuukausittain. - Terveystalon tärkeimmän tekijät pääsevät myös nauttimaan monipuolisista työsuhde-eduista, joihin kuuluvat lounas- ja liikunta-, kulttuuri- ja hyvinvointietu, kumppanialennukset sekä kattava työterveyshuolto. Työterveyshuolto sisältää peruspalveluiden lisäksi muun muassa lähetteelliset erikoislääkärikäynnit ja mielen hyvinvoinnin palveluita, kuten lyhytpsykoterapian.
Lue lisää työterveyshoitajana työskentelystä Terveystalossa täältä.

Miksi töihin Terveystaloon?

Meillä arki rakentuu sujuvuudesta ja toisista välittämisestä, jatkuvasta halusta kehittyä ja ennen kaikkea inhimillisistä kohtaamisista. Vaikka maailma muuttuu, meidän tapamme tehdä työtä säilyy: Terveystalossa sinä voit keskittyä tekemään sitä, mikä on tärkeintä – terveyttä.
- Arkemme on sujuvaa. Panostamme lähijohtamiseen ja esihenkilötyöhön, jotta jokainen ammattilaisemme saa työssään tarvittavan tuen. Ammattirajat ylittävä tiimityö, joustavuus ja edistykselliset hoitopolkumme tukevat arjen työtä. - Välitämme toisistamme. Meillä jokainen on oma arvostettu itsensä, oman alansa huippuosaaja ja tärkeä osa työyhteisöä. Osaajatutkimuksemme mukaan ammattilaisemme arvostavat muun muassa lämmintä työyhteisöämme, hyvää esihenkilötyötä ja lähijohtamista sekä mahdollisuutta onnistua omassa työssä. - Teemme vaikuttavaa työtä. Terveystalossa on ainutkertaista osaamista aina ennaltaehkäisystä perusterveydenhuoltoon, suunterveyteen ja erikoissairaanhoitoon. Käytössämme ovat ainutlaatuiset oman työn laatumittarit ja digitaaliset hoitopolut kaikkiin yleisimpiin sairauksiin. Panostamme myös ammattilaistemme laadukkaaseen kouluttautumiseen, kehittymiseen ja ammatilliseen kasvuun. - Kotimainen ja vastuullinen. Vastuullisuus on meille sydämen asia. ISS ESG:n arvioinnissa kuulumme globaalisti oman alamme kärkeen, ja Suomalainen työ ry on myöntänyt meille Avainlippu-tunnuksen osoituksena Suomessa tuotetusta ja työllistävästä palvelusta. Teemme työtä suomalaisten terveyden ja koko yhteiskunnan hyvinvoinnin eteen tinkimättömällä ammattitaidolla. Suomen suurimpana yksityisenä terveydenhuoltoalan toimijana vaalimme kotimaisia juuria ja olemme ylpeitä suomalaisista omistajistamme. - Monimuotoinen ja yhdenvertainen. Terveystalossa olemme kaikki samanarvoisia riippumatta sukupuolesta, iästä, etnisestä tai kansallisesta taustasta, kansalaisuudesta, kielestä, uskonnosta, vakaumuksesta, mielipiteestä, vammasta, terveydentilasta, seksuaalisesta suuntautumisesta tai muusta ominaisuudesta.

description:

Som administratör med fokus på löneräkning hos Finströms kommun har du en viktig roll i att säkerställa att våra medarbetare får rätt lön i rätt tid. Du räknar även lön åt våra bolag och samarbetskommuner. Totalt sett ungefär 220 utbetalningar per månad.

- tar ansvar för att dina arbetsuppgifter blir korrekt utförda

- tycker om rutiner, struktur och ordning

- kan följa givna direktiv och fastställda rutiner

- har lätt för att samarbeta och kommunicera med kollegor och verksamheter

- har god datorvana och lätt för att lära dig digitala system

- Erfarenhet av Abilitas löneprogram är meriterande

- En tillsvidareanställning på 80-100 % av heltid från 19.10.2026 eller enligt överenskommelse. Lön enligt lönesättningspunkt 01TOI060 3 542,26 (100%)

- Arbetstid enligt byråarbetstid, 36,25 h/vecka (vid 100 %).

title: Head of Growth Marketing
description:
We are looking for a growth leader whose primary responsibility is scaling and optimising Musopias paid user acquisition across our portfolio of mobile apps. This role combines strategic ownership of acquisition with hands-on technical growth execution, experimentation, data-driven decision making and monetisation optimisation.

We are not looking for a traditional marketing leader. We are looking for someone who can build scalable growth systems, measurement capabilities and experimentation practices that enable sustainable growth across Musopias products.

You will own Musopias performance marketing strategy across channels such as Meta, Google, Apple Search Ads, TikTok, and emerging acquisition platforms, ensuring that every marketing investment is measurable, incremental and delivers long-term customer value.

You will define Musopias long-term paid growth strategy, investment priorities, and growth capability roadmap, ensuring the company is well positioned to scale profitably over the coming years.

Working closely with Product, Data, Engineering and Creative teams, you will continuously improve our acquisition engine by combining technical expertise, experimentation, and commercial thinking.

Success in this role requires balancing growth, profitability, and product experience. You will use attribution, incrementality testing, LTV modelling, creative experimentation, and funnel optimisation to maximise subscription growth while improving marketing efficiency. You will also help shape the evolution of Musopias growth technology stack, measurement capabilities, and automation.

Paid User Acquisition

- Own Musopias paid growth strategy and performance across all acquisition channels.

- Define Musopias long-term paid growth strategy, investment priorities, and capability roadmap.

- Lead and coach our Paid UA Manager while providing strategic direction.

- Develop and execute scalable post-ATT acquisition strategies.

- Drive marketing measurement, attribution and incrementality testing.

- Work closely with BI, Product and Finance teams to optimise CAC and LTV.

- Identify and unlock new growth opportunities.

- Own growth measurement ecosystem and technology stack.

Growth, Data & Monetisation (Hands-On)

- Act as a hands-on growth partner for product teams.

- Drive web and D2C growth initiatives.

- Analyse user behaviour and experiment results.

- Contribute to experimentation across onboarding, subscriptions, and pricing.

- Work with Design, Engineering and Product teams.

- Build and improve growth processes and tooling.

What Success Looks Like

- Profitable scaling of paid acquisition.

- Reliable measurement and attribution.

- Data-driven growth decisions.

- Seamless web and mobile growth.

- Systematic testing and scaling of new opportunities.

Why Join Musopia?

You will join a talented and ambitious team building products used by music learners around the world. We work mostly in hybrid mode, value autonomy, and collaboration, and genuinely care about creating products that make a difference.

Our office is in Helsinki, and for team collaboration we expect our people to work two days per week in the office. Our team is easy-going yet super talented and ambitious, and we are set to impact the future. Playing an instrument is not required, but you will have every opportunity to start. Every team member receives a free guitar or ukulele.

How to apply

Here is your chance to be part of the modern music industry! To apply, please submit your application and CV on-line ASAP. For further information, please contact Arja Martikainen arja.martikainen(at)barona.fi or 0407621564.

ABOUT MUSOPIA

Musopias team is developing a unique and truly global concept to ease the early steps of learning to play a musical instrument. Based in Vallila, Helsinki Finland, Musopia is a music software development studio with a mission to help peoples dream of playing an instrument come true.

For more information visit www.musopia.net to get to know our products.

title: Lähihoitaja lapsiperheiden palveluihin – 50 % työaika, Espoo
description:
Lähihoitaja lapsiperheiden palveluihin – vähintään 50 % työaika, Espoo

Haluatko tehdä merkityksellistä työtä lasten ja perheiden omassa arjessa? ANNU sosiaalipalvelut etsii lähihoitajaa osa-aikaiseen työsuhteeseen Espoon alueelle. Työaika on vähintään 50 % täydestä työajasta, ja lisätunteja on mahdollista tehdä asiakastarpeen ja oman halukkuutesi mukaan.

Lähihoitajan työ ANNU sosiaalipalveluilla on monipuolista, itsenäistä ja palkitsevaa. Työskentelet lapsiperheiden kotipalvelussa ja omaishoidon vapaan palveluissa asiakkaiden kodeissa. Työssä pääset tukemaan lapsia ja perheitä käytännönläheisesti heidän yksilöllisten tarpeidensa mukaisesti.

Työaika painottuu arkipäivien iltapäiviin, mutta työvuoroja voi olla ajoittain myös iltaisin ja lauantaisin. Työvuorojen suunnittelussa huomioidaan mahdollisuuksien mukaan omat toiveesi ja käytettävyytesi. Asiakaskäynnit kestävät vähintään kaksi tuntia ja toteutuvat pääasiassa viikoittain. Toivomme, että pystyt sitoutumaan sovittuihin asiakkuuksiin useamman kuukauden ajaksi.

Mitä työ sisältää?

Työpäivääsi voi kuulua esimerkiksi:

- lapsen perustarpeista, hygieniasta ja ruokailusta huolehtimista

- leikkimistä, ulkoilua ja yhdessä tekemistä

- lapsen tukemista harrastuksissa ja muissa arjen tilanteissa

- sairastuneiden tai erityistä tukea tarvitsevien lasten hoitamista

- perheen avustamista kodinhoidossa ja ruoanvalmistuksessa

- vanhempien jaksamisen ja koko perheen arjen tukemista.


Työtehtävät määräytyvät aina asiakasperheen tarpeiden sekä sovitun palvelun sisällön mukaan.

Toivomme sinulta

- lähihoitajan tutkintoa

- rekisteröitymistä Valviran ammattihenkilörekisteriin

- kokemusta lasten ja lapsiperheiden kanssa työskentelystä

- iloista, vastuullista ja asiakaslähtöistä työotetta

- valmiutta työskennellä asiakkaiden kodeissa

- kykyä työskennellä itsenäisesti ja ammattitaitoisesti

- hyviä vuorovaikutus- ja yhteistyötaitoja

- sitoutumista sovittuihin asiakkuuksiin.


Oman auton käyttömahdollisuus katsotaan eduksi. Kerrothan hakemuksessasi myös muusta ammatillisesta osaamisestasi ja mahdollisista erityisosaamisalueistasi.

Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?

- osa-aikaisen työn vähintään 50 prosentin työajalla

- mahdollisuuden tehdä lisätunteja asiakastarpeen ja oman halukkuutesi mukaan

- mahdollisuuden vaikuttaa omien työvuorojesi suunnitteluun

- työn, joka on mahdollista yhdistää esimerkiksi opiskeluun tai toiseen työhön

- merkityksellisen ja monipuolisen työn lasten ja perheiden parissa

- kattavan ja palkallisen perehdytyksen ennen työtehtävien aloittamista

- oman esihenkilön tuen itsenäiseen asiakastyöhön

- kannustavan ja välittävän työyhteisön

- mahdollisuuden kehittää omaa osaamistasi kasvavassa sosiaalialan yrityksessä.


Perehdytyksestä maksettava palkka maksetaan ensimmäisen palkanmaksun yhteydessä.

Palkkaus

Noudatamme yksityisen sosiaalipalvelualan työehtosopimusta. Tehtävän palkkaluokka on G20C. Täyden työajan kuukausipalkka on työkokemuksesta riippuen 2 572,97–2 758,01 euroa. Osa-aikaisen työntekijän palkka määräytyy toteutuvan työajan mukaisesti.

Kiinnostuitko?

Lähetä meille hakemuksesi ja CV:si mahdollisimman pian. Kerro hakemuksessasi kokemuksestasi lasten ja perheiden kanssa työskentelystä, ammatillisesta osaamisestasi sekä siitä, millaisina ajankohtina pystyt työskentelemään.

Voimme käyttää Teams-etäyhteyttä osana rekrytointiprosessia. Haastattelemme hakijoita jo hakuaikana ja täytämme tehtävän sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.

ANNU sosiaalipalvelut

ANNU sosiaalipalvelut on ystävänpäivänä vuonna 2023 perustettu, sosiaali- ja terveysalan ammattilaisten luotsaama yritys. Tarjoamme palveluita lapsiperheille, nuorille ja aikuisille eri puolilla Suomea.

Tervetuloa mukaan rakentamaan kanssamme Suomen parasta sosiaalialan työpaikkaa!

title: Buffet Waiter/Waitress, Lapland Hotels Saaga, Ylläs
description:

StaffPoint is currently seeking BUFFET WAITER/WAITRESS for Lapland Hotels Saaga for the winter season 2026-2027!

The employment will begin in November 19th and continue until approximately at the end of February. Alternatively, you can work only during the Christmas season from 19 November until 31 December 2026.

What we require:

- EU citizenship/passport or a valid working permit for Finland

- Experience of working in a restaurant as a buffet waitress/waiter

- Finnish Hygiene certificate (We can provide assistance with applying for a certificate)

- A positive attitude and good skills in a customer service

- A driver's license

What we offer:

- A lively and international work environment

- A memorable season that stands out on your CV

- Staffpoint and Lapland Hotels personnel benefits

- The possibility of accommodation through Lapland Hotels

- Salary based on your experience, at least in accordance with the Finnish collective agreement for the hospitality industry (Marava TES)

Please note that the accommodations are approx. 5km away from the work place. Due to the location, having your own car will make it easier commuting to work and in free time.

How to apply:

Add your CV to your application to speed up the recruitment process! Please note that if you are applying with a friend, both applicants must submit their own application. If you meet our standards, you will first receive an invitation to a video interview and a Refapp request for recommendations.

Submit your job application and we'll see you in magical Lapland!

Please note that we do not accept applications via email due to GDPR regulations. All applications should be submitted through our website.


Lapland Hotels Saaga

Lapland Hotels & Safaris Oy offers northern experiences for all senses. It consists of Finland's largest private hotel chain Lapland Hotels, the Nordic region's largest program service company Lapland Safaris, and Lapland Ski Resorts. The entire group employs a total of about 1,950 people.

Lapland Hotels includes 20 hotels, over 2,600 rooms and apartments, and more than 11,000 restaurant seats throughout Finland: in Ylläs, Levi, Saariselkä, Rovaniemi, Olos, Luosto, Kilpisjärvi, Pallas, and Hetta, as well as in Helsinki, Tampere, Oulu, Kuopio, and Kartano & Spa Hotel Haikko in Porvoo.

Lapland Safaris offers unique nature activities in Lapland's five locations: Rovaniemi, Ylläs, Saariselkä, Levi, and Luosto. An essential part of the safari selection is dog sledding experiences, which are provided by Lapland Husky Safaris, a member of the same tourism group. The company is the largest operator in its field in Finland and has four kennels in Rovaniemi, Luosto, Saariselkä, and Muonio. title: Keikkakokkeja Attendo Merilokin keittiöön, Raaheen
description:
Haemme kahta (2) keikkakokkia Attendo Merilokin keittiöön Raaheen! Omaatko suurkeittiön taitoja ja erityisesti kokkaustaitoa? Etsimme nyt ahkeria keikkareita, jotka pystyvät itsenäiseen työskentelyyn sekä pitävät hanskat käsissään. Tarjoamme sinulle keikkatyön, joka joustaa elämäsi mukaan. Olet tärkeä lisä tiimiimme: paikkaat sairaslomia ja vuosilomia, sekä toimit yhtenä tiimin tasavertaisena jäsenenä. Työt ovat kutsutaan töihin tarvittaessa -sopimuksella ja toistaiseksi voimassa olevia. Palkkaamme sinut suoraan Attendon-kirjoille. Huomaathan, että keikkakokkisopimukset solmitaan aina ilman kiinteää tuntimäärää.

Työtä tehdään keittiössämme arkiaamuisin ja työsuhteen aloituksen ajankohdasta voimme sopia kanssasi.

Mitä sinä pääset tekemään?

* Ruoan valmistaminen ruokalistan ja reseptiikan mukaisesti

* Valmiiden ruokien pakkaus ja kuljetus muihin Attendo-koteihin

* Astiahuolto

* Jätehuolto

* Kuorman purku

* Varaston hallinta ja varaston kierron varmistaminen

* Hävikkimatka

* Omavalvonnan merkintöjen tekeminen sekä poikkeamiin reagointi

* Keittiön siisteydestä huolehtiminen

* Yhteistyö hoivan ja keittiön välillä

Mitä edellytämme sinulta?

* Alan kokemusta tai soveltuvaa koulutusta, katsomme suurtalousalan kokemuksen eduksi

* Hygieniapassi

* Tartuntatautilain 48§:n tarkoittama rokotussuoja asiakkaiden ja potilaiden suojaamiseksi koko työsuhteen voimassaoloajan ajaksi

* Sujuva suomen kielen taito, vähintään B2-taso (työkielemme ja dokumentointimme on suomi

* B-ajokortti manuaalivaihteiseen autoon

Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?

Kuljemme rinnallasi
Attendolla esihenkilösi ei ole kaukana, vaan mukana arjessa – tukemassa ja kulkemassa rinnallasi. Meillä olet tärkeä osa moniammatillista tiimiä, joka tekee kodista kodin asukkaillemme.

Tuemme kehittymistäsi
Attendolla kehittymismahdollisuudet ovat täyttä totta, eivät pelkkää puhetta. Meillä on laaja koulutustarjonta, ja kannustamme kaikkia työntekijöitämme kouluttautumaan ja halutessaan myös etenemään urallaan.

Joustamme kanssasi
Tasapaino työelämän ja muun elämän välillä on meille tärkeää. Meillä voit työskennellä joustavasti keikkaillen.

Työsuhteen ehdoissa ja palkkauksessa noudatamme yksityisen sosiaalipalvelualan työehtosopimusta.

Huomioithan, että olemme savuton työpaikka.

Kiinnostuitko? Hae meille työkaveriksi!

Hakuaikaa on 27.9.2026 asti, mutta älä jää odottamaan, vaan hyödynnä mahdollisuus päästä osaksi tiimiämme – täytämme paikan heti, kun sopiva hakija löytyy! Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa rekrytoiva esihenkilö. Lähetäthän työhakemuksesi suomen kielellä vain rekrytointijärjestelmän kautta. Emme huomioi sähköpostihakemuksia. Hakemuksen jättämisen yhteydessä pääset halutessasi vastaamaan myös lyhyeen videokysymykseen.

Sari Snåre

sari.snare@attendo.fi [sari.snare@attendo.fi] / puh. 041 732 5491 (tavoitettavissa vain arkisin kello 9.00-15.00)

----------------------------------------

Attendo – Tulevaisuuden hoivan suunnannäyttäjä

Attendo on Pohjoismaiden johtava hoivapalveluiden tarjoaja. Tehtävämme on vahvistaa ihmistä niin, että jokainen, joka meillä asuu, saa elää omannäköistään täyttä elämää.

Asukkaillemme olemme ennen kaikkea koti, sidosryhmillemme kumppani ja yhteiskunnassa vahva muutosvoima. Yli 18000 työntekijäämme palvelee yli 400 toimipisteessä ympäri Suomen.
