﻿

Tenant Experience, Care & Engagement

    

Oversee tenant onboarding and offboarding and drive tenant care, benefits, communications, and experience-enhancing initiatives.

    

Plan and coordinate tenant events, including supplier-provided event services, and support broader campus development projects.

﻿

Administrative & Operational Support

    

Maintain documentation, reporting, templates, guidelines, service processes, and internal coordination.

    

Support financial follow-up, cost verification, and internal controls related to supplier services and customer billing.

﻿

Required Experience and Qualifications

    

Minimum three years of relevant experience in facility services, workplace services, property management, or a similar operational role.

    

Proven experience in supplier management, KPIs, compliance, service agreements, contract lifecycle management, and operational development.

    

Relevant post-secondary education in Facility Management, Property/Real Estate, or a related field. Relevant certifications are considered an advantage.

    

Strong stakeholder management skills, structured ways of working, documentation accuracy, and the ability to lead multiple initiatives independently.

    

Professional communication skills in English and Swedish. Chinese language skills are considered an advantage.

    

Service-minded, proactive, solution-oriented, and committed to continuous improvement.

﻿

  This role requires fluency in both Swedish and English - Chinese knowledge is a big advantage!

This is a full-time consultant position in Gothenburg through Incluso. Start is November 15th, 7 months limited contract to begin with. This role is 100% onsite in Gothenburg.

Please submit your CV as soon as possible since we will review the applications on an on-going basis.

For more information about this role, please contact Marianne Nilsson recruiter at Incluso.

title: CAD Mechanical Engineer, Glass Systems
description:
About the Company

At Avaron, you get the security of permanent employment combined with the variety of working at different customers. We place specialists across everything from tech, IT and industry to project management and business support – and whatever the assignment, you have a consultant manager who is there for you and your development.

About the Role

You will join a team that develops the glass systems of a vehicle, covering everything from windscreen and rear screen to door glass, quarter-glass, glass roof and rails. In this role, you will work close to both engineering and industrialization, contributing to components that are developed in-house and followed all the way into production. You will collaborate across functions from early project work to released parts, in an environment where precision in CAD and strong mechanical understanding make a real difference. This is a strong opportunity for you who enjoy detailed product development in a complex automotive setting.

Job Description

    You will work with glass parts across several projects, mainly in the engineering and industrialization phases.
    You will provide technical design input for the parts your team is responsible for.
    You will create and update delivery models and produce 3D PMI for CAD models.
    You will work together with mechanical integration in the engineering template.
    You will perform clash analysis before release and update part templates when needed.
    You will collaborate in cross-functional teams from project start until the component is introduced in production.

Requirements

    You have very good experience in Catia V5.
    You have very good experience in Team Center.
    You have very good knowledge of plastic construction.
    You have experience working with CAD models, delivery models and 3D PMI.
    You are used to collaborating in cross-functional teams.

Volvo Cars require that an adequate background check has been completed prior to the start of the assignment, meaning that you, as the supplier, must have conducted the requested level/-s of background check as soon as possible after your candidate has been chosen for the assignment. Citizenship Verification: Supplier is to verify stated citizenship by requesting proof during the procurement process.

Nice to have

    Knowledge of glass construction.

Senior-Level Experience

title: Supplier Quality Inspector
description:
As the Supplier Quality Inspector, based in Vaesteras (SE) or Vaasa (FI), you have a key role by being responsible to perform inspections at Suppliers to ensure the equipment is manufactured according to the requirements. Work tasks are split between operational site visits to suppliers, performing inspections, and traveling. Strategic tasks as part of the department and different project teams for you to give input, report on findings, and work with other stakeholders both internal and external in preparation of and feedback about inspections.

We are interested to learn more about you and what you can contribute with, so don’t hesitate to apply even though you don’t meet all requirements. A team with great cooperation and with diverse backgrounds is waiting for you to join!

How you’ll make an impact

    Understand the contract, specifications, budget, scope and other relevant project documentation related to the different types of equipment in the scope of the Electrical Substation projects.
    Participate and be a decisive team player in the coordination meetings where inspections are distributed within the Supplier Quality Inspector.
    Perform inspections in line with the time schedule and the different contractual milestones, producing the inspection reports according to the project requirements.
    You care about delivering quality to the Customer and are not afraid to highlight the Customer's needs to the supplier to provide the best solution to the Customer.
    Identify, estimate and report cost savings or cost avoidance based on outcome of the inspections.
    Engage and support the stakeholders in the usage of the appropriate database for tracking supplier inspections and punch items.
    Ensure all relevant documentation and punch items are correctly registered in the appropriate database.
    Supervise the Suppliers in the completion of the Inspection and Test Records and punch items on a regular basis based on the scope.
    Raise deviations when deemed relevant based on punches.
    Takes part in completions meetings with customer, supplier, and Hitachi personnel and provide leadership on the actions assigned.

Your background

    Technical / Engineering / Quality management education or equivalent professional experience.
    Minimum 3+ years’ experience in a similar role.
    Experience with electrical substation equipment is considered an advantage.
    Proficient oral and written communication skills, including technical documentation and reporting.
    Ability to build sustainable relationships with suppliers, customers and project stakeholders through clear communication, influencing and coordination.
    Ability to work independently, prioritize your workload and thrive in a highly autonomous environment.
    English fluency (written and spoken).
    Willingness and availability to travel as part of the role (up to approximately 50% depending on project needs).

More About Us​

We believe great work thrives in an environment where people feel genuinely supported and fairly rewarded. Our benefits are designed to create real value for every individual – fueling engagement, performance, and growth. By prioritizing well‑being, we build a workplace where personal and organizational success grow together. ​

Our benefits offering for our roles generally includes:  ​

    Collective agreement, occupational pension & possibility of salary exchange to pension (for ITP1 and ITP2) ​
    Group life insurance and additional insurances. ​
    Flex-time and shortening of working hours in time bank ​
    Hybrid work & allowances for setting up a workplace at home (in agreement with line manager) ​
    Health care and wellness allowance ​
    Health insurance incl. dental, spectacles & contact lenses allowance (employee pay 140 sek/month via salary deduction) ​
    Psychological support program ​
    Supplementary compensation for parental leave ​
    Various trainings and education supporting employee development ​
    Internal career possibilities both within Sweden and globally ​
    Employee Benefit Portal with thousands of discounts and perks ​

The benefits listed above are an excerpt only and may vary depending on job grade, location and contract type. Eligibility is subject to local regulations. ​

title: Technical Sales & Business Development Manager - Paper & Board
description:
At Nouryon, our global team takes positive action every day, to reach higher collectively and individually. We create innovative and sustainable solutions for our customers to answer society’s needs – today and in the future.

We are looking for team members who bring ideas forward, champion others and work together to do better. Does that sound like you?



About the job

In this exiting role as Business Development Manager Paper & Board, you will lead the technical and commercial advancement of Nouryon’s Paper, Board and tissue business in Europe. With ownership of key CMC applications, you will drive innovation, strengthen customer partnerships, and help position Nouryon as the preferred solutions provider in tissue and barrier coatings.



In your future role as Business Development Manager, you will

    Conduct technical audits and diagnostics at Nordic key accounts and selected distributors to identify opportunities for CMC, surfactants and chelates (with focus on wet end tissue and barrier coating).
    Work closely and support the Account Manager to develop and manage a strategic key account plan implementing innovation and enabling multi‑level engagement, thereby strengthening customer proximity and long‑term partnership.
    Maintain regular technical and innovation touchpoints with key account R&D and distributor technical teams to align on project pipeline and application roadmaps.
    Provide second line technical support and training for the EMEA distribution network, including joint customer visits and troubleshooting of complex cases.
    Manage sales related KPIs for assigned accounts (volume, margin, price development, project pipeline value, hit rate) and report progress versus targets.



You will work closely with internal stakeholders across Sales, Marketing, and R&D to drive customer projects, technical development, and business growth. Externally, you will build strong relationships with paper mills, industrial customers, distributors, and customer R&D and application teams, acting as a trusted technical advisor and partner.

This role requires travel approximately 40-50% of the time, primarily across Europe. Occasional travel to the Middle East and North Africa, including Egypt, may also be required to support customer engagement, technical projects, and business development activities.



We believe you bring

    Great experience within the paper and board process industries, ideally in technical and application, process, or customer-facing role.
    Proven experience in technical sales, or technical service, with direct customer interaction.
    Hands-on experience with tissue, board, specialty paper, barrier coatings, or related applications.
    Experience planning and executing laboratory and mill trials and translating technical outcomes into commercial value.
    Bachelor's or Master's degree in Chemical Engineering, Paper Engineering, Chemistry, Process Engineering, or a related technical field.



We believe you are...



To be successful in this position you combine strong technical expertise with commercial acumen and can turn technical insight into customer value. You thrive in an independent role with a high degree of ownership, while also collaborating effectively across functions, teams, and countries. Structured and proactive in your approach, you value knowledge sharing, transparency, and strong teamwork to drive results.



We offer you

At Nouryon, we provide a great job and friendly coworkers, plus benefits in addition to salary. Our collective agreement is with IKEM. Plus, we offer unilateral perks, such as bonus, reduced hours, health care allowance, lunch allowance, and more.



Have we got your interest?

This is a permanent position on a full-time basis, reporting to Nicolo Marelli, Regional Sales Director EMEIA, based in Gothenburg, Sweden.

Please apply via our online recruitment system. We will not accept applications via e-mail. Once it's with us we will review to see if we have a match between your skills and the role! For more information about our hiring process, visit: nouryon.com/careers/how-we-hire/

As an applicant, you will be subject to a background check before employment. You will receive more information about this later in the recruitment process.

We work actively and systematically with HSE matters to ensure a safe and sustainable working environment for our employees. As an employee, you may therefore be required to undergo drug testing on a random basis. This is part of our commitment to safeguarding the safety and well-being of our staff.



We look forward to receiving your application!



About Nouryon

Explore careers and life at Nouryon  

If you’re looking for your next career move, apply today and join Nouryon’s worldwide team in providing essential solutions that our customers use to manufacture everyday products such as personal care, cleaning, paints and coatings, agriculture and food, pharmaceuticals, and building products. Our employees are driven by the wish to make an impact and actively drive positive change. If that describes you, we will gladly make way for your ambitions. From day one we support you with your personal growth, through challenging positions and comprehensive learning and development opportunities, in a dynamic, international, diverse, and proactive working environment.

Visit our website and follow us on LinkedIn.

title: PhD Student in Building Materials
description:
Are you ready to take the next step in your academic journey? As a doctoral student with us, you will work closely with leading researchers in a strong, international research environment, with access to advanced laboratory equipment and solid funding opportunities. You will be offered secure employment, high-quality supervision, and room to grow, both as a researcher and as a person.



The research subject of Building Materials (https://www.ltu.se/research/subjects/Byggmaterial?l=en) consists of 15 people. The subject focuses on the development of sustainable materials and production technologies for the construction industry, as well as on ice and arctic conditions-related research and education.



Subject description

Building Materials includes sustainable building materials and their application technologies, recycling and reuse, and applied building physics, especially focusing on the Arctic conditions.



Project description

This research explores how mining waste, such as tailings and waste rock, can be reused rather than sent to landfill. Sweden, one of Europe's largest metal producers, generates large volumes of such waste each year, which can create environmental problems due to its reactive nature. This project aims to develop innovative ways to reuse this material in cement-based products, helping to reduce environmental impact and support more sustainable, resource-efficient mining.



Duties

As a PhD student, you are expected to perform both experimental and theoretical work within your research studies as well as communicate your results at national and international conferences and in scientific journals. The tasks will include laboratory tests, analysis of data, and modeling.



Qualifications

To be eligible, you must have a master’s degree in materials science or chemistry. You should have basic knowledge of building materials and be fluent in English.



The following work or research experience will be an advantage: experience with cementitious materials, XRD with Rietveld analysis, SEM, TG, DSC, micro-CT, particle size analysis, calorimetry, and synchrotron experimental measurement techniques. Knowledge of AI-based and machine-learning methods is also beneficial.



For further information about a specific subject see http://www.ltu.se/research/Utbildning-pa-forskarniva/Studieplaner/Allmanna-studieplaner-Teknisk-fakultetsnamnd?l=en



Further information

Employment as a PhD student is limited to 4 years; teaching and other department duties may be added with max 20%. Placement: Luleå. Starting: as soon as possible but not later than January 1, 2027



For each position, a preliminary salary range is provided based on the requirements, responsibilities, and market conditions associated with the role. https://www.ltu.se/en/about-the-university/work-with-us/applying-for-a-job#h-Informationonpaytransparency

title: Software Engineer (.NET)
description:
Build software that matters — and help shape how it's built.

What if your .NET expertise could contribute to software that makes a real difference in healthcare?

At CellaVision, we develop innovative medical technology for digital blood cell analysis, helping laboratories automate diagnostics and enabling healthcare professionals to make faster, more reliable decisions.

We are now looking for an experienced Software Engineer (.NET) to join our Software Platforms team in Lund. This is an opportunity to work with modern software engineering while influencing the technology, architecture, and development practices used across the company.

The role

Software Platforms provides the infrastructure, shared capabilities, architecture, cybersecurity expertise, and reusable components that enable our engineering teams to develop and deliver software securely and at scale.

As a Software Engineer, you will work with:

    

C# and .NET development

    

SQL databases and data management

    

Windows-based applications and distributed systems

    

Software architecture and design for scalable, maintainable, and secure solutions

    

Reusable software components and shared platform capabilities

    

AI-assisted development tools to explore solutions, automate repetitive tasks, accelerate learning, and improve productivity

You will collaborate with experienced engineers, architects, product teams, and other stakeholders — and have the opportunity to influence solutions that benefit multiple teams and products.

About you

You are an experienced software engineer who enjoys solving complex problems and finding better ways to build software. You are curious, take ownership, and thrive in a collaborative environment where knowledge sharing and continuous improvement are part of everyday work.

We expect you to have:

    

A Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field

    

Strong experience with C# and .NET

    

Solid knowledge of SQL

    

Experience with Windows applications and distributed systems

    

A good understanding of software architecture and design principles

    

Experience with AI-assisted software development

Most importantly, you are eager to learn, explore new technologies, and turn ideas into reliable, practical solutions.

Why CellaVision?

At CellaVision, software isn't just software. Our products are part of modern medical diagnostics, and the quality, reliability, and security of what we build genuinely matter.

You will join an international medical technology company where you can combine technical challenges, modern development practices, and meaningful impact — while helping shape how software engineering is done across the organization.

Join us!

This is a full-time position based at CellaVision HQ in Lund, Sweden, in our modern offices with excellent infrastructure and commuting options. We are looking to fill the position as soon as possible.

Ready to build software that makes a difference? We'd love to hear from you!

In this recruitment process, we are partnering with Radeptus. For any questions regarding the position, please contact Jenny Månsson at +46 703 318 506 or via email at jenny@adeptus.se.

Please submit your application

title: Supply Chain Analyst
description:
We are looking for a Supply Chain Analyst to join our growing team at Mölnlycke.

In this role, you will leverage data, analytics, and digital solutions to support operational, tactical, and strategic decision-making across the Supply Chain organization. You will play a key role in improving procurement performance, inventory optimization, service levels, cost efficiency, and operational excellence through data-driven insights and continuous improvement initiatives.

This position will primarily focus on Level procurement, with Rosemount Tank Radar as the main area of responsibility. You will support procurement and inventory processes, monitor performance, identify opportunities for optimization, and collaborate with buyers across multiple sites to resolve system or setup-related issues.

If you are passionate about analytics, process improvement, and translating data into business value, we would love to hear from you.

In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be:

    Support Level procurement activities with a primary focus on RTR, ensuring effective procurement and inventory management processes.
    Provide guidance and support to buyers across global sites when procurement setup or process issues arise.
    Develop, maintain, and continuously enhance supply chain reporting, dashboards, and analytical tools that support business decision-making.
    Monitor, analyze, and report key supply chain performance metrics, including: Service Level and On-Time Delivery, Inventory Turnover and Procurement Performance
    Identify trends, risks, bottlenecks, and opportunities through quantitative and qualitative analysis of procurement and supply chain data.
    Recommend and drive fact-based actions and improvement initiatives based on business impact and operational priorities.
    Lead and support continuous improvement projects within Supply Chain and in partnership with cross-functional teams.
    Prepare reports, presentations, and data-driven recommendations to support management and business stakeholders.
    Drive inventory optimization activities through ABC classification reviews, safety stock analysis, and other inventory improvement initiatives.
    Partner with Global and European Supply Chain Analysts to leverage best practices, avoid duplication of efforts, and scale successful initiatives across the organization.



Who You Are:

You consistently apply analytical thinking to solve complex problems and make informed decisions. You collaborate effectively across teams, building strong working relationships and fostering a culture of continuous improvement. You communicate clearly and confidently, translating data into actionable insights for diverse stakeholders. You proactively identify opportunities, embrace new technologies and ways of working, and drive meaningful improvements that create business value.

For This Role, You Will Need:

    Bachelor's degree in Business, Supply Chain Management, Engineering, Operations, Analytics, or a related field.
    Experience in supply chain, procurement, operations, business analytics, reporting, automation, or a related area.- a minimum of 2-5 years.
    Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to transform data into business insights and recommendations.
    Experience working with data visualization, reporting tools, and performance metrics.
    Strong communication and presentation skills.
    Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional and global teams.
    A structured and organized approach with strong attention to detail.
    Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and other analytical tools.
    English proficiency



Preferred Qualifications That Set You Apart:

    Experience working in a manufacturing, supply chain, or procurement environment.
    Knowledge of Oracle ERP systems.
    Swedish proficiency will be a plus
    Experience with supply chain analytics, inventory optimization, or procurement process improvement.
    Exposure to automation, digitalization, AI-driven solutions, or business intelligence tools such as Power BI.
    Experience participating in global or cross-functional improvement initiatives.



Our Culture & Commitment to You:

At Emerson, we prioritize a workplace where every employee is valued, respected, and empowered to grow. We foster an environment that encourages innovation, collaboration, and diverse perspectives—because we know that great ideas come from great teams. Our commitment to ongoing career development and growing an inclusive culture ensures you have the support to thrive. Whether through mentorship, training, or leadership opportunities, we invest in your success so you can make a lasting impact. We believe diverse teams, working together are key to driving growth and delivering business results.

You’ll find us at our Innovation Center in Mölnlycke, just 10 minutes from Gothenburg, easily accessible by car, bike and public transport. Here, every employee is part of a dynamic and innovative environment where everyone understands how their work contributes to the success of our company.

At the office, you can enjoy access to our gym and share great lunches with colleagues in our restaurant. Customer focus, engagement, and courage are at the heart of our culture. We foster a friendly and positive atmosphere, and as part of a global organization with locations around the world, you’ll have plenty of opportunities for personal and professional development.

About Us

WHY EMERSON

Our Commitment to Our People

At Emerson, we are motivated by a spirit of collaboration that helps our diverse, multicultural teams across the world drive innovation that makes the world healthier, safer, smarter, and more sustainable. And we want you to join us in our bold aspiration.

At Emerson, you’ll see firsthand that our people are at the center of everything we do. So, let’s go. Let’s think differently. Learn, collaborate, and grow. Seek opportunity. Push boundaries. Be empowered to make things better. Speed up to break through. Let’s go, together.

ABOUT EMERSON

Emerson is a global leader in automation technology and software. Through our deep domain expertise and legacy of flawless execution, Emerson helps customers in critical industries like life sciences, energy, power and renewables, chemical and advanced factory automation operate more sustainably while improving productivity, energy security and reliability.

No calls or agencies please.

title: Copy of Senior Legal Counsel
description:
We’re looking for a Senior Legal Counsel for a global company in Stockholm. Start is October 1st, 1 year limited contract to begin with. This role is 100% onsite in Stockholm.

Assignment Description

Legal Counsel to the European Business Unit, with responsibilities spanning commercial structuring, competition law, M&A activity etc. Engage with stakeholders across marketing, operations, sourcing, and business development, tackling everything from product claims and pricing models to strategic collaborations and route-to-market changes.

﻿

■ Strong track record in commercial contract negotiation, stakeholder engagement, and legal advisory across operations, sales and supply chain.

■ Provide legal guidance on competition law, trade terms, and consumer protection, ensuring compliance across diverse European jurisdictions.

■ Collaborate closely with sales, sourcing and operations teams, advising on pricing models, discount schemes, and trade arrangements.

■ Naturally curious and commercially aware, with a strong desire to understand the business and add value beyond legal parameters.

■ Adaptable and self-directed, with the ability to create legal frameworks and processes in areas that may lack existing structure.

■ Confident in navigating ambiguity and bringing clarity to complex or novel legal and commercial questions.

■ Persuasive and collaborative communicator, capable of coaching and influencing senior stakeholders and business partners.

﻿

This role requires fluency in both Swedish and English.

This is a full-time consultant position in Stockholm through Incluso. Start is October 1st, 1 year limited contract to begin with. This role is 100% onsite in Stockholm.

Please submit your CV as soon as possible since we will review the applications on an on-going basis.

For more information about this role, please contact Marianne Nilsson recruiter at Incluso.

title: Mechanical Design Engineer - Vehicle Systems
description:
At Koenigsegg, our R&D team brings together highly talented individuals with a shared passion for engineering the best vehicles in the world. We work in a fast-paced, collaborative environment where innovation and technical expertise drive our development.

We are looking for someone who is ready to challenge conventional thinking, contribute with their expertise, and thrive in our non-conventional Lean Development philosophy.

You will work alongside world-renowned engineers on some of the most exciting automotive programs in the world, with the opportunity to create, innovate, and help shape the future of hypercars.

Responsibilities

As a Mechanical Design Engineer within the Vehicle Systems team, you will be responsible for the design and development of robust, reliable, and high-performance automotive systems. The role covers development from concept to production and requires close collaboration with Product, Powertrain, Optical and Electrical Design, as well as CAE, Prototype, and Homologation departments.

You will:

    Design and develop mechanical and electrical automotive systems, including cooling, HVAC, electrical boxes, hydraulics, fuel systems, wiper systems, and packaging
    Generate 3D models, assemblies, and 2D drawings using CATIA V6 / 3DEXPERIENCE
    Organize and carry out tests to verify component function and ensure requirements are met
    Provide technical support for the successful introduction of components and systems into production
    Support the release of products into production through PLM
    Collaborate with suppliers and technology providers to ensure quality, performance, and delivery requirements are met
    Ensure that products comply with relevant regulations and requirements
    Estimate cost and time scopes for components and systems

Requirements:

    MSc/BSc in Engineering, preferably Mechanical, Automotive, or a related field
    5+ years of experience in vehicle system design
    5+ years of experience with CATIA V5/V6 or 3DEXPERIENCE
    Strong mechanical engineering skills, including design, manufacturing limitations, mechanical linkages, and Design for Manufacturing (DFM)
    Experience with technologies used in automotive electrical and hydraulic systems
    Experience with PLM systems
    Working knowledge of DFMEA and GD&T
    Understanding of prototyping, manufacturing, and production technologies
    Professional level of English

Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so don't wait to apply. We look forward to receiving your application!

Koenigsegg is most known for building some of the fastest cars in the world; with almost all of our megacar technologies that are patented and made in-house by our almost 500 world-class technicians, engineers, sourcing experts, production craftsmen, and communicators.

What we’ve created is a unique proving ground of engineering creativity that makes use of our breakthrough megacar development and legacy to push the boundaries of sustainable mobility technology.

So, what’s next?

We are on a universe-denting mission to develop the next generation of breakthrough tech and products. We are looking for outstanding, impactful, and authentic individuals to grow with us. Our ambitions are inspiring but will push the limits of what is possible – requiring one to work efficiently amid our cross-functional teams to execute at high-quality levels.

The goal is clear: innovate and transform.

title: Piping Foreman
description:
Gemkom Engineering and Machinery Filial is a newly established branch of the Turkish company Gemkom. It is a leading engineering and manufacturing company that operates in a number of areas and in various ways within the steel industry.

We are participating in a project where Stegra AB establishes a steel mill in Norra Svartbyn in Boden where steel will be produced through an almost fossil-free process using hydrogen gas. Our mission is, among other things, to install machines used in steel production and includes work in mechanics, electronics and plumbing.

We now want to employ Piping Foremans. The work tasks may include but are not limited to:

Job Description

The Piping Foreman is responsible for supervising and directing piping installation, assembly, and maintenance activities on site. The role involves managing a team of piping fitters, coordinating daily work assignments, and ensuring that piping systems are installed according to engineering drawings, project specifications, quality standards, and safety regulations. The Piping Foreman ensures efficient workflow, proper resource utilization, and timely completion of project tasks.

Key Responsibilities

· Supervise and coordinate daily activities of piping crews, including piping fitters, helpers, and support personnel.

· Review and interpret engineering drawings, piping isometric drawings, blueprints, and technical specifications.

· Plan and assign work tasks to ensure efficient progress and completion of piping installation activities.

· Oversee the installation, assembly, and alignment of piping systems, valves, pumps, and related mechanical equipment.

· Ensure correct pipe routing, supports, fittings, and installation techniques in accordance with design requirements.

· Monitor work quality and ensure compliance with project specifications, codes, and industry standards.

· Coordinate with welding teams, mechanical crews, engineers, and site supervisors to maintain smooth workflow and resolve technical issues.

· Conduct routine inspections of installed piping systems and identify any installation or safety issues.

· Ensure that all work activities comply with company safety policies, site procedures, and regulatory requirements.

· Track work progress, manpower allocation, and materials usage, and report updates to the supervisor or project management.

· Provide guidance, training, and technical support to piping crew members to maintain productivity and quality standards.

Qualifications

· Experience in piping installation, fabrication, and maintenance in industrial or construction environments is preferred.

· Experience as a Piping Fitter or Piping Team Leader, with supervisory experience preferred.

· Strong ability to read and interpret piping drawings, isometric drawings, and technical documentation.

· Knowledge of piping materials, fittings, valves, and installation procedures.

· Familiarity with construction site safety regulations and industry standards.

Skills and Competencies

· Strong leadership and supervisory skills

· Solid technical knowledge of piping systems and installation methods

· Planning and organizational ability

· Problem-solving and decision-making skills

· Effective communication and coordination skills

· Commitment to safety and quality standards

Our headquarters are in Stockholm, and applications are received via the specified e-mail address.

title: IT Support Technician
description:
The European Spallation Source (ESS) is one of the largest science and technology infrastructure projects being built today. ESS will soon be the world’s most powerful source of neutrons, providing researchers with unique opportunities to explore the structure of materials at the atomic level. Neutron scattering at ESS will address critical questions in physics, chemistry, geology, materials science and life science.

About the role

As a valued member of our IT Helpdesk team consisting currently of 5 colleagues, you will play a central role in ensuring smooth and effective IT Support at ESS. Your primary responsibilities will include resolving incidents and service requests, either registered in our ticket system or reported directly by users visiting the IT Helpdesk. Collaborating closely with your colleagues you will tackle a variety of tasks such as installations, installations and maintenance of laptops and workstations, support of equipment, systems and applications.

To thrive as an IT Support technician at ESS, you bring a natural flair for service and enjoy delivering quality and long-term solutions. You are equally comfortable working independently or as part of a team, and you appreciate and understand the importance of structured processes and thorough documentation. You value the opportunity to learn new things and enjoy working in a fast-paced organisation. Your responsiveness to user inquiries and enthusiasm for interacting with people will be key to your success in this role.

This is a full-time permanent position with a 6 months' probationary period based at the ESS Campus in Lund, Sweden.

Day-to-day, you will:

    Support users directly at the physical IT service desk, remotely or by phone
    Manage and resolve service requests and incidents registered in case management system
    Deploy and configure laptops and mobile devices and manage replacements
    Install and configure workstations used across the ESS site
    Diagnose and resolve computer hardware and software problems
    Troubleshoot operating-system and driver issues
    Troubleshoot user account, password, permissions and accesses
    Troubleshoot basic network-related problems
    Troubleshoot basic issues with meeting rooms equipment and connections
    Troubleshoot printers and connection issues
    Handle IT assets, equipment inventories and lifecycle management
    Collaborate with your team and other functions to solve issues

About you:

    Minimum 2 years of relevant professional experience in IT Support and IT service desk, or a comparable technical support function or equivalent education
    Experience providing IT Support to users in a larger company
    Practical experience with installations, configurations, diagnosing and resolving issues with Windows- and macOS based laptops and workstations, peripherals and connectivity issues. Practical experience with Linux is an advantage
    Experience in advanced hardware troubleshooting of laptops and workstations
    Experience supporting specialized workstations like scientific workstations is an advantage
    Strong knowledge in Mac OS, Windows, iOS and preferably Linux distributions as an administrator or power user
    Experience with meeting room support and troubleshooting (Crestron- and Poly control systems)
    Experience with Microsoft Active Directory, and Microsoft 365
    Experience contributing to knowledge bases and technical documentation
    Ability to communicate technical matters clearly to users with different levels of technical knowledge

To apply:

If you see yourself in what we’re looking for, please provide your CV and motivation letter in English by clicking on “apply” and follow the instructions, latest by October 4, 2026. Please be aware that we can only accept direct applications made via the ESS website.

Certain roles at ESS require enhanced security screening processes, which will be performed as part of the recruitment and onboarding process.

For more information regarding the ESS recruitment process, please contact Louise Jönegård - Recruiter at mailto:louise.jonegard@ess.eu For further information regarding the position, please contact Anette Smedberg-Haukka – Group leader IT Helpdesk & Support – via mailto:anette.smedberghaukka@ess.eu

For trade union information, please contact Unionen representative Nerusha Naicker on mailto:erusha.Naicker@ess.eu or SACO/Swedish Association of Graduate Engineers representative Marc Kickulies at mailto:marc.kickulies@ess.eu

title: AI/ML Engineer - 19358
description:
Veritaz is a leading IT staffing solutions provider in Sweden, committed to advancing individual careers and aiding employers in ensuring the perfect talent fit. With a proven track record of successful partnerships with top companies, we have rapidly grown our presence in the USA, Europe, and Sweden as a dependable and trusted resource within the IT industry.

Assignment Description

title: QCS Service Engineer
description:

title: Financial Controller needed!
description:

You enjoy working in a dynamic environment and are motivated by improving processes and finding effective solutions.

Does this sound like an exciting opportunity? We look forward to reading your application!

Full-time consulting assignment until 2027-06-30. Start asap.

title: Senior Statistician - Late Cardiovascular, Renal and Metabolism
description:

Our cardiovascular, renal and metabolism (CVRM) pipeline spans investigational therapies at varied stages of clinical development, from recently approved products to earlier stage molecules. Analyse internal and external data; perform modelling and simulation to inform design decisions and decision criteria

    

Develop Statistical Analysis Plans for complex studies and project deliveries

    

Coach and guide less experienced statisticians in producing analyses, graphics and tables for reports, Global Medical Affairs studies and publications

    

Analyse, interpret, summarise and communicate results; contribute to regulatory documents and responses

Under guidance, investigate and apply novel statistical approaches; provide consultancy, engage with external scientists/academia, and communicate research (conferences/journals)



Essential Skills/Experience:

    

MSc/PhD in Statistics or Mathematics (containing a substantial statistical component)

    

Competent statistical programmer (SAS, R, and/or Python)

    

Excellent communication skills and ability to collaborate and work effectively in teams

    

Experience and knowledge of statistical methods and applications in study design, analysis and interpretation

    

Keen interest in research; Comfortable learning and applying new statistical methods.



Desirable Skills/Experience:

    

Knowledge of key technical and regulatory requirements related to the role

    

Experience of design, analysis and reporting of preclinical or clinical studies

    

Experience of pharmaceutical development

    

Ability to apply statistical expertise to problems, with strong problem solving and quality focus



AstraZeneca offers an environment where curiosity thrives. We are committed to making a difference by fusing data and technology with scientific innovations. title: Senior Data Scientist, Department of AI
description:
THE OPPORTUNITY IN A NUTSHELLYou? A hands-on, product-minded Data Scientist who turns rich datasets into intelligent, innovative AI systems that directly shape user experiences and business models. You’re motivated, eager and equipped to make us smarter by using data to innovate in our product offering.

Role? Experienced Data Scientist joining our Department of AI to develop, experiment with, and build machine learning and AI systems that provide new user experiences and business model innovation, in collaboration with our vertical teams.

Company? Vend, parent company of FINN, Blocket, Tori, Oikotie, DBA, Bilbasen, as well as other top brands, where millions of people across the Nordics connect to find what they need, whether it’s a job, a home, a way to move, or a fresh start.

Location? Join us in our central and modern Oslo or Stockholm office with the flexibility to work 3 days per week remotely!

Why us? The Department of AI is Vend’s biggest AI investment, a central team of 35 experts working to transform Vend’s products, way of working, and strategy using AI. This is your chance to make a meaningful impact through the company’s main AI bets, using data science to make new categories of products possible.

Sounds like your cup of tea? Check out the details below!

WHO ARE YOU?

    You are experienced in Data Science & Machine Learning: You have strong fundamental knowledge of machine learning algorithms and AI, with practical experience in building models and creating scalable solutions.
    You are as up to date with modern AI tools and are familiar in using LLMs in your Data Science Practice
    You are innovative, collaborative and can apply Data Science principles and techniques to create novel products and business models within cross-functional teams.
    You are business oriented, able to see opportunities where AI can improve our products and services.
    You are flexible and comfortable with change.

WHAT’S THE JOB LIKE?

Day-to-day work & projects cooking

    The Data Scientists in our Department of AI (dAI) collaborate in cross-functional, temporary teams with AI, design, product, engineering, and business experts to create agentic and AI-native products for our marketplaces.
    Data Science is an integral and essential part of our AI-native product development
    Our current projects include Finn Søkelys - an AI-based job matching system that removes the job listing and application from the process; a chat-based discovery experience for people looking for new places to live; and actionable recommendations for car dealers.
    We also offer some courses and workshops on Data Science for other employees, mainly engineers, in Vend. In our last courses, we developed our own materials from scratch on NLP, Deep Learning, LLMs behind the scenes, Computer Vision, and more.

The challenge you can turn into an opportunity!

How do we make agentic products work well for users and customers? Which surfaces and problems are AI systems best equipped to solve? What new business opportunities have we neglected, because they were not technologically possible before?

The work we do here is far from trivial, which means that you have an opportunity to do your best work and create something new and amazing.

A few words from the hiring manager

Hi, I’m Vilde, and I manage the Data Science team in dAI. The team consists of 5 Data Scientists, including you, who work alone or in pairs in projects to develop AI-native products for our marketplaces. We come together to discuss approaches and applications, and we develop Data Science courses and workshops for other people in the company. We are looked up to as experts, and expected to stay on top of AI developments and how to apply them effectively. Something exciting about us is that we love change, and we follow the biggest opportunities - the department itself will wind down at the end of 2027, and we strongly expect to find new homes for the roles in the business units. Data Science is an important and strategic capability for Vend.

Want to get a feel for our culture and what drives us? Take a peek behind the scenes at our Career Page!

GOT YOUR ATTENTION? Let us hear from you!

Make sure to apply by the 27th of September. We will review applications on a rolling basis, appreciate and encourage earlier applications.

At Vend, our mission is simple: Smart choices made easy.

We’re here to make sustainable living effortless through seamless digital experiences. As part of a dynamic family of marketplaces, including FINN, Blocket, Tori, Bytbil, Oikotie, Bilbasen, and DBA, we connect people with services and products that matter.

Driven by purpose and curiosity, we constantly evolve to meet today’s needs and shape a smarter, more sustainable tomorrow.

At Vend, your time matters. We want you to explore new paths to smarter. Be curious with technology and lean forward. Dare to try, learn, and try again, as we innovate, grow and succeed together. Because your time matters. And when spent wisely, it creates value for you, for Vend, and society as a whole.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
Hitachi Energy is a global leader in electrification, powering a sustainable future with innovative grid technologies and digital solutions. We’re inspiring the next era of sustainable energy, making electricity more accessible to all and empowering societies to thrive.

IVRS (Integration, Verification, Release and Support) is a department within Grid Integration Modular Advanced Control (GI MACH), working with securing the quality of the MACH platform, the brain of the HVDC station. We are responsible for verification of the MACH Platform towards high level requirements and for releasing the platform to our customers.

IVRS is developing a robust CI/CD pipeline to revolutionize delivery of the MACH platform in an HVDC project. Join the GI MACH team to help build a next-generation data platform that unifies data from diverse sources, creating a single source of truth for code development, design, and manufacturing.

As a DevOps Engineer, you’ll play a pivotal role in automating and scaling the infrastructure that powers this platform, with extra focus on our internal applications and tools.

How You’ll Make an Impact

     Design, develop, and implement mission-critical tools and applications to support a scalable, high-performance, high-volume production environment with global users.
     Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for C++ and C# development environments, leveraging tools like Azure DevOps, MS Build scripts, Python and build systems.
     Automate infrastructure and software processes using tools like Ansible or Terraform.
     Manage containerized environments using Docker or Podman including creating and testing Windows and Linux images.
     Implement full-stack monitoring and alerting systems using tools like Sensu, Splunk, Logstash or Nagios.
     Plan and execute software and infrastructure upgrades based on data-driven capacity planning.
     Manage configuration, variants, and version control using Git, TFVC, and release management tools like Jira.
     Streamline development experiences for teams by designing scalable CI/CD processes and optimizing workflows with containerization and virtualization.
     Collaborate with teams to support business needs and provide domain expertise for internal systems.

Your background

     Bachelor’s Degree or higher in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
     Expert skills in Linux, networking, storage, and virtualization.
     Proficiency in scripting languages such as Python. Shell and Golang beneficial.
     Strong understanding of CI/CD processes and experience designing pipelines using GitHub or GitLab.
     Familiarity with build systems (Makefiles, CMake) or Bazel and release management tools (e.g.: Git).
     Ability to manage software and infrastructure upgrades with a focus on scalability and performance.
     Experience setting up and supporting development environments for C++ and C#. Embedded system developer background beneficial.
     Strong English communication skills, Swedish is advantage.

More About Us​

​We believe great work thrives in an environment where people feel genuinely supported and fairly rewarded. Our benefits are designed to create real value for every individual – fueling engagement, performance, and growth. By prioritizing well‑being, we build a workplace where personal and organizational success grow together. ​

​

    Collective agreement, occupational pension & possibility of salary exchange to pension (for ITP1 and ITP2) ​

    Hybrid work & allowances for setting up a workplace at home (in agreement with line manager) ​
    Health care and wellness allowance ​
    Health insurance incl. dental, spectacles & contact lenses allowance (employee pay 140 sek/month via salary deduction) ​
    Psychological support program ​
    Supplementary compensation for parental leave ​
    Various trainings and education supporting employee development ​
    Internal career possibilities both within Sweden and globally ​
    Employee Benefit Portal with thousands of discounts and perks ​

​

The benefits listed above are an excerpt only and may vary depending on job grade, location and contract type. Eligibility is subject to local regulations. ​

​

title: Project Manager to the Center for Security and Resilience at SSE
description:
The Center for Security and Resilience is seeking a motivated and organized Project Manager who can take ownership of projects from initial concept and planning through implementation, evaluation, and continued development. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys working with a wide range of stakeholders and combining strategic development with hands-on execution.

A key part of the role involves planning and delivering both academic and practitioner-focused events, as well as recruiting and engaging students and hourly employees for various projects and assignments.

About the Center for Security and Resilience

Building security through competitiveness. In a world shaped by disruption, agile competitiveness is increasingly central to national and global security. The Center for Security and Resilience (CfSR) brings together academia, business, and government to explore how societies can grow stronger in preparing for and managing crises and war.

About the Role

As Project Manager, you will have broad responsibility for planning, coordinating, and delivering activities at the Center for Security and Resilience. You will oversee projects as a whole, create structure, and ensure that objectives are achieved on time and within budget.

You will work closely with students, partner organizations, and other relevant stakeholders. The role includes both independent work and collaboration with internal and external stakeholders. You will report to the Executive Director of the Center for Security and Resilience.

Your primary responsibilities will include, but not be limited to:

    Managing projects from start to finish, from needs assessment and project planning through implementation, monitoring, and evaluation
    Planning and delivering seminars, conferences, workshops, networking events, and other activities
    Recruiting, onboarding, and coordinating research assistants for various projects and assignments
    Developing clear processes for recruitment, staffing, onboarding, and event management
    Creating project timelines, assigning responsibilities, preparing budgets, and establishing monitoring procedures
    Coordinating participants, speakers, vendors, and partner organizations
    Preparing information, instructions, and other materials for projects and activities
    Ensuring a professional participant experience before, during, and after each event or activity
    Reviewing existing processes, documenting outcomes, and developing improved ways of working based on feedback
    Contributing to the development of the Center’s operations, procedures, and long-term partnerships

Your profile

We are looking for someone who is proactive, solutions-oriented, and skilled at bringing structure to projects with many moving parts. You take ownership of your work and can shift between long-term planning and hands-on tasks as needed. You are organized and structured in your work, while remaining flexible, service-oriented and confident in leading, coordinating, and supporting others to achieve shared goals.

To succeed in this role, you should be a clear, confident, and engaging communicator who can build trust, align stakeholders, and translate complex information into practical guidance for different audiences.

Requirements:

    A relevant academic degree or equivalent professional experience
    Experience independently planning, managing, and completing projects
    Experience organizing events, large-scale programs, or similar activities
    Experience recruiting, staffing, or coordinating employees, students, or volunteers
    Strong administrative skills and ability to create structure, manage details, and keep projects organized and on track
    Experience developing and quality-assuring procedures, instructions, and work processes
    Swedish and English

Meritorious:

    Experience working with student programs, professional development, training initiatives, digital learning platforms, or topics related to security, emergency preparedness, and resilience is a plus

What We Offer

At the Center for Security and Resilience, you will have a varied role with significant responsibility and the opportunity to influence how the Center and its projects develop. You will work in an environment where knowledge, civic engagement, and practical implementation come together, with students and external stakeholders serving as key partners.

Other:

This is a full-time, permanent position with an initial six-month probationary period. The position is located in Stockholm and start date according to agreement.

Please be aware that we conduct background checks on final candidates for this position.

About the Stockholm School of Economics

The Stockholm School of Economics is ranked as the top business school in the Nordic and Baltic countries and enjoys a strong international reputation. World-class research forms the foundation of our educational offering, which includes Bachelor, Master, PhD, MBA, and Executive Education programs. Through creativity and collaboration, the Stockholm School of Economics provides an environment where ambitious students and accomplished researchers meet to address contemporary challenges within business and economics, particularly those concerning sustainability, diversity and innovation.

Apart from delivering world class education within business and economics, SSE students are trained to be successful decision makers and leaders of the future. Our educational mission has over the years strengthened SSE students, and you can read more about it here.

SSE is committed to a balanced gender distribution and values a variety of backgrounds and experiences among our employees. We therefore welcome all applicants regardless of their gender, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, disability, sexual orientation, age, or religion or other beliefs. We strive to have a fair and inclusive recruitment process.

title: Instrument Project Planner
description:
As an Instrument Project Planner, you will create the conditions needed for work to be carried out efficiently - from breaking down work orders and assessing resource requirements to coordinating dependencies, following progress in the field and managing changes along the way. This role suits someone with experience from heavy or highly regulated industry, a solid understanding of instrumentation and the confidence to independently drive their area of responsibility forward.

About the position:

As an Instrument Project Planner, you will be responsible for the planning, preparation and execution of instrument-related work within a large-scale industrial project.

Much of your focus will be on reviewing and preparing the work orders included in the project. You will define the scope, break the work down into executable activities and ensure that technical documentation, resources and dependencies have been identified. This can include coordinating requirements for electrical and mechanical work, scaffolding, insulation and other supporting activities needed to complete the instrument work.

An important part of the role is understanding what the work will actually require in the field. Your planning needs to consider site conditions, required competencies and resources, as well as the sequence in which different activities need to be performed. The resulting work packages will form the basis for both contractor procurement and subsequent execution.

As the project moves into execution, your focus will shift closer to the work taking place in the plant. You will coordinate assigned resources and contractors, follow progress and ensure that work is performed safely and according to plan.

At the same time, you need to be comfortable working in an environment where conditions can change quickly. A work area may become unavailable, additional repair needs may be discovered or resources may need to be reallocated. In these situations, you will assess the impact, reprioritize activities and coordinate with the relevant disciplines to keep the work moving forward.

Responsibilities:

    Plan and prepare instrument-related work orders and work packages
    Develop technical work descriptions for procurement and execution
    Ensure work packages are complete, accurate and executable
    Assess work scope, resource requirements and technical dependencies
    Coordinate supporting activities from disciplines such as electrical, mechanical, scaffolding and insulation
    Ensure planned activities are incorporated into the overall project schedule
    Coordinate contractors and assigned resources during execution
    Follow progress and ensure work is performed according to applicable safety requirements
    Replan and reprioritize activities when conditions change
    Manage discovery work as well as changes and additional work identified during execution
    Follow up completed work packages and coordinate handover for inspection and quality control
    Provide technical support and problem-solving throughout execution

Requirements:

    Technical knowledge and a good understanding of instrumentation
    Experience from major industrial projects, shutdowns or similar environments
    Experience with technical planning and coordination of industrial work
    An understanding of working within heavy, process-based or otherwise highly regulated industry
    The ability to assess the resources, activities and dependencies required to execute technical work
    The ability to independently manage and follow up your area of responsibility

It is considered an advantage if you have:

    Experience from turnarounds or major planned maintenance shutdowns
    Experience from refineries, process plants, pulp and paper, pharmaceutical manufacturing or other highly regulated industrial environments
    Experience combining technical planning with coordination or supervision in the field
    Experience managing contractors and coordinating work across several technical disciplines

To succeed in this role, you need to be self-driven and confident in your technical judgement. You should be able to understand a work scope, determine what is required to execute it and independently drive the next steps without relying on detailed direction.

You are structured in your planning but pragmatic when circumstances change. When unexpected issues arise, you can assess the situation, reprioritize and bring the right people together to find a way forward without compromising safety or quality.

The role involves close collaboration with technical specialists, contractors and other parts of the project organization, so you should also be comfortable communicating clearly and coordinating people around a common plan.

Practical information:

Scope: Full-timeStart: As agreed within the scope of the project til the end of 2027Location: Nynäshamn Salary: Fixed monthly salary by agreement

This is a consulting assignment through Friday, meaning you will be employed by Friday and work on assignment with the client.

About Friday:

At Friday, we are passionate about helping you take the next step in your career in IT and technology, whether you are looking for your first job or already have a few years of experience. By listening to what you want and what motivates you, we match you with companies and opportunities that make you look forward to going to work.

We place great value on ambition and potential and actively promote unbiased recruitment, giving everyone an equal opportunity to succeed.  You can find us in Stockholm, Gothenburg, Malmö, Linköping and Örebro. Every year, we hold more than 5,000 career meetings and match candidates with companies ranging from global corporations to innovative startups.

As a person, you are proactive, self-driven, and results oriented. You do not wait for information or direction but actively seek out what is needed to move projects forward. You lead a geographically distributed commercial organization, collaborate closely with Cimatron leadership team, and report business performance, risks and strategic recommendations to the President of Cimatron.

title: Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH Langzeitpflege 80-100% für die Region Grabs gesucht
description:
- Eine etablierte Institution in der Region Grabs sucht Verstärkung: Sie als Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH, Schwerpunkt Langzeitpflege.

### Ihr Überblick zur Stelle als Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH in Grabs

**Position:** Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH

**Fachbereich:** Langzeitpflege

**Pensum:** 80–100 %

**Anstellung:** Feste Stelle

**Start:** Nach Vereinbarung

**Arbeitsort:** Region Grabs

**Arbeitgeber:** Den Namen nennen wir Ihnen gerne im Gespräch

Kurz gesagt: Der Rahmen stimmt. Zudem lernen Sie nun den Arbeitsort besser kennen, denn genau darum geht es als Nächstes.

Grabs liegt im Rheintal des Kantons St. Gallen und bietet Sie mit einer ausgezeichneten Verkehrsanbindung an. Die Region ist durch die Bahnlinie und das Autobahnnetz gut erreichbar. Als Arbeitsort überzeugt Grabs Sie mit einer starken Industrie- und Gewerbebase, günstigen Bodenpreisen und einer hohen Lebensqualität in unmittelbarer Nähe zum Bodensee und Liechtenstein.

### Das erwartet Sie als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Langzeitpflege in Grabs

- Sie tragen dabei die Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess, von der Erhebung bis zur Auswertung
- Zudem: Durchführung ärztlicher Verordnungen sowie sichere Abgabe der Medikamente
- Zudem überwachen Sie die Vitalzeichen, denn Sie erkennen früh, wenn sich etwas ändert
- Darüber hinaus leiten Sie FaGe, Pflegeassistenz sowie Lernende fachlich an
- Ausserdem lückenlose Pflegedokumentation im elektronischen System
- Zusammenarbeit mit Ärzteschaft, Therapien sowie Angehörigen auf Augenhöhe

### Ihr Profil – darauf kommt es an

- Zuerst das Fachliche: die Ausbildung als dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder FH
- Bei ausländischem Diplom: SRK-Anerkennung zwingend erforderlich
- Zudem Erfahrung in der Langzeitpflege, Akutpflege oder Reha
- Vor allem Verantwortung, Empathie sowie eine belastbare, ruhige Art
- Dazu sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (mind. B2)

### Ihr Arbeitsumfeld: Langzeitpflege

Die Langzeitpflege lebt von Beziehung: Sie begleiten Menschen über lange Zeit, kennen ihre Gewohnheiten und bauen echtes Vertrauen auf. Dabei begleiten Sie auch komplexe, chronische Verläufe – mit Ruhe und Kontinuität statt Hektik.

Kurz gesagt: Als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Langzeitpflege in Grabs verbinden Sie Fachlichkeit mit einem Umfeld, das zu Ihnen passt. Darum lohnt sich diese Stelle doppelt.

### Der Beruf im Detail: Was macht eine diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH?

Als diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH tragen Sie die fachliche Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess. Sie erheben den Pflegebedarf, danach planen Sie die Massnahmen und werten die Ergebnisse aus. Zudem steuern Sie die Abgabe der Medikamente, überwachen Vitalzeichen und erkennen Veränderungen früh. Somit entsteht Pflegequalität, die ankommt.

Der Weg in diesen Beruf führt über die höhere Fachschule (HF) oder das Bachelorstudium Pflege (FH). Ausländische Diplome brauchen dafür eine [Anerkennung durch das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK)](https://www.redcross.ch/de/srk-anerkennung). Ausserdem stehen erfahrenen Fachpersonen viele Wege offen: ein Nachdiplomstudium (NDS), die Rolle als Berufsbildnerin oder die Teamleitung.

Die Nachfrage nach diplomierten Pflegefachpersonen in der Langzeitpflege rund um Grabs ist derzeit sehr hoch, da Altersheime und Betreuungseinrichtungen konstant unter Fachkräftemangel leiden. Sie profitieren von ausgezeichneten Karrierechancen und können zwischen verschiedenen attraktiven Positionen im 80–100%-Pensum wählen. iPersonal unterstützt Sie als erfahrener Vermittler mit persönlicher Beratung, passgenauen Stellenvorschlägen und dem Netzwerk zu etablierten Arbeitgebern in der Region, was Ihnen einen reibungslosen Einstieg garantiert.

Strong technical judgment and problem\-solving skills.  
Excellent communication and leadership skills for multi\-functional and executive interactions.  
Proven track record to lead budgets, schedules, and complex contractor relationships.  
Familiarity with regulatory expectations for facilities in regulated industries.  
Proficiency with project management and engineering documentation tools.

**Position:** Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH

**Fachbereich:** Entzugsstation

**Anstellung:** Feste Stelle

**Start:** Nach Vereinbarung

**Arbeitsort:** Region Kaiseraugst

**Arbeitgeber:** Den Namen nennen wir Ihnen gerne im Gespräch

Kurz gesagt: Der Rahmen stimmt. Zudem lernen Sie nun den Arbeitsort besser kennen, denn genau darum geht es als Nächstes.

Kaiseraugst liegt strategisch günstig im Kanton Aargau nahe Basel und besticht durch eine hervorragende Verkehrsanbindung mit direktem Zugang zur Autobahn sowie zu Bahnverbindungen. Die Nähe zu Basel und das Dreiländereck machen die Region für Arbeitnehmende äußerst attraktiv, da Sie von einer stabilen Wirtschaft und vielfältigen Jobmöglichkeiten profitieren. Zugleich bietet Kaiseraugst Ihnen Wohnqualität mit ländlichem Charme und guter Infrastruktur.

### So sieht Ihr Alltag als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Entzugsstation in Kaiseraugst aus

- Sie tragen dabei die Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess, von der Erhebung bis zur Auswertung
- Zudem: Durchführung ärztlicher Verordnungen sowie sichere Abgabe der Medikamente
- Zudem überwachen Sie die Vitalzeichen, denn Sie erkennen früh, wenn sich etwas ändert
- Darüber hinaus leiten Sie FaGe, Pflegeassistenz sowie Lernende fachlich an
- Ausserdem lückenlose Pflegedokumentation im elektronischen System
- Zusammenarbeit mit Ärzteschaft, Therapien sowie Angehörigen auf Augenhöhe

### Was Sie für diese Stelle mitbringen

- Zuerst das Fachliche: die Ausbildung als dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder FH
- Bei ausländischem Diplom: SRK-Anerkennung zwingend erforderlich
- Zudem Erfahrung in der Langzeitpflege, Akutpflege oder Reha
- Vor allem Verantwortung, Empathie sowie eine belastbare, ruhige Art

title: Sr. Supervisor QA Complaint Approval
description:
Sr. Supervisor QA Complaint Approval  
At Johnson \& Johnson, we believe health is everything. Our strength in healthcare innovation empowers us to build a world where complex diseases are prevented, treated, and cured, where treatments are smarter and less invasive, and solutions are personal. Through our expertise in Innovative Medicine and MedTech, we are uniquely positioned to innovate across the full spectrum of healthcare solutions today to deliver the breakthroughs of tomorrow, and profoundly impact health for humanity. Learn more at .  
As guided by Our Credo, Johnson \& Johnson is responsible to our employees who work with us throughout the world. We provide an inclusive work environment where each person is considered as an individual. At Johnson \& Johnson, we respect the diversity and dignity of our employees and recognize their merit.  
Cilag AG in Schaffhausen belongs to the group of Johnson \& Johnson Innovative Medicine and manufactures high quality pharmaceutical products, active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs) and medical devices. Today Cilag AG is one of the largest pharmaceutical manufacturers in Switzerland supplying all the major global markets. The Schaffhausen facility is a strategic launch and growth site for parenteral products, and we have an impressive pipeline of new and innovative products.  
The Senior Supervisor, Complaint Quality Approver Team is accountable for leading a team of Complaint Quality Approvers responsible for independent, objective review and approval of complaint records. The role provides people leadership, operational oversight, and quality decision support to ensure complaint investigations are complete, scientifically justified, risk\-based, and compliant with applicable procedures and regulations. The Senior Supervisor ensures consistent approval practices, timely record progression, appropriate escalation of quality risks, and continuous capability development across the team.  
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES  
The Senior Supervisor leads the Complaint Quality Approver team and is responsible for assigning, prioritizing, and monitoring work to ensure compliant and timely approval of complaint records. The role provides guidance to approvers on investigation strategy, risk assessment, escalation, evidence requirements, Root Cause Analysis, NC considerations, and alignment of investigation conclusions across products or affiliates when applicable. The Senior Supervisor ensures that approval decisions are made consistently and are supported by objective evidence, applicable procedures, and current regulatory expectations. In addition, the role reviews complex or high\-risk complaint records, supports escalation to Quality leadership, and drives alignment with cross\-functional partners when investigation direction, closure readiness, or quality risk requires leadership input.  
The Senior Supervisor is accountable for developing team capability through coaching, feedback, training, and performance management. The role establishes clear expectations for documentation quality, approval rationale, system usage, and stakeholder communication, and ensures the team applies best practices consistently. The Senior Supervisor monitors workload, cycle time, quality metrics, backlog, and recurring investigation trends to identify improvement opportunities, remove barriers, and support sustainable business continuity. The role also contributes to process improvement initiatives, inspection readiness, audit support, and the implementation of global or site quality system changes impacting complaint record approval.  
KEY INTERFACES  
Complaint Quality Approvers to provide leadership, coaching, work prioritization, and performance feedback.  
Complaint investigation owners and cross\-functional contributors, including Manufacturing, QC, Engineering, Supply Chain, Packaging, MSAT, Regulatory, and Medical Safety as applicable.  
Quality leadership for escalation, risk communication, resource planning, operational performance, and decision alignment.  
Other sites and affiliates to align investigation strategy, closure expectations, evidence requirements, and consistent complaint outcomes for site\-manufactured products.  
Audit, inspection readiness, quality systems, and process improvement stakeholders to support compliant execution and continuous improvement.  
REQUIRED KNOWLEDGE \& SKILLS  
Strong knowledge of quality investigations, complaint handling, CAPA and nonconformance concepts in a regulated pharmaceutical or medical product environment.  
Demonstrated ability to lead, coach, and develop a team in a quality organization, including setting priorities and managing performance.  
Strong understanding of cGMP, Good Documentation Practices, data integrity expectations, and applicable U.S. and international regulatory requirements.  
Proven ability to assess complex technical data, investigation conclusions, risk assessments, and escalation needs.  
Ability to make sound quality decisions, communicate clear rationale, and ensure consistency in approval standards.  
Strong stakeholder management skills and ability to operate effectively in a matrixed, cross\-functional, and global environment.  
Ability to drive sustainable process improvements.  
Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to provide actionable feedback and represent the team in leadership discussions.  
Strong organization, prioritization, and decision\-making skills to manage multiple priorities, deadlines, and escalations.  
EDUCATION \& EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS  
Master’s degree or PhD in Life Science or related discipline, or equivalent experience, is required.  
Minimum of 3\-4 years of experience in quality investigations, complaint handling, quality systems, or a related regulated quality environment is required.  
Prior people leadership, team lead, supervisory, or demonstrated coaching experience is strongly preferred.  
Experience performing, reviewing, approving, or providing oversight for complex quality investigations, complaints, deviations, nonconformances, or similar quality events.  
Experience working with cross\-functional stakeholders and quality leadership to manage risk, escalation, and decision alignment.  
Demonstrated ability to drive process improvement, inspection readiness, and consistent execution of quality system requirements.  
Proven critical thinking, problem\-solving, communication, and people leadership skills.
